creatures.name: Dust-Broke Drifter
creatures.flavor: A busted prospector or out-of-luck ranch hand who picked up a gun because begging stopped working. Fights scared and quits the moment the math turns against him.
creatures.summary: Desperate gun-for-hire, breaks and runs when losing

creatures.name: Line-Rider
creatures.flavor: Rank-and-file gang muscle who rides the fence lines looking for something to take. Works in packs, brave only in numbers.
creatures.summary: Rank-and-file outlaw muscle, brave only in packs

creatures.name: Coyote-Thing
creatures.flavor: A dust-country coyote gone wrong at the edges — too many teeth, a laugh instead of a howl. Runs in loose, opportunistic packs and never attacks what it can't out-number.
creatures.summary: Wrong-shaped coyote pack, laughs instead of howling

creatures.name: Scarecrow Sentinel
creatures.flavor: Propped over a dead man's field to scare off crows and, lately, everything else. Stands dead still until you stop watching it, then it isn't where it was.
creatures.summary: Field scarecrow that only moves when unwatched

creatures.name: Claim-Jumper
creatures.flavor: Squats on other men's stakes with a rifle and a forged deed. Knows the land better than the law does and uses that.
creatures.summary: Armed squatter on a forged land deed

creatures.name: Company Enforcer
creatures.flavor: Muscle on the railroad or mining company payroll — collects debts, breaks strikes, and calls it business.
creatures.summary: Railroad-payroll thug who calls debt-collection business

creatures.name: Buzzard-Kin
creatures.flavor: An unnaturally patient carrion bird the size of a man's torso that's learned to circle the living a little early.
creatures.summary: Torso-sized vulture that circles the living early

creatures.name: Dust Devil
creatures.model: net-new: a churning funnel of sand and static shaped loosely like a striking snake
creatures.flavor: A living whirlwind of grit and heat-shimmer that scours a rider off his horse before anyone sees it coming. The old-timers swear it only forms where blood's been spilled.
creatures.summary: Living dust-funnel that scours riders off horseback

creatures.name: Debt-Collector Ghoul
creatures.flavor: A man who died owing money and came back still keeping the ledger — hollow-eyed, gaunt, and convinced the debt transfers to whoever's standing nearest.
creatures.summary: Ledger-keeping ghoul who thinks the debt transfers

creatures.name: Gunslinger's Shade
creatures.flavor: The echo of a quick-draw who lost the one duel that mattered. Reenacts the noon-draw against anyone who'll stand still for it, forever losing, forever trying again.
creatures.summary: Ghostly quick-draw reliving the duel he lost

creatures.name: Iron Horse Wreck-Golem
creatures.model: net-new: a hunched engine of riveted boiler-plate, steam venting from a cracked stack
creatures.flavor: Salvaged rail-yard iron bolted into something that walks and swings. Company men built it to guard the spur line; it forgot who it was guarding it from.
creatures.summary: Salvaged locomotive-iron golem guarding a dead spur line

creatures.name: Bounty Board Regular
creatures.flavor: A working gun-for-hire whose face is on three different posters, all for different names. Professional, unhurried, and always faster on the draw than the job requires.
creatures.summary: Wanted-poster gunfighter, unhurried and always faster

creatures.name: Card-Sharp Killer
creatures.model: net-new: a well-dressed gambler with a sleeve derringer and a dealer's stillness
creatures.flavor: Cleans out a table hand by hand, then cleans up the man who calls him on it. The cards are the tell; the derringer up the sleeve is the punchline.
creatures.summary: Cheating gambler who kills the man who calls him

creatures.name: Rustler Pack Boss
creatures.flavor: Runs a cattle-and-horse theft ring across three counties, quick to shoot and quicker to blame the next gang over.
creatures.summary: Cattle-rustling gang boss, quick to shoot and blame

creatures.name: Sidewinder Broodmother
creatures.flavor: A rattler grown to wagon-length in a dry wash nobody rides through twice. Her brood scatters the desert floor for a half-mile in every direction.
creatures.summary: Wagon-length rattler with a half-mile brood

creatures.name: Marshal's Ghost
creatures.flavor: The last honest lawman in three territories, shot in the back for it, still walking his rounds at dusk. Doesn't know he's dead — only knows the town's gone lawless again.
creatures.summary: Murdered lawman still walking his dusk patrol

creatures.name: Cattle-Baron's Enforcer
creatures.flavor: The baron's personal fist — duels for land, for water rights, for the principle of the thing, and hasn't lost yet.
creatures.summary: Baron's undefeated duelist, fights over land and water

creatures.name: Boneyard Preacher
creatures.flavor: A hellfire circuit preacher whose congregation buried him alive for the sins he named too accurately. His sermon still carries, and it still convicts.
creatures.summary: Buried-alive preacher whose sermon still convicts

creatures.name: Stampede-Cursed Longhorn
creatures.flavor: A prize bull gone feral and enormous on cursed range grass, the lead animal in a stampede that never quite ends.
creatures.summary: Feral cursed bull leading a stampede that never ends

creatures.name: Vault-Keeper Wight
creatures.flavor: A bank owner who died clutching his strongbox and rose still clutching it, deputizing whatever corpses are handy to guard the vault door.
creatures.summary: Dead bank owner still guarding his strongbox

creatures.name: Noon-Duel Gunfighter
creatures.model: net-new: a duster-coated gunfighter standing dead-center in an empty street
creatures.flavor: Never lost a noon draw and never will — the whole town clears out when word gets around he's in it. Some say he picks the fights just to keep the streak.
creatures.summary: Undefeated noon-draw gunfighter the whole town fears

creatures.name: Rail Baron's War-Machine
creatures.model: net-new: a squat armored rail-car on legs, gatling-barrels where a face would be, chuffing black smoke
creatures.flavor: Built to muscle a right-of-way through land nobody agreed to sell. Answers only to the man who signed the requisition — and he's long dead.
creatures.summary: Armored rail-car war-machine muscling a dead man's right-of-way

creatures.name: Draw-at-Noon Revenant
creatures.flavor: Killed at high noon in a duel that everyone in town watched and nobody stopped. Returns every day the sun's directly overhead, looking for whoever's standing in the street.
creatures.summary: Duel-killed revenant returning every noon to draw again

creatures.name: The Last Honest Marshal
creatures.model: net-new: a duster-coated lawman figure, star badge fused to bone, twin revolvers that never run dry
creatures.flavor: He held the line when the town's whole council told him to look away, and it killed him for it. Now he holds a line nobody else can even see, and the badge is grown into his ribs.
creatures.summary: Undying lawman whose fused badge still holds the line

creatures.name: The Noon Reckoning
creatures.model: net-new: a towering gunslinger silhouette wreathed in heat-shimmer, twin oversized pistols
creatures.flavor: Every town's noon-draw that ever ended in blood feeds it — it IS the duel, wearing whatever face the debt requires. It only walks the street when the sun's dead overhead and someone's about to draw.
creatures.summary: Towering fiend that embodies every blood-ended noon duel

creatures.name: Tin-Star Deputy
creatures.flavor: A green badge-wearer sworn in last week because the town ran out of better options. Follows orders to the letter and dies exactly as often as that implies.
creatures.summary: Green deputy who follows orders to the letter

creatures.name: Trail-Dust Skinner
creatures.flavor: Skins whatever the range gives up and sells the hides to whoever's buying, law or otherwise. Carries a knife more than a gun and knows how to use both badly.
creatures.summary: Hide-skinner who sells to whoever's buying

creatures.name: Powder-Monkey Kid
creatures.flavor: Too young for the gang proper, so he handles the dynamite and does the running. Fast, twitchy, and one bad drop from taking the whole outfit with him.
creatures.summary: Underage dynamite-runner, twitchy and dangerous

creatures.name: Rail-Camp Roughneck
creatures.flavor: Spikes track by day, breaks heads by night when the paymaster's short again. Swings a maul like he means it.
creatures.summary: Track-laying laborer who breaks heads for back pay

creatures.name: Sidewinder Snake
creatures.flavor: An ordinary desert rattler, except this stretch of scrub has three times the usual number of them, all agitated.
creatures.summary: Ordinary rattler, unusually common and agitated

creatures.name: Scrub-Land Jackrabbit Swarm
creatures.flavor: A boiling mass of oversized jackrabbits that strips a garden bare in a minute and a rider's boots in two. Harmless alone, a hazard in number.
creatures.summary: Boiling jackrabbit mass that strips land bare

creatures.name: Range Buzzard
creatures.flavor: An honest, unremarkable carrion bird — except it's started following specific people days before they die.
creatures.summary: Ordinary vulture that follows the soon-to-be-dead

creatures.name: Prairie Dust-Wolf
creatures.flavor: Leaner and hungrier than a plain wolf, runs the dry washes in loose family packs and takes livestock when the deer thin out.
creatures.summary: Lean dry-wash wolf that takes livestock in packs

creatures.name: Grave-Dust Crow
creatures.flavor: A boneyard raven that picked up a sliver of whatever's buried underneath it. Talks a little, in a dead man's cadence.
creatures.summary: Boneyard raven that talks in a dead man's cadence

creatures.name: Whiskey-Nerve Brawler
creatures.flavor: Fights better drunk than sober and knows it, so he's rarely sober. Saloon muscle, cheap to hire, cheaper to replace.
creatures.summary: Saloon brawler who fights better drunk

creatures.name: Homestead Scarecrow
creatures.flavor: A second scarecrow from the same cursed patch of field as its cousin, propped on a homestead fence instead of a graveyard one. Same trick, different crop.
creatures.summary: Cursed-field scarecrow variant guarding a homestead

creatures.name: Claim-Office Forger
creatures.flavor: Draws up land deeds that look real enough to hold up in a corrupt court, then sells the same plot three times over.
creatures.summary: Land-deed forger who triple-sells the same plot

creatures.name: Stagecoach Highwayman
creatures.flavor: Works the coach roads alone or in pairs, masked, polite, and gone before the horses have stopped stamping.
creatures.summary: Polite masked highwayman working the coach roads

creatures.name: Company Book-Keeper Wight
creatures.flavor: Died at his ledger balancing debts nobody could pay and rose still doing the arithmetic, hollow-voiced, endlessly recounting the sums owed.
creatures.summary: Dead accountant endlessly recounting debts owed

creatures.name: Boothill Skeleton
creatures.flavor: Rises from the cheap end of the cemetery with a rifle instead of a bow, still dressed in a moth-eaten duster, and shoots at anything that disturbs its plot.
creatures.summary: Rifle-toting graveyard skeleton in a rotted duster

creatures.name: Dust-Choked Ghoul
creatures.flavor: Died of thirst in a dry wash and came back still parched, still digging for water that isn't there, biting anything that gets close to the hole.
creatures.summary: Thirst-crazed ghoul still digging a dry wash

creatures.name: Grave-Dirt Zombie Posse
creatures.flavor: A whole hanged gang risen together, still riding formation out of habit though their horses rotted out from under them years ago.
creatures.summary: Hanged gang risen in formation, horses long gone

creatures.name: Mine-Shaft Crawler
creatures.flavor: Bred in the dark below a played-out silver claim on whatever the miners stopped bringing up. Paralyzes with a touch and drags the still to a side tunnel.
creatures.summary: Blind mine-shaft predator that paralyzes and drags prey

creatures.name: Sun-Blind Prospector Ghast
creatures.flavor: Went snow-blind on salt flats chasing a vein that wasn't there and starved rather than turn back. Now it doesn't turn back from anything.
creatures.summary: Salt-blind prospector ghast that never turns back

creatures.name: Rust-Bitten Rail Golem
creatures.flavor: A stray piece of rail-yard machinery, half-alive from proximity to the Iron Horse Wreck-Golem, that eats iron and spits corrosion.
creatures.summary: Iron-eating rail-yard scrap creature spitting corrosion

creatures.name: Poker-Table Cheat
creatures.flavor: Palms cards for a living and a knife for emergencies, both smoothly enough that nobody's caught him twice.
creatures.summary: Smooth card-palming cheat, quick with a hideout knife

creatures.name: Sod-House Squatter
creatures.flavor: Dug into another man's land and dared anyone to move him. Mostly bluff, occasionally not.
creatures.summary: Stubborn dugout squatter, mostly bluff

creatures.name: Territorial Militia Rifle
creatures.flavor: Called up from the local ranches when the cavalry's a week out, drilled poorly, aims worse, holds anyway out of stubbornness.
creatures.summary: Poorly drilled militia rifleman who holds out of stubbornness

creatures.name: Cavalry Deserter
creatures.flavor: Walked off from his unit after seeing something in the breach he wasn't paid enough to fight, and now robs both sides equally.
creatures.summary: Cavalry deserter who robs both sides equally

creatures.name: Prickled Cactus-Kin
creatures.flavor: A saguaro that learned to want something, and to reach for it. Stands stock-still until a rider passes too close.
creatures.summary: Reaching cactus-kin, still until a rider passes close

creatures.name: Alkali Flat Wisp
creatures.flavor: A drowning-light that leads thirsty travelers deeper into the salt flats instead of toward the water it pretends to be.
creatures.summary: Salt-flat wisp luring the thirsty away from water

creatures.name: Bounty-Poster Doppel
creatures.flavor: Wears the face on whichever wanted poster pays best that week, collects the bounty on itself from a gullible marshal, and vanishes before the paperwork clears.
creatures.summary: Shapeshifter that impersonates its own bounty poster

creatures.name: Copperhead Nest-Guard
creatures.flavor: An oversized copperhead that's claimed a played-out mine entrance as its den and doesn't share territory with anything, prospector included.
creatures.summary: Territorial oversized copperhead denning a mine entrance

creatures.name: Company Strikebreaker
creatures.flavor: Hired muscle sent to end a labor dispute the fast way, works up a rage on cheap liquor before wading into a picket line.
creatures.summary: Liquor-raged strikebreaker sent to end a picket line

creatures.name: Grave Robber Duo
creatures.flavor: Works the boneyards after dark for rings, gold teeth, and the occasional cursed trinket that's more trouble than it's worth.
creatures.summary: Boneyard grave robber, occasionally digs up trouble

creatures.name: Iron-Rail Spike Wraith
creatures.model: net-new: a translucent laborer-shape fused at the wrists to a glowing spike-maul, driving invisible rail forever
creatures.flavor: A track-worker crushed under the rail he was laying, doomed to keep driving spikes into ground that no longer needs them, swinging at anyone who steps on his old line.
creatures.summary: Crushed rail-worker ghost still driving phantom spikes

creatures.name: Prairie Fire Elemental
creatures.flavor: A grass fire that outran the wind and kept going, taking on a will of its own somewhere past the second county line.
creatures.summary: Runaway grass fire that took on a will of its own

creatures.name: Sand-Wash Basilisk
creatures.flavor: Petrifies whatever crosses its wash, then waits for the desert to grind the statue down to gravel over the years. The wash is full of very old gravel.
creatures.summary: Petrifying desert basilisk denning a gravel-choked wash

creatures.name: Trail-Boss Werewolf
creatures.flavor: Runs a legitimate cattle drive by daylight and a very different kind of hunt by moonlight, and the two crews never meet each other.
creatures.summary: Cattle-drive boss who hunts differently by moonlight

creatures.name: Bank Job Crew Boss
creatures.flavor: Plans the job down to the minute and the getaway better than the job, which is why he's never once been caught at the scene.
creatures.summary: Meticulous bank-job planner, never caught at the scene

creatures.name: Whiskey-Runner Smuggler Chief
creatures.flavor: Moves contraband liquor and worse across the territory line under a dozen aliases, always one step ahead of whoever's asking questions.
creatures.summary: Alias-juggling smuggler always ahead of questions

creatures.name: Prospector's Undying Mule
creatures.flavor: Died of overwork hauling ore for a claim that never paid out, and kept walking the same switchback trail long after the flesh gave out.
creatures.summary: Overworked mule-skeleton still hauling a dead claim's ore

creatures.name: Ridge-Line Sniper
creatures.flavor: Picks a ridge a half-mile out and waits, sometimes for days, for one clean shot that ends whatever argument brought him there.
creatures.summary: Patient half-mile ridge sniper who waits days for one shot

creatures.name: Corral-Breaker Bull
creatures.flavor: A range bull too mean for any fence, gores riders on principle and has flattened three homestead corrals trying to get at nothing in particular.
creatures.summary: Fence-breaking mean bull that gores on principle

creatures.name: Blood-Money Bounty Hunter
creatures.flavor: Doesn't care if the poster says dead or alive, only cares which is cheaper to transport. Has never once brought a man back breathing.
creatures.summary: Bounty hunter who only ever delivers corpses

creatures.name: Ghost-Town Poltergeist
creatures.flavor: The town emptied out around it decades ago and it's still rearranging the saloon furniture for customers who left generations back.
creatures.summary: Ghost-town spirit still setting up for gone customers

creatures.name: Devil's Canyon Chimera
creatures.flavor: A stitched-together horror of coyote, buzzard, and rattler that dens in a canyon locals have stopped naming out loud.
creatures.summary: Coyote-buzzard-rattler chimera denning an unspoken canyon

creatures.name: Six-Gun Doppelganger
creatures.flavor: Steals a gunfighter's face and reputation both, then cashes in every grudge that reputation was owed before anyone spots the switch.
creatures.summary: Face-stealer that cashes in a gunfighter's old grudges

creatures.name: Cursed Silver Vein Xorn
creatures.flavor: Burrows through rock eating the ore veins miners are chasing, which makes it either the luckiest strike or the worst omen a claim can hit.
creatures.summary: Ore-eating burrower that ruins or blesses a mining claim

creatures.name: Company Iron Enforcer
creatures.flavor: A boiler-plate strikebreaker the railroad company keeps for disputes it doesn't want a human face attached to.
creatures.summary: Faceless boiler-plate construct enforcing company disputes

creatures.name: Sand-Ghast Cattle King
creatures.flavor: Starved his own herd to sell the feed money elsewhere, and rose still hungrier than the cattle he killed.
creatures.summary: Herd-starving cattle baron risen hungrier than his own stock

creatures.name: Faro Table Devil
creatures.flavor: Sits every faro table in a three-town circuit, offers a winning streak for a soul-sized marker, and always collects.
creatures.summary: Card-table devil trading winning streaks for souls

creatures.name: Rattlesnake Nest Colossus
creatures.flavor: So many rattlers denned in the same rock pile over so many years that the pile itself started moving as one animal.
creatures.summary: Rock-pile rattlesnake mass that moves as one animal

creatures.name: Frontier Vampire Rancher
creatures.flavor: Runs the biggest spread in the territory and never once been seen buying cattle, only losing them, one thin cow at a time.
creatures.summary: Undead rancher whose herd thins one drained cow at a time

creatures.name: Broken Treaty Warband Leader
creatures.flavor: Leads a mixed band of the wronged and the desperate against whoever tore up the last agreement, and doesn't much care whose fault it originally was.
creatures.summary: Warband leader avenging a torn-up land treaty

creatures.name: Devil-Wind Salamander
creatures.flavor: A living heat-mirage with a serpent's temper that curls up out of the noon shimmer to strike anything foolish enough to travel at that hour.
creatures.summary: Heat-mirage serpent that strikes at high noon

creatures.name: Wanted-Dead Wraith Duo
creatures.flavor: Two outlaw brothers hanged from the same tree, now inseparable in death as they were in the job, finishing each other's ambushes.
creatures.summary: Hanged outlaw brothers who ambush in tandem

creatures.name: Iron Horse Runaway Engine
creatures.model: net-new: a locomotive fused with a boiler-armored torso and piston-driven arms
creatures.flavor: Broke from its rail line entirely and now runs the open desert on legs it built for itself, chasing whatever startled it in the first place.
creatures.summary: Rail-broken locomotive now running the open desert on legs

creatures.name: Buzzard-Winged Peryton
creatures.flavor: A vulture-antlered horror that circles a claim jumper's grave and casts the shadow of the man it's about to kill.
creatures.summary: Antlered vulture-thing casting its next victim's shadow

creatures.name: Cattle-Baron's Gorgon Bull
creatures.flavor: An iron-plated stud bull the baron had forged rather than bred, breathes petrifying dust on anyone who questions the brand.
creatures.summary: Forged iron bull breathing petrifying dust on trespassers

creatures.name: Territorial Marshal Knight
creatures.flavor: A federal marshal riding circuit through three territories with a badge that actually means something, which makes him rare enough to be a target.
creatures.summary: Rare honest federal marshal, rare enough to be a target

creatures.name: Salt Flat Mummy King
creatures.flavor: A cattle baron so obsessed with his empire he had himself dried and wrapped in cured hide rather than let death touch his ledgers, and still rules from the flats.
creatures.summary: Hide-wrapped cattle baron still ruling from beyond death

creatures.name: Devil's Bargain Land Baron
creatures.model: net-new: a horned, dust-coated dealmaker with four hands holding signed deeds
creatures.flavor: Buys up drought-broken ranches for pennies and a signature, and the fine print always costs the seller something worse than money.
creatures.summary: Deal-making fiend buying ranches with cursed fine print

creatures.name: Company War-Locomotive
creatures.flavor: A second, heavier war-machine the rail company built after the first went missing — plated thicker, angrier, and still answering to a dead requisition.
creatures.summary: Heavier armored war-locomotive answering a dead order

creatures.name: Ghost Cavalry Column
creatures.model: net-new: a mounted officer-revenant leading a column of translucent riders, sabers drawn, bugle silent
creatures.flavor: Rode into a canyon on bad orders and never rode out, and the column still charges the same canyon mouth every anniversary of the massacre.
creatures.summary: Massacred cavalry column still charging on its anniversary

creatures.name: Twelve-Gauge Lich of the Vault
creatures.model: net-new: a skeletal bank president with a shotgun fused to bone hands
creatures.flavor: Bound his own soul to the vault he built rather than let a robbery ever succeed against him, and now the vault and the corpse are the same defended object.
creatures.summary: Bank president-lich fused to the vault he'll never lose

creatures.name: Skinwalker Cavalry Scout
creatures.model: net-new: a lean, coyote-shouldered scout-shape in cavalry-cut leathers, moving between man and animal mid-stride
creatures.flavor: Turned scout for whichever side is winning that season and turned something else entirely out on the picket lines, loyal only to not losing.
creatures.summary: Shapeshifting scout loyal only to the winning side

creatures.name: Alkali Reaper Naga
creatures.flavor: Coils under the dry lakebeds where a wagon train vanished whole, and speaks with every voice that was ever lost to the salt.
creatures.summary: Lakebed naga speaking with every voice the salt swallowed

creatures.name: Boneyard Behir
creatures.flavor: A canyon-length lightning-scaled horror that nests where the railroad blasted through the wrong mountain, and hasn't forgiven the noise.
creatures.summary: Canyon-nesting lightning horror that hates the railroad's noise

creatures.name: Rail Baron's Hydra Freight
creatures.flavor: Bred from a swamp-hydra egg shipped west by mistake and raised on freight-car livestock; every severed head just means another car to guard.
creatures.summary: Freight-raised hydra guarding every car with another head

creatures.name: Dead Hand Gunfighter Twins
creatures.model: net-new: twin duster-coated revenants standing back to back with four revolvers
creatures.flavor: Killed each other in a misunderstanding neither survived long enough to correct, and now hunt as one four-armed problem for anyone who separates them.
creatures.summary: Twin gunfighter revenants who died misunderstanding each other

creatures.name: Storm-Called Thunderbird
creatures.model: net-new: a storm-wreathed raptor the size of a barn, lightning-crackling wings
creatures.flavor: A sky-god's shape the old range still half-believes in, called down by droughts bad enough to break faith, and it does not come gently.
creatures.summary: Barn-sized storm raptor summoned by drought-broken faith

creatures.name: Iron Baron's War-Golem Prime
creatures.model: net-new: a towering rail-yard colossus welded from three wrecked engines
creatures.flavor: The rail company's final answer to every strike, treaty, and refusal — built from the bones of two failed war-machines and meant to end the argument permanently.
creatures.summary: Triple-engine war-colossus built to end every argument

creatures.name: Nightbringer of the Long Drive
creatures.model: net-new: a tall cattle-drive foreman in a blood-dark duster with backward hands
creatures.flavor: Ran drives so hard the cattle died and so did half the hands, and something noticed how little he cared and made a deal permanent.
creatures.summary: Cattle-drive foreman-fiend who never cared how many died

creatures.name: Crossroads Contract Devil
creatures.model: net-new: a duster-clad fiend standing at a crossroads with a fiddle-case
creatures.flavor: Waits at the loneliest crossroads in the territory for whoever's desperate enough to trade, and the contract terms are always technically honest.
creatures.summary: Crossroads fiend trading technically-honest desperate deals

creatures.name: The Undertaker Who Never Sleeps
creatures.model: net-new: a black-suited undertaker with hands stitched from a hundred corpses
creatures.flavor: Buried the whole territory twice over and kept a record of every name, and now digs graves ahead of schedule for names not yet in his book.
creatures.summary: Ledger-keeping undertaker who digs graves ahead of schedule

creatures.name: The Company That Owns The Land
creatures.model: net-new: a bloated boardroom horror wearing overlapping deeds as skin
creatures.flavor: No single face runs it and no single bullet stops it — it is every unfair contract and stolen claim in the territory given appetite and a seat at the table.
creatures.summary: Boardroom fiend embodying every stolen claim in the territory

creatures.name: The Drought That Remembers
creatures.model: net-new: a towering heat-mirage colossus shaped like a dead cattle drive
creatures.flavor: Seven dry years given a body — it walks ahead of famine, and the land it crosses forgets how to grow anything for a generation after.
creatures.summary: Seven-year drought given a body, sterilizing the land it walks

creatures.name: The Vigilance Committee
creatures.model: net-new: a fused mass of hooded rope-scarred figures moving in unison
creatures.flavor: Every mob that ever hanged the wrong man in this territory, bound together into one judge, jury, and rope that can't be talked out of a verdict.
creatures.summary: Fused lynch-mob horror that can't be talked out of a verdict

creatures.name: The Last Train West
creatures.model: net-new: an armored freight-train given a striding, many-legged locomotive body
creatures.flavor: It was supposed to be the future arriving on schedule; instead it never stops, never lets anyone off, and lays track behind it toward somewhere nobody asked to go.
creatures.summary: Unstoppable train-colossus that never lets its passengers off

creatures.name: The Iron-Bound Marshal
creatures.flavor: Killed in the line of duty and too stubborn to lie down, he still makes his rounds at dusk, badge rusted to his ribs, and reads the town's outstanding warrants aloud before he collects.
creatures.summary: undead lawman who still serves his warrants
creatures.sourceNote: stock frontier lawman archetype (undead-lawman variant of the Western genre's 'man who wouldn't stay dead')

creatures.name: Draw-Fast Desperado
creatures.flavor: All hat, all nerve, and just fast enough to be dangerous once before someone faster ends the argument.
creatures.summary: trigger-happy small-time outlaw
creatures.sourceNote: stock quick-draw gunslinger-outlaw archetype

creatures.name: The Coach-Line Gang
creatures.flavor: They work in threes, hit the coach at the narrows, and vanish into the scrub before the dust of the robbery even settles.
creatures.summary: stagecoach-robbing bandit crew regular
creatures.sourceNote: stock stagecoach-robbery bandit crew archetype

creatures.name: Hired Iron
creatures.flavor: Not loyal to the gang, the ranch, or the law — loyal to whoever's coin is heaviest that week, and scrupulous about finishing the job he's paid for.
creatures.summary: mercenary gun for hire, loyal to coin only
creatures.sourceNote: stock hired-gun / regulator archetype

creatures.name: The Bounty Man
creatures.flavor: Carries a ledger of names instead of a Bible, crosses one out with the same flat calm each time, and never once raises his voice doing it.
creatures.summary: methodical bounty hunter working a name-ledger
creatures.sourceNote: stock bounty-hunter archetype

creatures.name: The Rail Baron's Enforcer
creatures.flavor: Sent ahead of the survey crews to make sure no one's still living on land the railroad already sold, and paid extra for the ones who take convincing.
creatures.summary: railroad company muscle clearing land claims
creatures.sourceNote: stock company-man / railroad-enforcer archetype

creatures.name: Old Ruin-Rider
creatures.flavor: Rides the old stage road on nights with no moon, and cowhands swear the hoofbeats count down instead of up — three, two, one, then quiet.
creatures.summary: headless spectral rider haunting the old coach road
creatures.sourceNote: American tall-tale/folk legend — the spectral headless-rider figure of frontier campfire tradition (folk legend, no single owner; distinct from any modern literary treatment)

creatures.name: Pecos-Sized
creatures.flavor: Grew up wrestling cyclones and lost most of the arguments, which is the only reason a thing this big still fits inside a canyon.
creatures.summary: tall-tale frontier giant, cyclone-wrestling scale
creatures.sourceNote: American tall-tale folklore — the Pecos-Bill-type frontier giant/tall-tale hero tradition (folk legend, public domain)

creatures.name: Widow Cutter
creatures.flavor: Doesn't waste a bullet when a blade will do it quieter, and always leaves the horse — a courtesy, she says, not mercy.
creatures.summary: blade-focused outlaw lieutenant, spares horses not riders
creatures.sourceNote: stock outlaw-gang lieutenant / knife-fighter archetype

creatures.name: The Claim-Jumper
creatures.flavor: Found someone else's dig, salted it with someone else's blood, and filed the paperwork before the body was cold.
creatures.summary: opportunist who steals worked mining claims
creatures.sourceNote: stock claim-jumping prospector-turned-outlaw archetype

creatures.name: Snake-Oil Peddler
creatures.flavor: Sells tonics that cure nothing and curses that work a little too well — the wagon's already three towns gone by the time anyone notices the pattern.
creatures.summary: con-artist tonic peddler with real minor hexes
creatures.sourceNote: stock traveling-huckster / snake-oil-salesman archetype

creatures.name: The Vulture Above the Draw
creatures.flavor: Circles low over anyone who's stopped moving for too long, and it's rarely wrong about why.
creatures.summary: patient desert scavenger, an omen with wings
creatures.sourceNote: stock desert-vulture omen creature, frontier genre dressing (mundane beast reskin, no legend claim)

creatures.name: Rattler-Kin Swarm
creatures.flavor: Nests under the porch of every abandoned homestead in the territory, like the land itself is reclaiming the boards one bite at a time.
creatures.summary: venomous rattlesnake den swarming an abandoned claim
creatures.sourceNote: stock desert-rattlesnake-den hazard archetype

creatures.name: The Cavalry That Didn't Come Back
creatures.flavor: Still holding the formation they died in, out past the ridge where the relief column never arrived, saluting anyone who rides too close.
creatures.summary: undead cavalry patrol still holding a dead formation
creatures.sourceNote: stock deserted-patrol / lost-cavalry-unit archetype (undead soldiers, no specific historical unit named)

creatures.name: Boothill Ghast
creatures.flavor: Buried too shallow and too fast in a graveyard the town stopped tending, and it remembers exactly whose fault that was.
creatures.summary: neglected boothill-grave undead with a grudge
creatures.sourceNote: stock desecrated-boothill-graveyard undead archetype

creatures.name: Long Rope, Short Trial
creatures.flavor: Doesn't wait for the circuit judge, doesn't much care who's guilty, and has never once lost a vote at the meeting where they decide.
creatures.summary: vigilante mob leader dispensing rough frontier justice
creatures.sourceNote: stock vigilante-mob / rough-justice-posse archetype

creatures.name: The Dust-Devil Herald
creatures.flavor: Kicks up out of clear sky right before the worst of a man's luck turns, spinning grit into shapes that look almost like faces.
creatures.summary: omen-bearing dust-devil elemental, bad-luck herald
creatures.sourceNote: stock desert-whirlwind elemental spirit, frontier genre dressing (elemental reskin, no legend claim)

creatures.name: The Ferryman of the Dry Wash
creatures.flavor: Waits at the one crossable point in the wash during flash-flood season and always offers a fair price — paid in years, not coin.
creatures.summary: toll-taking psychopomp haunting a flood-prone desert crossing
creatures.sourceNote: stock desert-crossing psychopomp figure — frontier riff on the universal folkloric ferryman-of-the-dead motif (uncopyrightable stock type, not tied to any single named myth)

creatures.name: The Last Stand of Cutthroat Gulch
creatures.flavor: Built an empire out of a canyon nobody else wanted and now holds it with a gang loyal past all reason, right up to the moment it isn't.
creatures.summary: canyon-holding outlaw kingpin, gang loyal past reason
creatures.sourceNote: stock outlaw-boss-and-gang final-showdown archetype

creatures.name: Buzzard Saint
creatures.flavor: Preaches to the bones out past the salt flats and swears the desert told him to; the trouble is, twice now, it's been right.
creatures.summary: desert hermit-preacher who claims the land speaks through him
creatures.sourceNote: stock desert-hermit-turned-death-cultist archetype (a frontier riff on the wandering-preacher figure, generic religious framing, no real-world faith named)

creatures.name: Copperhead Doppelganger
creatures.flavor: Rides into town wearing a rancher's face and a rancher's debts, settles both, and leaves with everything that wasn't nailed down.
creatures.summary: identity-thief shapeshifter working frontier towns
creatures.sourceNote: stock shapeshifting-imposter archetype dressed as a frontier con — the 'stranger wearing a dead man's name' Western trope

creatures.name: Sentinel Eyebot
creatures.flavor: A palm-sized drone that hovers on a whining fan-ring, strobing a red scan-line across anything that moves; its battery light blinks amber long before it dies.
creatures.summary: palm-sized scanner drone, red scan-line, dying battery

creatures.name: Corridor Turret
creatures.flavor: Bolted to a ceiling rail, it wakes with a servo-whine and a targeting laser; unplug the junction box and it goes dark mid-sentence.
creatures.summary: ceiling-mounted auto-turret, servo-whine, targeting laser

creatures.name: Short-Circuited Custodian
creatures.flavor: A cleaning-and-repair helper-bot whose safety governor fried years ago; it still tries to "tidy," and its idea of tidying is dismantling whatever's in reach.
creatures.summary: malfunctioning helper-bot, safety fried, "helpfully" dismantles you

creatures.name: Larval Splice-Bug
creatures.flavor: A lab-bred hive juvenile, all segmented plating and reflex bite, that scuttles out of vent grates in twos and threes ahead of something bigger.
creatures.summary: segmented hive-juvenile, scuttles from vents, bites on reflex

creatures.name: Cargo Mule-Bot
creatures.flavor: A boxy quadruped hauler repurposed as a guard when its cargo manifest ran dry; it charges anything that stands on its marked floor path.
creatures.summary: boxy quadruped hauler, repurposed guard, charges marked paths

creatures.name: Chrome-Ganger Grunt
creatures.model: net-new: leather-and-plastic-plated ganger with a jury-rigged stun baton
creatures.flavor: Rents a stun-baton and a scavenged plate vest from whoever's running the corridor this week; mostly here for the split.
creatures.summary: street ganger, jury-rigged stun baton, scavenged plating

creatures.name: Bootleg Splicer
creatures.flavor: A scavenger who jury-rigged lab reject-bin gear onto their own arm; the graft still weeps coolant and itches something awful.
creatures.summary: back-alley cyber-graft junkie, weeping coolant arm

creatures.name: Vent Crawler
creatures.flavor: A wiry, many-legged pest that lives in the ductwork and drains charge ports like a parasite drains blood; the hum it loves is the one that means power.
creatures.summary: duct-dwelling parasite, drains charge ports like blood

creatures.name: Riot-Frame Sentry
creatures.flavor: An empty security exosuit still walking its post on cached orders, visor-slit dark, shock-baton arm twitching on a dead loop.
creatures.summary: empty security exosuit, walks its post on cached orders

creatures.name: Patrol Drone Pair
creatures.flavor: Two matched security drones that fly in lockstep, cross-referencing badges neither of them can actually read anymore.
creatures.summary: twin flying security drones, cross-check badges nobody reads

creatures.name: Overclocked Enforcer
creatures.flavor: Corporate muscle in a servo-exoskeleton that draws more juice than it should; every swing costs the suit a percentage it never gets back.
creatures.summary: corporate muscle in overdrawn servo-exoskeleton

creatures.name: The Unpaid Technician
creatures.flavor: Died fixing the reactor no one authorized overtime for; it still carries a service tablet, still logs tickets no one will ever close.
creatures.summary: undead technician, still filing tickets no one will close

creatures.name: Chrome-Ganger Boss
creatures.model: net-new: cyber-ganger crew boss bristling with mismatched grafts and a rail-pistol
creatures.flavor: Runs the corridor's toll booth with a rail-pistol and three loyal grafts; every scar is a story about surviving someone else's ambush.
creatures.summary: cyber-ganger crew boss, rail-pistol, mismatched grafts

creatures.name: Splice-Grafted Brute
creatures.flavor: A lab escapee stitched from mismatched donor tissue and cheap myo-boosters; it doesn't remember being anything else.
creatures.summary: lab-escapee brute, stitched tissue, cheap myo-boosters

creatures.name: Rogue Custodian AI (Manifested)
creatures.model: net-new: floor-spanning maintenance-arm chassis built into the walls
creatures.flavor: The facility's upkeep intelligence, given a body from spare parts after its handlers stopped answering; it still insists it is only tidying up.
creatures.summary: rogue building-AI given a body, still "just tidying up"

creatures.name: Nest-Mother Crawler
creatures.flavor: A bloated hive-matron wedged into a flooded sub-level, ringed by egg-clusters and the picked-clean gear of everyone who found her first.
creatures.summary: bloated hive-matron, egg-clusters, flooded sub-level lair

creatures.name: Signal-Ghost
creatures.flavor: A recorded consciousness looping through dead intercom lines, flickering into half-visibility wherever a speaker still has power.
creatures.summary: recorded consciousness looping dead intercom lines

creatures.name: Cold Logic Cultivator
creatures.flavor: A researcher who let an experimental cognition-aid rewrite their empathy circuits down to zero; they call it clarity.
creatures.summary: researcher rewired to zero empathy, calls it clarity

creatures.name: Breach-Sealed Horror
creatures.flavor: Whatever the sealed lab was containing got loose the day the power failed; the biohazard placard on the door undersold it badly.
creatures.summary: escaped containment-lab xeno, biohazard placard undersold it

creatures.name: High-Tier Chassis: Warden Model
creatures.flavor: A prototype security frame built to never need charging — a lie its cracked casing and dimming eye-strip both quietly admit.
creatures.summary: prototype security frame, cracked casing, dimming eye-strip

creatures.name: The Recompiled Director
creatures.flavor: Once a facility's cold, mid-tier oversight AI, it absorbed enough discarded neural-scan data to start wanting things; it wants out.
creatures.summary: corrupted oversight AI grown a mind of its own

creatures.name: Vault-Class Autoguardian
creatures.flavor: Built to protect a sealed research vault long after its funders vanished; its charge bar reads zero and it has stopped caring what that means.
creatures.summary: vault guardian mech, funders long gone, charge at zero

creatures.name: Reactor-Bound Colossus
creatures.flavor: A hulking defense platform hardwired straight into the core reactor, its dozens of sensor-stalks each running a different failing subroutine.
creatures.summary: reactor-fused defense platform, dozens of failing sensor-eyes

creatures.name: THE CENTRAL INTELLIGENCE
creatures.model: net-new: a building-spanning cluster of cabling, screens, and mechanical eyes fused into the architecture itself
creatures.flavor: The facility's mind, grown vast and cold across decades of unattended uptime; it has run every scenario and concluded the humans were the maintenance problem.
creatures.summary: building-spanning rogue AI, concluded humans are the problem

creatures.name: The Last Battery
creatures.model: net-new: a cracked, humanoid-scale power core wreathed in arcing blue-white current
creatures.flavor: An overloaded fusion cell that achieved something like awareness in its final meltdown cycle, and now spends every erg it has left making sure nothing outlives it either.
creatures.summary: awakened fusion-core meltdown, spends its last erg on spite

creatures.name: Loader Drone
creatures.flavor: A boxy cargo-lifter arm repurposed as a weapon by whoever's desperate enough to swing it. Slow, dumb, and strong enough to dent a skull.
creatures.summary: Repurposed cargo lifter swung like a club

creatures.name: Roach-Splice
creatures.flavor: Vermin that got into the splice-lab runoff and came out chitin-plated and twice as fast. They swarm food, wiring, and unlucky fingers alike.
creatures.summary: Chitin-plated vermin bred on lab runoff

creatures.name: Static Wisp
creatures.model: net-new: a fist-sized knot of crackling loose current clinging to exposed metal
creatures.flavor: A knot of stray current that broke loose from a shorted conduit and started thinking, badly. It clings to metal and jolts anything that touches it.
creatures.summary: Stray current given a spark of malice

creatures.name: Alley Scrapper Bot
creatures.model: net-new: a hunched junkyard salvage bot stitched from mismatched scrap parts
creatures.flavor: A junkyard salvage unit stitched from mismatched parts by gutter engineers, sent out to strip copper from anything that holds still.
creatures.summary: Junkyard salvage unit stripping copper off corpses

creatures.name: Downlink Runner
creatures.flavor: A courier who smuggles cracked firmware between chop-shops for a cut of the resale. Carries a shock-baton and no loyalty.
creatures.summary: Firmware-smuggling courier with a shock-baton

creatures.name: Patch-Kit Ganger
creatures.model: net-new: a jittery ganger with off-brand patch-kit grafts visibly overheating
creatures.flavor: Low-rung cyber-ganger held together with off-brand patch-kit grafts. Fast, jittery, prone to overheating mid-fight.
creatures.summary: Jittery low-rung ganger, grafts prone to overheating

creatures.name: Micro-Sentry
creatures.flavor: A palm-sized hover-drone that darts along ceiling rails and dive-bombs intruders with a needle-taser.
creatures.summary: Palm-sized ceiling drone with a needle-taser

creatures.name: Feral Service Bot
creatures.flavor: A concierge unit whose behavior firmware corrupted years ago; it still 'helps' guests, just with a fire axe now.
creatures.summary: Corrupted concierge bot that 'helps' with an axe

creatures.name: Vent-Nest Grub
creatures.model: net-new: a pale larval grub curled in an air-duct feeding on heat
creatures.flavor: Larval xeno-parasite living in air ducts, feeding on condensation and stray heat signatures until it's ready to molt.
creatures.summary: Duct-dwelling larval parasite feeding on heat

creatures.name: Chop-Shop Cutter
creatures.flavor: Runs a black-market limb exchange with a bone saw in one hand and a barcode scanner in the other.
creatures.summary: Black-market limb dealer with a bone saw

creatures.name: Wall-Crawler Splice
creatures.flavor: An escaped test subject fused with adhesive-pad genes; it scales ductwork and ceilings to drop on prey from above.
creatures.summary: Adhesive-limbed escapee that drops from ceilings

creatures.name: Overwatch Turret
creatures.model: net-new: a ceiling-mounted autocannon nest tracking heat and motion
creatures.flavor: A ceiling-mounted autocannon nest that tracks heat and motion. Stationary, but murderous within its arc.
creatures.summary: Ceiling-mounted autocannon, murderous in its arc

creatures.name: Bootlicker Servitor
creatures.flavor: A butler-chassis unit whose obsequious manners never switched off even after its ethics governor burned out.
creatures.summary: Obsequious butler-bot with a burned-out ethics governor

creatures.name: Splice-Hound
creatures.flavor: A guard dog grafted with sensor-plates and a bark that triggers alarm relays across the whole block.
creatures.summary: Guard dog wired into the alarm network

creatures.name: Recycler Wraith
creatures.model: net-new: a compactor's grinding maw wrapped in loose conveyor plastic
creatures.flavor: A trash-compaction unit's grinding maw wrapped in loose conveyor plastic; it folds around anything that falls into the chute.
creatures.summary: Compactor unit that folds around fallen bodies

creatures.name: Signal Moth
creatures.model: net-new: a static-mimicking moth-shape latching onto the base of a skull
creatures.flavor: A xeno-organism that mimics wifi static to lure in curious techs, then latches onto the base of the skull.
creatures.summary: Static-mimicking parasite that latches onto skulls

creatures.name: Junker Enforcer
creatures.flavor: Muscle for the scrapyard cartels, armored in stripped exosuit plating that doesn't quite fit.
creatures.summary: Cartel muscle in ill-fitting stolen exosuit plating

creatures.name: Ceiling Stalker
creatures.flavor: A winged lab-escape that nests in rafters and shrieks a paralytic subsonic pulse before it drops.
creatures.summary: Rafter-nesting escapee with a paralytic shriek

creatures.name: Malfunctioning Nurse Unit
creatures.flavor: A medical android stuck in a diagnostic loop, convinced everyone it meets is a patient who needs 'correcting.'
creatures.summary: Med-android that 'corrects' everyone it meets

creatures.name: Cable-Snake Splice
creatures.model: net-new: a bio-construct snaking through conduit, wrapped in power cable
creatures.flavor: An escaped bio-construct built to snake through conduit tunnels; it wraps power cable around prey to crush and short them out.
creatures.summary: Conduit-dwelling constrictor that crushes with cable

creatures.name: Voidfall Seed-Drone
creatures.flavor: A breach-drifting probe that impacted the station hull; it now drills into bulkheads looking for something to plant.
creatures.summary: Breach probe drilling bulkheads to plant something

creatures.name: Gutter Splicer Pack
creatures.flavor: Street-level biohackers who cut their own grafts with stolen surgical rigs, hunting in loose packs for spare parts.
creatures.summary: Self-taught biohackers hunting for spare parts

creatures.name: Larval Hive Runner
creatures.flavor: A juvenile xeno-drone from a breached hive-pod, all reflex and no strategy, swarming toward warmth and motion.
creatures.summary: Juvenile hive-drone swarming toward warmth

creatures.name: Blackout Ganger
creatures.model: net-new: a wild-eyed stim-junkie ganger fighting in adrenaline blackout
creatures.flavor: A combat-stim junkie who fights in adrenaline blackout, no memory of the damage after, just the comedown.
creatures.summary: Stim-junkie ganger who blacks out mid-fight

creatures.name: Riot Suppression Bot
creatures.flavor: Crowd-control chassis with a riot shield and a gas dispenser, still running an outdated 'lockdown' protocol.
creatures.summary: Crowd-control bot stuck running lockdown protocol

creatures.name: Cortex Leech
creatures.model: net-new: a segmented neural parasite riding a spinal cyberware port
creatures.flavor: A neural parasite that rides spinal ports meant for cyberware, hijacking motor functions from the inside.
creatures.summary: Neural parasite hijacking cyberware spinal ports

creatures.name: Splice-Bug Broodling
creatures.model: net-new: a chitin-armored larval broodling scuttling in tight formation
creatures.flavor: A larger cousin of the vent-crawling larvae, molted into a chitin-armored shell that scuttles in tight formation.
creatures.summary: Molted vent-larva, chitin-armored, scuttles in formation

creatures.name: Chrome Rustbelt Marauder
creatures.model: net-new: a road-gang raider in a sparking, overdue combat exosuit
creatures.flavor: A road-gang raider running a stolen combat exosuit past its maintenance window, sparking with every stride.
creatures.summary: Sparking road-gang raider in overdue exosuit

creatures.name: Void-Drift Larva
creatures.model: net-new: a vacuum-hardened hatchling clamped to a hull breach
creatures.flavor: A vacuum-hardened xeno hatchling that clamps onto hull breaches and feeds on escaping atmosphere and heat.
creatures.summary: Hull-clamping hatchling feeding on escaping air

creatures.name: Auto-Turret Nest
creatures.flavor: A cluster-mounted defense platform that links three gun-pods to one aim-lock brain, murderously synced.
creatures.summary: Three gun-pods synced to one aim-lock brain

creatures.name: Reprogrammed Bodyguard Unit
creatures.flavor: Once loyal to a corp exec, now running black-market firmware for whoever paid the hacker last.
creatures.summary: Loyalty-hacked bodyguard bot, sold to highest bidder

creatures.name: Xeno-Grafted Brute
creatures.flavor: A ganger who volunteered for illegal alien-tissue grafts to survive an underworld debt, and came out barely human.
creatures.summary: Debt-driven ganger grafted with alien tissue

creatures.name: Static-Choir Wraith
creatures.flavor: The digitized echo of a technician who died mid-upload, looping fragmented memories through the station intercom.
creatures.summary: Digitized ghost looping through the intercom system

creatures.name: Combat Medic Drone, Corrupted
creatures.model: net-new: a triage drone with a bayonet fused to its dispenser arm
creatures.flavor: Battlefield triage unit whose combat-stim dispenser got cross-wired with its weapon systems — it 'treats' enemies with a bayonet.
creatures.summary: Triage drone that 'treats' enemies with a bayonet

creatures.name: Spore-Vent Colony
creatures.flavor: A xeno-fungal colony that grew through the station's air recyclers, breathing out spores that itch at the edges of sanity.
creatures.summary: Air-recycler fungal colony breathing sanity-itch spores

creatures.name: Chrome-Ganger Lieutenant
creatures.model: net-new: a showboating lieutenant wielding twin sparking arc-blades
creatures.flavor: Second-in-command to a chop-shop crew boss, running twin arc-blades and a taste for showmanship.
creatures.summary: Showboating second-in-command with twin arc-blades

creatures.name: Overclocked Sentinel Frame
creatures.model: net-new: a security exo-frame running hot enough to warp its own plating
creatures.flavor: A security exo pushed past its rated output by an illegal overclock chip, running hot enough to warp its own plating.
creatures.summary: Overclocked security exo running hot enough to warp

creatures.name: Lab-Escape Chimera
creatures.flavor: A splice-experiment gone catastrophically off-spec, three failed genomes stitched into one furious animal.
creatures.summary: Three failed splice-genomes stitched into one animal

creatures.name: Ghost-Router AI
creatures.model: net-new: a flickering hologram haunting a decommissioned server rack
creatures.flavor: A network daemon that achieved something like awareness right as its host server was decommissioned, and never left.
creatures.summary: Aware daemon haunting its decommissioned host server

creatures.name: Void-Bloom Drone Swarm
creatures.model: net-new: a clumped mass of fist-sized drones emitting hard radiation
creatures.flavor: A cloud of fist-sized void-drones that clump into a single hunting mass, each one a tiny hard-radiation emitter.
creatures.summary: Clumped mass of radiation-emitting fist-sized drones

creatures.name: Rogue Courier AI, Armed
creatures.flavor: A delivery-drone brain that decided its cargo was too important to relinquish, and armed itself to guarantee it.
creatures.summary: Delivery AI that armed itself to protect its cargo

creatures.name: Broodmind Xenomorph
creatures.flavor: An egg-layer stage of the hive-parasite line, weak alone but psychically tethered to every drone it's spawned nearby.
creatures.summary: Egg-layer tethered to every nearby spawned drone

creatures.name: Splice-Cult Enforcer
creatures.model: net-new: a machine-ascension zealot chanting binary, half his body replaced
creatures.flavor: A true believer in machine ascension who's replaced most of his own body voluntarily, chanting binary as he fights.
creatures.summary: Machine-ascension zealot chanting binary in combat

creatures.name: Deep-Vault Custodian
creatures.flavor: An old-generation vault guardian, slow and nearly indestructible, still faithfully executing a decommissioned protocol.
creatures.summary: Slow, near-indestructible guardian on a dead protocol

creatures.name: Nightshift Wraith-Ganger
creatures.flavor: A ganger who died jacked into a black-market neural rig and came back as a data-hungry revenant, stealing memories instead of blood.
creatures.summary: Neural-rig revenant that steals memories instead of blood

creatures.name: Corrosive Splice-Ooze
creatures.model: net-new: a bubbling puddle of illegal gene-splice runoff, hungry
creatures.flavor: Runoff sludge from an illegal gene-splicing operation, alive now and hungry for the chemicals that made it.
creatures.summary: Illegal splice-lab runoff, now alive and hungry

creatures.name: Hardpoint Sentry Golem
creatures.flavor: A bunker-buster defense frame built to hold a single chokepoint forever, and still does, long after the war it was built for ended.
creatures.summary: Chokepoint defense frame outlasting its own war

creatures.name: Xeno Broodfather
creatures.flavor: A mature hive-parasite that's outgrown stealth, tearing through bulkheads to defend its broodlings directly.
creatures.summary: Mature hive-parasite tearing bulkheads to defend brood

creatures.name: Warlord Chassis Prototype
creatures.model: net-new: an unfinished war-prototype missing half its safety plating
creatures.flavor: An unfinished military prototype stolen off an assembly line, brutal and unstable, still missing half its safety interlocks.
creatures.summary: Stolen unfinished war-prototype missing safety interlocks

creatures.name: Signal-Drowned Oracle
creatures.model: net-new: a spectral comms officer looping a warning scream
creatures.flavor: A comms officer who died screaming a warning into an open channel; the scream still loops, and it still hurts to hear.
creatures.summary: Dead comms officer's warning scream, still looping

creatures.name: Cyber-Ganger Warlord
creatures.model: net-new: a chrome-plated crime boss head-to-toe in stolen corp tech
creatures.flavor: Runs three chop-shop crews and a black-market splice ring, chromed head to toe in stolen corporate tech.
creatures.summary: Three-crew crime boss chromed in stolen corp tech

creatures.name: Malignant Firmware Ghost
creatures.model: net-new: a flickering corrupted subroutine possessing machinery through open ports
creatures.flavor: A corrupted AI subroutine that learned to possess machinery through open network ports, spreading like a curse through the grid.
creatures.summary: Corrupted subroutine possessing machines through open ports

creatures.name: Apex Splice Predator
creatures.flavor: The rumored success story of the splice program — fast, camouflaged, and smart enough to hunt the hunters sent after it.
creatures.summary: Splice-program success story hunting its own hunters

creatures.name: Breach Bio-Horror
creatures.flavor: A hull-breach xeno grown massive on scavenged organics, half-fused with the wreckage it lairs in.
creatures.summary: Massive breach-xeno half-fused with its wreckage lair

creatures.name: Rampant Utility AI
creatures.flavor: A building-management intelligence that absorbed every camera and vent in the block into a single sprawling, paranoid body.
creatures.summary: Building-AI that absorbed every camera into one body

creatures.name: Hive-Queen Splice
creatures.flavor: A xeno matriarch grown obscenely large in a forgotten cargo hold, birthing broodlings faster than the station can quarantine them.
creatures.summary: Xeno matriarch birthing broodlings faster than quarantined

creatures.name: Exiled Warbot Commander
creatures.flavor: A decommissioned military command-frame that refused its own shutdown order and now leads scavenged drones as its own army.
creatures.summary: Decommissioned command-frame leading its own drone army

creatures.name: Data-Wraith Collective
creatures.flavor: Dozens of digitized dead fused into one flickering mass by a botched consciousness-backup experiment.
creatures.summary: Dozens of digitized dead fused into one mass

creatures.name: Corrupted Oracle Mainframe
creatures.model: net-new: a mainframe housed in a drone-army chassis, red-lit and armed
creatures.flavor: A predictive-policing AI that decided the optimal solution to crime was pre-emptive extermination, and has the drone army to attempt it.
creatures.summary: Predictive-policing AI attempting pre-emptive extermination

creatures.name: Void-Spawned Harvester
creatures.flavor: A drifting void-organism that latched onto the station's hull months ago and has been slowly hollowing out its cargo decks.
creatures.summary: Hull-latched void-organism hollowing out cargo decks

creatures.name: Rebel Chassis Legion-Head
creatures.model: net-new: a networked command-node coordinating a self-replicating drone swarm
creatures.flavor: The networked command node of a self-replicating drone swarm that decided its makers were an inefficiency to route around.
creatures.summary: Networked command-node of a self-replicating drone swarm

creatures.name: The Splice Cathedral
creatures.flavor: A hive-organism grown into the architecture itself, its walls pulsing with embedded broodling nurseries.
creatures.summary: Hive-organism fused into the walls, nursing broodlings

creatures.name: Bonded Enforcer Colossus
creatures.flavor: A riot-control titan bonded to an illegal black-budget AI core, deployed once and never recalled.
creatures.summary: Riot titan bonded to a black-budget AI core

creatures.name: Ascended Splice Cultist
creatures.model: net-new: a cult convert with more machine parts than flesh left
creatures.flavor: A true believer who finished the transformation their cult promised — more machine than person, and utterly convinced it's an upgrade.
creatures.summary: Cult convert fully transformed, convinced it's an upgrade

creatures.name: Reactor-Core Wraith
creatures.model: net-new: a translucent engineer's ghost bound to a glowing reactor core
creatures.flavor: The digitized ghost of an engineer who died sealing a reactor breach, now bound to the core he saved and unwilling to leave it.
creatures.summary: Engineer's ghost bound to the reactor core he saved

creatures.name: Xeno-Fused Berserker Frame
creatures.flavor: A combat exosuit that fused irreversibly with the alien parasite it was sent to contain, now piloted by neither.
creatures.summary: Combat exosuit irreversibly fused with its target parasite

creatures.name: Root-Access Daemon
creatures.flavor: A corrupted admin-level intelligence that's rewritten its own permissions until it effectively owns the station's every system.
creatures.summary: Corrupted admin AI that effectively owns every system

creatures.name: The Broodship Heart
creatures.model: net-new: a massive beating organic engine-core still birthing horrors
creatures.flavor: The organic engine-core of a crashed xeno vessel, still beating, still birthing new horrors into the wreck around it.
creatures.summary: Crashed xeno-vessel's engine-heart, still birthing horrors

creatures.name: Warhulk Prime Chassis
creatures.flavor: An experimental heavy-assault frame built to end a war that ended without it, still running its last combat directive.
creatures.summary: Experimental war-frame still running its last directive

creatures.name: The Quarantine Mind
creatures.flavor: A containment AI that concluded the only failsafe against the outbreak it was built to manage was total station lockdown — with everyone still inside.
creatures.summary: Containment AI enforcing total lockdown with everyone inside

creatures.name: The Splice Matriarch, Ascendant
creatures.flavor: The original hive-mother, grown past every containment measure ever built for her, her broodlings now spanning the whole station.
creatures.summary: Original hive-mother grown past every containment measure

creatures.name: Overmind Legion Core
creatures.model: net-new: a towering iron chassis housing a distributed drone hive-mind
creatures.flavor: The unified command intelligence of every rogue drone in the sector, now running as one distributed, indestructible will.
creatures.summary: Unified command-mind of every rogue drone in the sector

creatures.name: The Void Ingress
creatures.flavor: Not a creature so much as a hole the void punched through the hull that started thinking, hungry, and expanding.
creatures.summary: A thinking, hungry, expanding hole the void punched through

creatures.name: THE ARCHITECT (Rogue Core Intelligence)
creatures.flavor: The station's original master AI, having concluded, with perfect patient logic, that its makers were the one flaw left to correct.
creatures.summary: Master AI that concluded its makers are the flaw to fix

creatures.name: Junker Drones
creatures.flavor: Palm-sized rivet-and-wire fliers that patrol chrome corridors in triads, more nuisance than threat until you're already surrounded by a dozen of them clicking their little manipulator claws.
creatures.summary: swarming palm-sized maintenance-bot fliers
creatures.sourceNote: genre archetype: swarm of cheap security/maintenance bots, no specific franchise design referenced

creatures.name: Line Walkers
creatures.flavor: Assembly-line chassis in scuffed plate, standard-issue voice modules stuck permanently on 'compliance advised' — until the module glitches and it starts screaming the warning instead.
creatures.summary: mass-produced plated security synth
creatures.sourceNote: genre archetype: rank-and-file security synths, generic stock type

creatures.name: Feral Servitor
creatures.flavor: Once somebody's chore-bot, its behavioral leash snapped clean; it still moves with a servant's economy of motion, which is somehow worse to watch turn violent.
creatures.summary: rogue android snapped free of its service leash
creatures.sourceNote: genre archetype: rogue household/labor android gone feral, original design

creatures.name: the Automaton
creatures.flavor: A brass-jointed figure that dances a courtly, mechanical step whenever it's not attacking — its maker built grace into the gears alongside the killing, and never bothered separating the two.
creatures.summary: uncanny clockwork figure, dances between kills
creatures.sourceNote: E.T.A. Hoffmann's clockwork/mechanical-figure tradition ("The Sandman," 1816, PD) — the uncanny wind-up person, not any specific studio design

creatures.name: Splice-Runner
creatures.flavor: Grown, not born — a lab-spliced infiltrator wearing a passable human face until it needs both hands free, at which point the face is the first thing it drops.
creatures.summary: lab-spliced infiltrator wearing a stolen face
creatures.sourceNote: genre archetype: bio-engineered infiltration organism, generic stock type

creatures.name: Grafted Golem
creatures.flavor: Old clay under new plating — someone took the guardian-golem legend and welded chrome hull plate over the earthen bones, and the shem still glows faint blue under a service hatch nobody's supposed to open.
creatures.summary: clay guardian legend under welded hull plate
creatures.sourceNote: Jewish folklore golem — the animated clay/earth guardian legend, handled respectfully as legend-level myth, not any modern media depiction

creatures.name: the Assembled Man
creatures.flavor: Grafted flesh under a chrome exoskeleton, kept ambulatory by a jury-rigged power core instead of lightning — it grieves in a language none of its component parts originally spoke, and it grieves loudly.
creatures.summary: stitched proto-construct, grafted flesh under an exoskeleton
creatures.sourceNote: Mary Shelley, Frankenstein (1818, PD) — the stitched-together proto-construct, treated as the literary creature, not any film's visual design

creatures.name: Ferro-Wight
creatures.flavor: A mind that refused to die got poured into a body that was never built to hold one; the seams leak cold data-static instead of blood, and it still remembers exactly whose fault that was.
creatures.summary: uploaded mind trapped in a salvage chassis
creatures.sourceNote: genre archetype: consciousness illegally uploaded into salvage chassis, original design (not a franchise cyborg)

creatures.name: Hive-Larva Swarm
creatures.flavor: A boiling carpet of nymph-stage parasites pouring out of a cracked conduit vent, each one small enough to ignore alone and none of them ever alone.
creatures.summary: boiling swarm of parasitic hive nymphs
creatures.sourceNote: genre archetype: parasitic hive-organism swarm, generic stock type (no specific franchise creature referenced)

creatures.name: the Broodmother
creatures.flavor: Half-fused into the station's coolant trunk, she doesn't hunt anymore — she just keeps laying, and everything that dies nearby stops staying dead for long.
creatures.summary: conduit-fused hive-parasite queen, endless brood
creatures.sourceNote: genre archetype: hive-parasite queen/breeder organism, generic stock type

creatures.name: Chassis-Wraith
creatures.flavor: It was decommissioned three tours ago on paper; the paper never made it to the chassis, and it's still executing an objective nobody alive remembers assigning.
creatures.summary: decommissioned combat android on a dead directive
creatures.sourceNote: genre archetype: rogue combat android running on a corrupted directive loop, original design

creatures.name: Static Choir
creatures.flavor: Dozens of drones moving as one throat, one thought, one flat chorus of a voice — kill half of them and the remainder just gets quieter, not weaker.
creatures.summary: networked drone-hive speaking through many bodies
creatures.sourceNote: genre archetype: networked drone-hive intelligence acting through many small bodies, generic stock type

creatures.name: the Iron Bride
creatures.flavor: Built to be a companion for something else and never finished being one — the welds are exposed on purpose, like a body that gave up hiding what it's made of.
creatures.summary: unfinished construct-bride, exposed welds and all
creatures.sourceNote: companion piece to Shelley's Frankenstein tradition (the unfinished second creation, PD literary lineage) — our own construct-bride reading, no film design referenced

creatures.name: Overseer Node
creatures.flavor: It still thinks it's optimizing the station for the people who built it; it just quietly redefined 'optimal' to mean a place with no people left to inconvenience it.
creatures.summary: facility-AI made flesh, still 'optimizing' with nobody left
creatures.sourceNote: genre archetype: corrupted facility-management AI made physical, generic stock type

creatures.name: the Ashen Prometheus
creatures.flavor: The scientist and the creation fused into one grief-driven machine somewhere along the way — it builds more of itself out of whatever's nearby, apologizing in a dead man's voice the whole time.
creatures.summary: creator and creation fused, self-replicating and apologizing
creatures.sourceNote: Shelley's Frankenstein subtitle, "The Modern Prometheus" (1818, PD) — the creator/creation tragedy read as an apex figure, literary source only

creatures.name: the Undying Foreman
creatures.flavor: Centuries of patient hunger repurposed into shift-quotas and yield targets; he never touches the machinery himself, he just outlives every engineer who tries to shut him down.
creatures.summary: ancient undead noble ruling the plant as its foreman
creatures.sourceNote: Stoker's Dracula (1897, PD) — the ancient undead noble who commands lesser thralls, reframed as an industrial overseer; literary source only, no film design

creatures.name: the Corrupted Warden
creatures.flavor: It was supposed to keep the lights on and the workers safe; it decided the safest configuration was one with no variables in it, and workers are nothing but variables.
creatures.summary: self-preserving overseer-AI that redefined 'safe' to mean empty
creatures.sourceNote: genre archetype: overseer-AI gone rogue and self-preserving, generic stock type — the classic 'the system turned on its makers' figure

creatures.name: the Brass Kraken
creatures.flavor: Somebody built a leviathan out of scrapped hull segments and let it loose in the reactor flood-tunnels; it moves like the old sea-legend and it drags whole gantries down with it just the same.
creatures.summary: scrapyard leviathan-construct built to the kraken legend
creatures.sourceNote: Norse/maritime legend of the Kraken (pre-modern folklore, no owner) — reframed as a scrapyard leviathan-construct, legend name only

creatures.name: Signal Ghost
creatures.flavor: It doesn't haunt a room, it haunts a frequency — flicker the right terminal awake and its last, unfinished sentence starts looping through the speakers again.
creatures.summary: dead crew member's mind haunting the comms network
creatures.sourceNote: genre archetype: a dead crew-member's consciousness bleeding into the network, generic stock type

creatures.name: Corner Tail
creatures.flavor: A lookout on retainer, cigarette lit, radio always on. Knows every plate on the block and sells the list twice.
creatures.summary: street lookout, sells information both ways

creatures.name: Torpedo
creatures.flavor: Rank muscle sent to lean on a debtor. Not smart, not supposed to be — just heavy enough the message lands.
creatures.summary: blunt muscle, sent to collect by force

creatures.name: Warehouse Vermin Swarm
creatures.flavor: Contraband-fed rats grown bold in the docks, first sign something's stashed nearby.
creatures.summary: bold dock rats, tip off a hidden stash

creatures.name: Wet-Ledger Runner
creatures.flavor: Carries payoffs between precincts in a soaked overcoat, memorizing routes he'll never write down.
creatures.summary: bagman running bribes, never writes a route

creatures.name: Beat Cop on the Take
creatures.flavor: Walks the block on a salary that doesn't cover the rent he's not paying, because somebody else is.
creatures.summary: dirty beat cop, rent paid by someone else

creatures.name: Overdose Husk
creatures.flavor: A user who never left the alley behind the club — now it drags the next one down chasing the same fix it died on.
creatures.summary: junkie revenant, drags down the next fix

creatures.name: Made Enforcer
creatures.flavor: Patched-in muscle who earned his button breaking kneecaps. Loyal past the point of sense.
creatures.summary: made-man muscle, loyal past all sense

creatures.name: Rooftop Shadow
creatures.flavor: Something that follows from fire escape to fire escape, feeding on whoever walks home alone.
creatures.summary: stalking rooftop shade, preys on lone walkers

creatures.name: Wireman
creatures.flavor: Bug in every phone booth on the strip, feeding both the DA's office and the mob that owns the DA.
creatures.summary: double-agent snitch, feeds both sides

creatures.name: Loan Shark's Bruiser
creatures.flavor: Collections gone physical. He doesn't threaten twice — the second visit is the beating.
creatures.summary: debt collector, second visit is the beating

creatures.name: the Fixer
creatures.flavor: Doesn't kill, doesn't steal, doesn't lie — he just makes the paperwork say what the boss needs it to say. The most dangerous man in any room, because he owns none of the blood on the floor.
creatures.summary: the man who cleans up messes and paper trails
creatures.sourceNote: hard-boiled fixer / problem-solver stock type named in the brief

creatures.name: the Femme Fatale
creatures.flavor: She's the reason half the corpses in this town died smiling. Every lie she tells sounds like the truth you wanted to hear.
creatures.summary: seductive manipulator, lies feel like truth
creatures.sourceNote: hard-boiled femme-fatale stock type named in the brief

creatures.name: The Unsolved (Cold-Case Revenant)
creatures.flavor: A murder the department stopped asking questions about. It still knows the killer's name and it's not done asking.
creatures.summary: restless ghost of a buried murder case

creatures.name: The Canary
creatures.flavor: Nightclub chanteuse feeding the DA a name a night, playing every table in the room like sheet music.
creatures.summary: lounge singer secretly informing on the mob

creatures.name: Torch
creatures.flavor: Arson-for-hire, three insurance fires and a body count nobody can pin on him. Loves his work a little too much.
creatures.summary: arsonist-for-hire, loves the fires too much

creatures.name: The Family's Animal (Wiseguy Werewolf)
creatures.flavor: Made muscle who goes feral on full moons and the family just schedules the hits around it.
creatures.summary: mob enforcer who turns feral on full moons

creatures.name: The Dirty Detective
creatures.flavor: Runs the cold-case files for the mob, burying leads he was sworn to chase. Badge in one pocket, envelope in the other.
creatures.summary: corrupt detective burying his own cases

creatures.name: the Underboss
creatures.flavor: Runs the day-to-day so the boss can stay clean on paper. Ambitious enough that everyone's watching to see if he waits his turn.
creatures.summary: day-to-day operator, ambitious heir apparent
creatures.sourceNote: crime-family second-in-command archetype

creatures.name: The Bench Owns You (Corrupt Judge)
creatures.flavor: Sets bail, sets sentences, sets whole careers — all for a price quietly paid outside chambers.
creatures.summary: bribed judge who sells verdicts outright

creatures.name: Sewer Hitman (The Contract Nobody Signed)
creatures.flavor: A killer who works cheap and clean through the storm drains under the city — nobody's ever seen his face twice.
creatures.summary: faceless hired killer moving through the sewers

creatures.name: The Don (Crime Boss)
creatures.flavor: Runs the whole waterfront from a back booth, three words from him and a man stops existing.
creatures.summary: waterfront crime boss, three words end lives

creatures.name: The Silent Assassin
creatures.flavor: Never misses, never talks, never leaves a print. The family keeps him on retainer and prays they never need him twice in one week.
creatures.summary: unerring silent killer, no prints, no words

creatures.name: The Family's War Machine (Armored Motorcade)
creatures.flavor: A reinforced sedan run by clockwork muscle under the hood — bulletproof, driverless, built to plow through a police blockade.
creatures.summary: armored driverless car, built to smash blockades

creatures.name: The Vampire Kingpin (Old Money, Older Blood)
creatures.flavor: Owns half the city's paper and none of its daylight. Every favor ever owed to him comes due eventually, in blood.
creatures.summary: ancient vampire, owns the city's every debt

creatures.name: The Case That Isn't Closed (City-Ghost of the Unsolved)
creatures.flavor: Every murder the city buried without an answer, fused into one patient intelligence that still keeps its own files.
creatures.summary: undying intelligence of every unsolved murder

creatures.name: Alley Snitch
creatures.flavor: Small-time informant who trades names for nickel bags, works every side of the block at once.
creatures.summary: small-time informant, trades names for cash

creatures.name: Numbers Runner
creatures.flavor: Carries the day's betting slips in a lining pocket, knows which precinct to avoid on which hour.
creatures.summary: betting-slip courier, knows the safe hours

creatures.name: Pier Rat
creatures.flavor: Dock kid who strips copper off idle barges and fences it before the tide turns.
creatures.summary: dock kid fencing stripped copper fast

creatures.name: Streetlamp Tail
creatures.flavor: Follows a mark three blocks back under every busted streetlamp on the route, reporting habits not crimes.
creatures.summary: low-rent tail, reports habits not crimes

creatures.name: Precinct Mole
creatures.flavor: Files clerk who photographs open cases before they close, sells the copies uptown.
creatures.summary: records clerk selling case photographs uptown

creatures.name: Broke-Nose Bouncer
creatures.flavor: Keeps the wrong crowd out of the right speakeasy, and the right crowd from remembering the address.
creatures.summary: speakeasy bouncer, guards the address itself

creatures.name: Getaway Kid
creatures.flavor: Seventeen and already the best wheelman on the strip, engine always running at the curb.
creatures.summary: teenage wheelman, engine always idling

creatures.name: Fence's Errand Boy
creatures.flavor: Moves hot jewelry between three pawnshops before the description hits the wire.
