creatures.summary: moves hot jewelry ahead of the wire

creatures.name: Sewer Grifter Ghoul
creatures.flavor: A con man who died mid-scam in the storm drains, still working an angle on anyone who wanders down.
creatures.summary: dead con man still working an angle

creatures.name: Payroll Skimmer
creatures.flavor: Union rep who takes a cut off every dock worker's envelope before it's counted.
creatures.summary: union rep skimming every payroll envelope

creatures.name: Hollow-Eyed Patrolman
creatures.flavor: Walked his beat so long after death nobody's noticed he stopped breathing on it.
creatures.summary: dead cop still walking his old beat

creatures.name: Speakeasy Torpedo
creatures.flavor: Doorman with a sap in his coat, decides who gets in by the size of the tip and the size of the fist.
creatures.summary: speakeasy doorman, admits by tip or fist

creatures.name: Pawnshop Ghost
creatures.flavor: Haunts a hock shop full of things people pawned to pay off men who killed them anyway.
creatures.summary: haunts a shop of desperate final pawns

creatures.name: Second-Story Man
creatures.flavor: Never touches the ground floor. In and out of a fire escape before the mark rolls over.
creatures.summary: cat burglar, works only the upper floors

creatures.name: Rumrunner
creatures.flavor: Drives crates of the good stuff past three checkpoints a night, paid in product and silence.
creatures.summary: bootlegger, paid in product and silence

creatures.name: Wharf Enforcer
creatures.flavor: Collects the union's cut from every ship that unloads, breaks fingers when the math is short.
creatures.summary: dock enforcer, breaks fingers over shortfalls

creatures.name: Undertaker's Accomplice
creatures.flavor: Runs a legitimate funeral parlor by day, disposal service for the family by night.
creatures.summary: funeral director doubling as disposal service

creatures.name: Rooftop Sniper
creatures.flavor: Sets up on a water tower with a rifle and a thermos, watches the drop and waits for the signal.
creatures.summary: rooftop rifleman, watches drops from towers

creatures.name: Loan Shark's Bookkeeper
creatures.flavor: Keeps two sets of ledgers, real and pretty, and never confuses which one goes to the DA.
creatures.summary: loan-shark accountant, keeps two ledgers straight

creatures.name: Betrayed Partner Wraith
creatures.flavor: A private eye killed by the client he trusted, drifting the office he never got to close.
creatures.summary: murdered PI haunting his own agency

creatures.name: Dockside Werebeast
creatures.flavor: Low-level runner who caught something in the sewers under the fish market and now can't stop scratching at full moon.
creatures.summary: low-level runner cursed with the wererat bite

creatures.name: Blackmail Photographer
creatures.flavor: Shoots compromising photos through hotel transoms for a living, sells the negatives twice.
creatures.summary: blackmail photographer, sells negatives to both

creatures.name: Arson Squad Torch-for-Hire
creatures.flavor: Second-string firebug who gets the small jobs, warehouses not landmarks, and still loves the smell.
creatures.summary: junior arsonist, still loves the smell

creatures.name: Junkyard Dog (Loyal Muscle)
creatures.flavor: Grew up in the same tenement as the boss, would eat a bullet before he'd talk.
creatures.summary: childhood muscle, would die before talking

creatures.name: Crooked Bail Bondsman
creatures.flavor: Springs the family's soldiers before the ink dries on the paperwork, for a price paid in favors.
creatures.summary: bail bondsman, springs soldiers for favors

creatures.name: Corner Pharmacist (Under-the-Counter)
creatures.flavor: Sells the legal stuff up front and the fixings for the illegal stuff out the back door.
creatures.summary: pharmacist selling fixings out the back

creatures.name: Skid Row Ghoul-Pack Runner
creatures.flavor: Once ran errands for the family, now runs down anyone sleeping rough near the old warehouse district.
creatures.summary: undead errand-runner preying on skid row

creatures.name: Motorcade Gunner
creatures.flavor: Rides the running board with a shotgun, job is simple, nothing gets close to the car.
creatures.summary: running-board gunman guarding the boss's car

creatures.name: Cathouse Madam's Muscle
creatures.flavor: Handles the rough trade so the house stays quiet and the customers stay embarrassed instead of dead.
creatures.summary: brothel muscle, keeps trouble quiet not fatal

creatures.name: The Interrogator
creatures.flavor: Basement room, one bare bulb, a patience that outlasts anyone's nerve. Never raises his voice.
creatures.summary: basement interrogator, patience outlasts any nerve

creatures.name: The Widow-Maker (Serial Insurance Killer)
creatures.flavor: Marries lonely men with good policies, three funerals in as many towns and a fourth name in her purse.
creatures.summary: serial black-widow killer, three funerals deep

creatures.name: The Chop-Shop King
creatures.flavor: Runs a garage that turns stolen cars into scrap and cash inside of six hours, no questions kept on paper.
creatures.summary: chop-shop boss, six-hour car-to-cash turnaround

creatures.name: The Blackmailer
creatures.flavor: Holds a file on half the city council, cashes it in an inch at a time so nobody ever pays enough to make him stop.
creatures.summary: blackmailer with a file on the council

creatures.name: The Wharf Boss's Widow
creatures.flavor: Inherited the docks when her husband went off a pier, and turned out to be better at the violence than he ever was.
creatures.summary: widow who's crueler than the husband was

creatures.name: The Torch's Rival (Ice Man)
creatures.flavor: Handles the jobs Torch won't touch, drownings staged as accidents, always cold, always clean.
creatures.summary: drowning specialist, cold where Torch is hot

creatures.name: The Cathouse Vampire
creatures.flavor: Works the high-end house on the hill, takes more than money from every client who overstays.
creatures.summary: seductive predator working the high-end house

creatures.name: The Coroner on the Payroll
creatures.flavor: Signs whatever cause of death keeps the invoice paid, has buried more truth than bodies.
creatures.summary: corrupt coroner, signs whatever pays best

creatures.name: The Getaway Ghost
creatures.flavor: A wheelman who died at the wheel mid-job, still floors it through the same six blocks every night.
creatures.summary: dead wheelman still driving his last job

creatures.name: The Pit Boss (Casino Enforcer)
creatures.flavor: Watches the tables for card counters and skimmers alike, settles both the same way out back.
creatures.summary: casino floor boss, settles cheats out back

creatures.name: Wiseguy Wererat Crew Boss
creatures.flavor: Runs the sewer-adjacent smuggling routes personally, likes his crew small and his tunnels smaller.
creatures.summary: sewer-route smuggling boss, feral under moons

creatures.name: The Nightclub Sorcerer (House Mage)
creatures.flavor: Runs 'luck' at the tables with a whispered word, the house never really loses on his shift.
creatures.summary: club mage rigging luck at every table

creatures.name: The Contract Killer's Handler
creatures.flavor: Never pulls a trigger himself, just arranges the calendar for the men who do.
creatures.summary: arranges hits, never pulls a trigger himself

creatures.name: Deep-Water Enforcer (Smuggler's Ghoul-Kin)
creatures.flavor: Drowned running contraband through the harbor and came back wrong, still guards the same sunken crates.
creatures.summary: drowned smuggler guarding sunken contraband crates

creatures.name: The Family Consigliere
creatures.flavor: Advises the Don on every angle of the law, knows exactly how far a body can bend it.
creatures.summary: mob lawyer, knows the law's every angle

creatures.name: The Bent Coroner's Ghoul Ward
creatures.flavor: Something the morgue basement keeps making from the bodies that were never properly buried.
creatures.summary: morgue-basement horror from unburied bodies

creatures.name: The Sweatshop Overseer
creatures.flavor: Runs an off-books garment floor behind a legitimate front, keeps the workers scared and the inspectors paid.
creatures.summary: sweatshop boss behind a legitimate front

creatures.name: The Assassin's Apprentice
creatures.flavor: Learning the trade from the Sewer Hitman, already better with a garrote than the teacher wants to admit.
creatures.summary: assassin-in-training, already outpacing the teacher

creatures.name: The Precinct Captain (Owned Outright)
creatures.flavor: Signs off on every cover-up in his district personally, keeps his own hands the cleanest in the building.
creatures.summary: precinct captain, signs every cover-up personally

creatures.name: The Ferryman (River Body-Disposal)
creatures.flavor: Runs a fishing boat that never catches fish, takes the family's problems out past the breakwater.
creatures.summary: boat captain who disposes of bodies offshore

creatures.name: The Kingpin's Bodyguard (Silent Type)
creatures.flavor: Stands two steps behind the Don at every meeting, has never once been photographed.
creatures.summary: never-photographed bodyguard, always two steps back

creatures.name: The Corrupt Warden
creatures.flavor: Runs the city lockup like a hotel for the family's soldiers, luxury cells for the right price.
creatures.summary: prison warden selling luxury to the family

creatures.name: The Nightclub's Second Vampire
creatures.flavor: The Femme Fatale's rival for the same territory, just as hungry, twice as reckless.
creatures.summary: rival seductress, hungrier and more reckless

creatures.name: The Wharf Sea-Witch (Waterfront Fixer)
creatures.flavor: Trades favors for names at the fish market before dawn, always knows what washed up before the cops do.
creatures.summary: waterfront fixer, knows what washes up first

creatures.name: The Underboss's Enforcer Pack Leader
creatures.flavor: Runs the muscle detail for the Underboss, stripes showing through the suit on a bad night.
creatures.summary: underboss's muscle chief, barely hides the stripes

creatures.name: The Crime Scene Cleaner
creatures.flavor: Erases a murder from a room in ninety minutes flat, has never once left a print of his own.
creatures.summary: scene cleaner, erases murders in ninety minutes

creatures.name: The Mayor's Handler
creatures.flavor: Nobody elected him to anything, but every decision in city hall runs through him first.
creatures.summary: unelected fixer who runs city hall's decisions

creatures.name: The Old Money Enforcer
creatures.flavor: Old family muscle who never got a mugshot in forty years, protected by names in high places.
creatures.summary: forty-year enforcer, protected by high names

creatures.name: The Precinct's Own Ghost Detective
creatures.flavor: Died solving the one case the department buried, and now solves it louder every year.
creatures.summary: dead detective, solving his buried case louder

creatures.name: The Vampire Kingpin's First Lieutenant
creatures.flavor: Turned decades ago as a reward for loyalty, runs the daylight business the kingpin can't touch.
creatures.summary: vampire's daylight proxy, runs business he can't

creatures.name: The Sewer Hitman's Mentor
creatures.flavor: Taught every hired gun on the waterfront everything they know, and kept the best tricks for himself.
creatures.summary: veteran hitman who trained the whole waterfront

creatures.name: The Family's Freighter (Armored Smuggling Ship)
creatures.flavor: A hollowed cargo ship rigged with hidden compartments and a hull that shrugs off harbor-patrol fire.
creatures.summary: rigged smuggling ship, hull shrugs off gunfire

creatures.name: The City's Corrupt Commissioner
creatures.flavor: Set every policy that lets the rackets breathe, and framed it all as tough-on-crime reform.
creatures.summary: commissioner who legislated the rackets' survival

creatures.name: The Bench's Ghost (Wrongful-Execution Revenant)
creatures.flavor: Executed for a crime the real judge sold to someone else, and death didn't settle the account.
creatures.summary: wrongly-executed man, death didn't settle it

creatures.name: The Nightclub Owner (Dhampir Front-Man)
creatures.flavor: Half-turned heir apparent to the Vampire Kingpin, runs the club as his own private hunting ground.
creatures.summary: half-vampire heir, hunts from his own club

creatures.name: The Kingpin's Rival (Old Blood, New Money)
creatures.flavor: Bought his way up from nothing and wants the whole waterfront the old families still hold.
creatures.summary: self-made rival, wants the old families' turf

creatures.name: The Kingpin's Enforcer Elite (Death Knight of the Docks)
creatures.flavor: A soldier who died collecting for the kingpin and rose to keep collecting, forever, without complaint.
creatures.summary: undead debt collector, rose to keep collecting

creatures.name: The Family's Assassin-Twins
creatures.flavor: Two killers who split every contract down the middle, one takes the mark, one takes the witnesses.
creatures.summary: twin killers splitting mark and witness work

creatures.name: The Fallen DA (Ultimate Corruption)
creatures.flavor: Sold his conviction record to the family piece by piece until nothing human was left underneath the suit.
creatures.summary: soul-sold DA, nothing human left underneath

creatures.name: The Judge's Devil (Contract Behind the Bench)
creatures.flavor: The thing that actually holds the corrupt judge's real contract, collects on every sentence sold.
creatures.summary: devil holding the judge's real signed contract

creatures.name: The City's Silent Partner (Shadow Financier)
creatures.flavor: Owns pieces of every legitimate business downtown, laundering the family's money through polite society.
creatures.summary: shadow financier laundering money through society

creatures.name: The Godmother (Matriarch of the Family)
creatures.flavor: Never took the Don's title but every real decision in the family runs through her kitchen table first.
creatures.summary: true power behind the Don, unseen matriarch

creatures.name: The Frame Job (Living Conspiracy)
creatures.flavor: A tangle of false confessions, planted evidence, and bought witnesses that has learned to think for itself.
creatures.summary: self-aware conspiracy of false evidence, alive

creatures.name: The Executioner's Debt (Mummified Hangman)
creatures.flavor: The city's official executioner, embalmed and still working through a backlog of names he was never given.
creatures.summary: mummified hangman, still working an endless backlog

creatures.name: The Vampire Kingpin's Ancient Rival
creatures.flavor: Older than the city's founding charter, wants the throne of blood-debt the kingpin only thinks he owns.
creatures.summary: ancient undead rival, predates the city's charter

creatures.name: The Last Honest Cop, Corrupted (Apex Fall)
creatures.flavor: The one detective who never took a dime, broken and remade by the family into something that never sleeps or stops.
creatures.summary: the last honest cop, broken and remade undying

creatures.name: the Chiseler
creatures.flavor: Works the crowd outside the courthouse, palming wallets and running the pigeon drop. Bolts the second a mark makes him.
creatures.summary: petty street grifter, first line of noir muscle
creatures.sourceNote: hard-boiled small-time grifter/pickpocket stock type

creatures.name: the Torpedo
creatures.flavor: A rented fist in a cheap suit, sent to lean on shopkeepers who are late on the vig. Talks with his knuckles first.
creatures.summary: low-level muscle for hire, leans on debtors
creatures.sourceNote: hard-boiled hired-gun enforcer archetype

creatures.name: the Wire Man
creatures.flavor: A beat cop on the take, radio turned down so the boys upstairs get the tip-off first. His badge buys silence, not justice.
creatures.summary: bent patrolman feeding tips to the rackets
creatures.sourceNote: dirty-cop / bent-badge archetype

creatures.name: the Wheelman
creatures.flavor: Never draws a piece, never needs to — his job is making sure everyone else is three blocks gone before the sirens turn the corner.
creatures.summary: getaway driver, mobile support in a chase
creatures.sourceNote: getaway-driver stock type

creatures.name: the Shakedown Man
creatures.flavor: Built like a delivery truck and twice as polite about it — right up until the register doesn't open fast enough.
creatures.summary: protection-racket collector, bigger and blunter
creatures.sourceNote: protection-racket collector archetype

creatures.name: the Cigarette Girl
creatures.flavor: Sells smokes table to table at the club and sells whispers to whoever's paying after close. Everyone underestimates the tray.
creatures.summary: club-floor informant, trades gossip for coin
creatures.sourceNote: nightclub-informant/eyes-and-ears archetype

creatures.name: the Enforcer
creatures.flavor: The crime lord's answer when words stop working. Doesn't monologue, doesn't negotiate — just walks in slow and leaves loud.
creatures.summary: crime lord's blunt-instrument muscle
creatures.sourceNote: hard-boiled enforcer stock type named in the brief

creatures.name: the Dirty Cop
creatures.flavor: Made detective the honest way, then found out honest doesn't pay the mortgage. Still carries the badge like it means something.
creatures.summary: corrupt detective, badge as much as bribe
creatures.sourceNote: corrupt-detective archetype named in the brief

creatures.name: the Torch
creatures.flavor: Burns warehouses for insurance money and burns witnesses for free. Whistles while the building comes down.
creatures.summary: arsonist-for-hire, insurance jobs and cleanup
creatures.sourceNote: professional-arsonist-for-hire archetype

creatures.name: the Coroner's Friend
creatures.flavor: Signs whatever cause of death keeps the retainer coming. A gunshot wound becomes 'heart failure' for the right envelope.
creatures.summary: bought-off examiner, falsifies causes of death
creatures.sourceNote: corrupt-medical-examiner / hush-money doctor archetype

creatures.name: the Consigliere
creatures.flavor: Never raises his voice, never touches a weapon — he just tells the boss which enemies to forgive and which to bury, and he's never once been wrong.
creatures.summary: family strategist, plans the violence others do
creatures.sourceNote: crime-family advisor/counselor archetype

creatures.name: the Torpedo Boss
creatures.flavor: Twenty years in the life and not one clean kill on his sheet — every hit gets dressed up as an accident, a robbery, a suicide. Craftsmanship.
creatures.summary: veteran hitman, disguises every kill
creatures.sourceNote: veteran hitman / made-man archetype

creatures.name: the Ghoul in the Icebox
creatures.flavor: The meat-locker in the back of the butcher shop has a second tenant, and he doesn't stay cold. The mob uses him to make problems disappear — permanently, and personally.
creatures.summary: grave-risen enforcer kept on ice by the mob
creatures.sourceNote: gothic revenant tradition (generic grave-risen undead, pre-1929 folklore/literature — not a specific author's IP)

creatures.name: the Torch Singer's Ghost
creatures.flavor: She sang the last set at the Blue Room the night they found her in the river. Now her voice still drifts through the club after closing, and the men who paid to have her silenced haven't slept right since.
creatures.summary: murdered singer's ghost haunting her old club
creatures.sourceNote: gothic revenant tradition — a wronged-woman haunting, drawn from settled 19th-century ghost-story convention, not any specific copyrighted work

creatures.name: the Assassin
creatures.flavor: Doesn't work for the crime lord — works for whoever's currently paying the crime lord's rivals. Loyalty is a rate card.
creatures.summary: mercenary killer with no fixed allegiance
creatures.sourceNote: hard-boiled contract-killer stock type

creatures.name: Count Marlowe
creatures.flavor: Old money, older habits. He came from somewhere across the water a century ago and never quite stopped feeding — now he owns the docks, the judges, and most of the bodies nobody ever finds. He receives petitioners once a week, always after dark, always alone in the room with them.
creatures.summary: centuries-old crime lord, Dracula lineage reskinned
creatures.sourceNote: Bram Stoker, Dracula (1897, US public domain) — our own crime-lord recontextualization of the Dracula lineage, not any film studio's visual design

creatures.name: the Crime Lord's Bride
creatures.flavor: Nobody knows if she runs the family or he does anymore — she's older than his human years put together and considerably less patient. The books say his name is on the deeds. The books are wrong.
creatures.summary: elder vampire consort, true power behind the throne
creatures.sourceNote: Stoker's Dracula (1897, PD) — the vampire-bride motif from the same novel, our own noir take, not a studio design

creatures.name: Rustfall Ghoul
creatures.flavor: A radiation-mad scavenger, sun-blistered and skeletal, that picks through rubble on hunger reflex alone.
creatures.summary: radiation-mad wretch scavenging rubble on hunger reflex

creatures.name: Scrap-Hound
creatures.flavor: A feral dog gone patchy and mean, hide crusted with fallout-scald, running loose packs down the cracked highway lines.
creatures.summary: mutant feral dog pack hunting the broken highway

creatures.name: Rat-King's Swarm
creatures.flavor: A boiling carpet of mutated rats nesting in a dead town's substructure, teeth filed sharp on rebar and bone.
creatures.summary: boiling mutant rat carpet nesting in dead-town pipes

creatures.name: Warband Ganger
creatures.flavor: Foot-soldier of a raider crew, spikes welded to a salvage jacket, running on stolen fuel and borrowed nerve.
creatures.summary: spiked-jacket raider grunt running a warband's front line

creatures.name: Bomb-Cult Zealot
creatures.flavor: A wide-eyed devotee of the old mushroom-cloud gospel, strapped with scavenged ordnance and singing the countdown hymn.
creatures.summary: ordnance-strapped zealot singing the mushroom-cloud hymn

creatures.name: Geiger Wretch
creatures.flavor: A corpse that never stopped ticking — its wounds glow faint green, and the count climbs the longer you stand near it.
creatures.summary: glowing irradiated corpse that never stopped ticking

creatures.name: Blistered Stalker
creatures.flavor: A hairless mutant hound, skin cracked like the asphalt it hunts on, drawn to the sound of a working engine.
creatures.summary: hairless mutant hound drawn to a running engine

creatures.name: Chem-Huffer
creatures.flavor: A raider hopped up on scavenged stimulant canisters, shakes and swings a length of pipe with more rage than sense.
creatures.summary: stim-shaking raider swinging a pipe with pure rage

creatures.name: Cracked Sentry-Bot
creatures.flavor: A pre-Fall security drone running on a dying battery, patrolling a route that hasn't mattered in a generation.
creatures.summary: dying pre-Fall security drone patrolling a dead route

creatures.name: Fuel-Cult Firestarter
creatures.flavor: An officer of the bomb-cult warband, doused in promethium and preaching detonation as sacrament to the ranks behind him.
creatures.summary: promethium-doused cult officer preaching detonation as sacrament

creatures.name: Mutant Behemoth Hog
creatures.flavor: A boar swollen wrong by fallout, tusks like rebar, that charges convoys for the meat and the noise.
creatures.summary: fallout-swollen boar that charges convoys tusks-first

creatures.name: Irradiated Ghast
creatures.flavor: A ghoul cooked past rot into something faster and hungrier, skin sloughing, glowing faintly under the ash-clouds.
creatures.summary: faster hungrier ghoul cooked past rot by fallout

creatures.name: Warband Enforcer
creatures.flavor: Muscle for a raider crew's chain of command, a scrap-plate riot shield in one hand and a debt ledger in the other.
creatures.summary: raider muscle enforcing the warband's chain of debt

creatures.name: Chitin-Plated Feral
creatures.flavor: A mutant gone half-beast under the ash-fall moon, hide grown over in cracked insect plate, tusks and claws both.
creatures.summary: half-beast mutant grown a cracked chitin hide

creatures.name: Power-Rig Brute
creatures.flavor: A raider bolted into a scavenged hydraulic exo-rig, twice the size he was born, hitting like a demolition crew.
creatures.summary: raider bolted into a scavenged hydraulic exo-rig

creatures.name: Diesel Golem
creatures.flavor: A patchwork war-machine stitched from engine blocks and rebar, lurching forward on hissing pistons and stolen fuel.
creatures.summary: patchwork engine-block war-machine lurching on stolen fuel

creatures.name: Last-Light Keeper
creatures.flavor: A settlement's champion, armored in scavenged plate, fighting arena bouts to keep the generator's lights burning one more night.
creatures.summary: settlement champion fighting to keep the generator alive

creatures.name: Fallout Stalker
creatures.flavor: Pale, hairless, and silent — it hunts by the geiger-tick of its prey's gear and drags kills back into the slag caves to glow.
creatures.summary: silent radiation-zone apex hunter
creatures.sourceNote: mutant-feral archetype: apex predator adapted to hot-zone terrain

creatures.name: Convoy Warlord
creatures.flavor: A road-baron who rules a war-rig fleet by ambush and fear, trading fuel and captives up and down the ruin-highways.
creatures.summary: road-baron ruling a raider convoy by ambush and fear

creatures.name: Vault Revenant
creatures.flavor: A bunker's last resident, sealed in decades past and returned changed — pale, ageless, and furious the door ever opened.
creatures.summary: ageless bunker-dweller returned furious the seal broke

creatures.name: Apex Ferox
creatures.flavor: The wasteland's top predator, white-ash pelted and man-tall at the shoulder, that has learned raiders are easy prey.
creatures.summary: ash-pelted apex predator that hunts raiders for sport

creatures.name: War-Rig Juggernaut
creatures.flavor: A warlord's mobile fortress, welded from a dozen dead trucks, that rolls down the highway spitting fire from every hatch.
creatures.summary: warlord's mobile fortress rolling on a dozen dead trucks

creatures.name: The Long Count
creatures.flavor: A dead soldier still running the last order he was given, counting down a mission that ended with the world.
creatures.summary: dead soldier still counting down a mission long over

creatures.name: The Last Warlord
creatures.flavor: The wasteland's uncrowned king, a raider-general who unified a hundred warbands under one banner and one law: take everything.
creatures.summary: raider-general who unified the wasteland under one law

creatures.name: The Half-Life
creatures.flavor: A leviathan born from the deepest hot-zone, burrowing under the ash-flats and surfacing only when the ground starts to glow.
creatures.summary: gargantuan hot-zone leviathan that surfaces when ground glows

creatures.name: Cinder Rat
creatures.flavor: A radiation-swollen rat that scavenges the blast rings, chewing wire for the copper.
creatures.summary: Radiation-swollen scavenger rat gnawing wire for copper

creatures.name: Slag Crow
creatures.flavor: Feathers fused with melted glass; it circles collapse sites waiting for the dust to settle.
creatures.summary: Glass-feathered scavenger bird circling collapse sites

creatures.name: Barrens Jackal
creatures.flavor: Runs in loose packs behind warbands, cleaning up whatever the raiders leave behind.
creatures.summary: Pack scavenger trailing raiders for the leftovers

creatures.name: Fallout Toad
creatures.flavor: Bloated on chem runoff, its croak alone curdles unprotected water.
creatures.summary: Chem-bloated toad whose croak curdles nearby water

creatures.name: Wasteland Scrapper
creatures.flavor: A lookout for a warband, armed with a pipe rifle and a claim to the ruins ahead.
creatures.summary: Warband lookout with a jury-rigged pipe rifle

creatures.name: Ration Raider
creatures.flavor: Kills for canned goods and clean water, nothing personal, everything necessary.
creatures.summary: Desperate raider who kills for canned goods and water

creatures.name: Bonepicker Ghoul
creatures.flavor: Radiation twisted this corpse into a hungry thing that still remembers how to run.
creatures.summary: Radiation-twisted corpse that still remembers running

creatures.name: Static Zealot
creatures.flavor: Worships the hum in dead radios as the voice of the sky that ended the world.
creatures.summary: Cultist who worships the static hum as divine voice

creatures.name: Wire-Fanged Cur
creatures.flavor: A scrap-hound whose muzzle was crudely fitted with barbed wire fangs by its handler.
creatures.summary: Scrap-hound fitted with crude barbed-wire fangs

creatures.name: Blister-Skin Drifter
creatures.flavor: Sores weep a contact rot; it doesn't chase so much as shamble into your path.
creatures.summary: Weeping-rot shambler that spreads contact contamination

creatures.name: Powder-Keg Runner
creatures.flavor: Straps a satchel of scavenged explosives to their chest and sprints the last stretch.
creatures.summary: Bomb-cult runner who sprints in with a strapped satchel

creatures.name: Rust-Eaten Sentry
creatures.flavor: An old security frame, corroded half-through, still walking its dead patrol route.
creatures.summary: Corroded security automaton walking a dead patrol route

creatures.name: Chem-Slick Viper
creatures.flavor: Its venom glands swelled on tank runoff; one bite and the wound never quite closes.
creatures.summary: Runoff-mutated viper whose venom keeps wounds open

creatures.name: Grit-Locust Cloud
creatures.flavor: A living dust storm of mutant locusts that strips crops and flesh alike.
creatures.summary: Mutant locust swarm stripping crops and flesh alike

creatures.name: Carrion Beetle Swarm
creatures.flavor: Chitinous beetles the size of fists, drawn en masse to fresh kills in the ash flats.
creatures.summary: Fist-sized beetle swarm drawn to fresh ash-flat kills

creatures.name: Tanker Ganger
creatures.flavor: Rides shotgun on a fuel convoy, quick to violence when the tribute's short.
creatures.summary: Fuel-convoy enforcer quick to violence over short tribute

creatures.name: Scab-Plate Scavver
creatures.flavor: Wears bolted scrap armor scavenged plate by plate off the dead.
creatures.summary: Scrap-armored raider wearing plates looted off corpses

creatures.name: Detonator Cultist
creatures.flavor: Straps a warhead trigger to his own chest, grinning, waiting to be told when.
creatures.summary: Bomb-cultist wired with a warhead trigger, waiting

creatures.name: Growth-Warped Boar
creatures.flavor: Tumor-ridden and enormous, it charges anything that moves in its blighted range.
creatures.summary: Tumor-ridden giant boar charging anything that moves

creatures.name: Half-Life Skeleton
creatures.flavor: Bones fused glass-green by fallout, animated by whatever still crackles in the marrow.
creatures.summary: Fallout-glassed bones animated by residual radiation

creatures.name: Corroded Watcher
creatures.model: net-new: camera-drone husk on scavenged chassis
creatures.flavor: A camera-drone husk grafted to a scavenged chassis, still logging intruders no one reads.
creatures.summary: Drone-husk sentinel still logging intruders no one reads

creatures.name: Ash-Choked Hound
creatures.flavor: A scrap-hound puppy grown feral in the rubble, quick and starving.
creatures.summary: Feral scrap-hound pup, quick, starving, unpredictable

creatures.name: Firebrand Initiate
creatures.flavor: A new convert to the Bomb-Cult, still nervous, still willing to light the fuse.
creatures.summary: Nervous bomb-cult convert still willing to light fuses

creatures.name: Mange-Back Mutt
creatures.flavor: Mangy, hairless, and vicious in packs, it hunts the collapsed subway lines.
creatures.summary: Mangy hairless mutt hunting collapsed subway tunnels

creatures.name: Warband Trapper
creatures.flavor: Lines the approach roads with snares and pit traps before the warband ever shows itself.
creatures.summary: Trap-setter who lines roads before the warband arrives

creatures.name: Static-Touched Vermin
creatures.flavor: An irradiated centipede whose touch leaves skin blistered and numb for days.
creatures.summary: Irradiated centipede whose touch blisters skin for days

creatures.name: Fume Vent Zealot
creatures.flavor: Breathes through a cracked filter mask, chanting over any vent that still leaks gas.
creatures.summary: Cracked-mask cultist chanting over leaking gas vents

creatures.name: Wreck-Diver
creatures.flavor: Specializes in stripping downed aircraft and sunken tankers before the warlords claim them.
creatures.summary: Salvager who strips wrecks before warlords claim them

creatures.name: Ashfield Widow Spider
creatures.flavor: Its web is laced with fine grit and ash, near invisible against a scorched field.
creatures.summary: Ash-camouflaged spider whose webs vanish in scorched fields

creatures.name: Grinder-Belt Sentry
creatures.flavor: Retrofitted from an old factory line, its arms still swing the grinder motion, now on flesh.
creatures.summary: Retrofitted factory automaton swinging grinder arms on flesh

creatures.name: Fuel-Cult Bruiser
creatures.flavor: Enforces tithe collection for the Fuel Cult with a length of rebar and no patience.
creatures.summary: Tithe enforcer swinging rebar for the Fuel Cult

creatures.name: Chem-Vat Horror
creatures.flavor: Something that crawled out of a corroded chemical vat and kept growing wrong.
creatures.summary: Chemical-vat mutant that crawled out and kept growing

creatures.name: Ash-Widow Broodmother
creatures.flavor: Nests in a collapsed reactor dome, her brood hatching by the hundreds each ash-season.
creatures.summary: Reactor-dome broodmother spawning hundreds each ash-season

creatures.name: Warlord's Duelist
creatures.flavor: Trained to fight one-on-one for the warlord's amusement — and his succession.
creatures.summary: Warlord's champion dueling for sport and succession

creatures.name: Bloat-Ghast Preacher
creatures.flavor: Once a bomb-cult prophet, now a rotting thing still delivering the sermon to no one.
creatures.summary: Rotting former prophet still delivering sermons to no one

creatures.name: Convoy Breaker
creatures.flavor: Specializes in ambushing fuel convoys, cracking axles before the guns ever come out.
creatures.summary: Convoy ambusher who cracks axles before guns come out

creatures.name: Warp-Chitin Stalker
creatures.flavor: Insect and something else fused by decades of runoff, patient and armored.
creatures.summary: Insect-hybrid mutant armored by decades of chem runoff

creatures.name: Rig-Mounted Turret Hound
creatures.model: net-new: scrap-hound chassis with swivel autogun
creatures.flavor: A scrap-hound chassis welded permanently to a swivel-mounted autogun.
creatures.summary: Scrap-hound chassis welded to a swivel autogun

creatures.name: Fume-Choked Ettin
creatures.flavor: A two-headed mutant giant, each head arguing over which smokestack to loot next.
creatures.summary: Two-headed mutant giant arguing over which ruin to loot

creatures.name: Vault-Sealed Revenant
creatures.flavor: Died locked in a bunker's blast door; its scream still carries the hiss of failing air.
creatures.summary: Bunker-sealed ghost whose scream carries failing air

creatures.name: Warband Chieftain
creatures.flavor: Climbed to command over three rival gangs by outliving every challenger personally.
creatures.summary: Warband chief who climbed to power by outliving rivals

creatures.name: Molten Vat Ooze
creatures.flavor: A runoff sludge of chemical waste and slag, dissolving anything that wades too close.
creatures.summary: Chemical-waste sludge ooze dissolving anything too close

creatures.name: Rad-Sick Troll
creatures.flavor: Its regeneration keeps pace with the radiation eating it, an endless grotesque stalemate.
creatures.summary: Regenerating troll locked in stalemate with its own radiation sickness

creatures.name: Piston-Arm Enforcer
creatures.flavor: Salvaged hydraulic press arms bolted onto a walking chassis to break down doors and skulls alike.
creatures.summary: Salvaged hydraulic-press automaton breaking doors and skulls

creatures.name: Ashborn Wyrmling Mutant
creatures.flavor: A reptile mutated past recognition, its stare leaves flesh cracked like sun-baked clay.
creatures.summary: Mutant reptile whose stare cracks flesh like baked clay

creatures.name: Fallout Wight Captain
creatures.flavor: Commands a squad of lesser ghouls, the only one who still remembers military drill.
creatures.summary: Ghoul squad commander who still remembers military drill

creatures.name: Bomb-Cult High Priest
creatures.flavor: Preaches that the old bombs were mercy and prays daily for a second, holier blast.
creatures.summary: Fanatic priest praying for a second, holier detonation

creatures.name: Furnace-Bound Salamander
creatures.flavor: Bound into a scrapyard's blast furnace, it lashes out at anyone who opens the door.
creatures.summary: Blast-furnace-bound elemental lashing at anyone who opens the door

creatures.name: Scrapfield Chimera
creatures.flavor: Three mutant heads fused by radiation, each screaming a different warning.
creatures.summary: Three-headed radiation-fused mutant, each screaming differently

creatures.name: Diesel Pit Fighter
creatures.flavor: Champions the fighting pits under a warlord's banner, undefeated across nine seasons.
creatures.summary: Undefeated warlord's pit champion across nine seasons

creatures.name: Wraith of the Fallout Line
creatures.flavor: A commuter train's dead passengers fused into one hungry, drifting shape.
creatures.summary: Dead commuters fused into one hungry drifting shape

creatures.name: Junk-Titan Enforcer
creatures.flavor: Built by a warlord's engineers to guard the compound gate; nothing has yet gotten past it.
creatures.summary: Warlord's gate guardian that nothing has gotten past

creatures.name: Toxin-Blood Oni Raider
creatures.flavor: A brute of a raider warped by chem exposure until its blood itself became a weapon.
creatures.summary: Chem-warped raider brute whose own blood is a weapon

creatures.name: Scrap-Hound Alpha
creatures.flavor: Leads a scrap-hound pack, frost-white fur stained ash-grey from the wastes.
creatures.summary: Scrap-hound pack alpha with ash-stained frost-white fur

creatures.name: Vault Door Golem
creatures.flavor: An entire blast door animated by pre-collapse tech, still guarding a vault long since emptied.
creatures.summary: Animated blast-door guardian of a vault long since emptied

creatures.name: Warlord's Bodyguard
creatures.flavor: Silent, armored, loyal only to whoever currently holds the warlord's seat.
creatures.summary: Silent armored bodyguard loyal only to whoever rules

creatures.name: Contagion Ghast Broodkeeper
creatures.flavor: Spreads its rot deliberately, cultivating new ghouls the way a farmer tends a field.
creatures.summary: Rot-spreading undead cultivating new ghouls like crops

creatures.name: Detonation Engineer
creatures.flavor: Designs the Bomb-Cult's warheads from scavenged reactor cores, half-mad with the maths of it.
creatures.summary: Bomb-cult engineer half-mad with reactor-core warhead math

creatures.name: Iron Convoy Behemoth
creatures.flavor: A war-rig hauled by an animated chassis, plating scavenged from a dozen dead vehicles.
creatures.summary: War-rig hauler plated with scrap from a dozen dead vehicles

creatures.name: Fallout Hydra Broodhorror
creatures.flavor: Each severed head regrows twisted differently, mutation compounding mutation.
creatures.summary: Hydra whose severed heads regrow ever more mutated

creatures.name: Cinderfall Vampire Warlord
creatures.flavor: Feeds on the survivors of the settlements it razes, then rules the ashes it leaves.
creatures.summary: Undead warlord feeding on survivors of settlements it razes

creatures.name: Bunker-Bred Nightmare Steed
creatures.flavor: A cult general's mount, hooves scorching whatever ash-field it charges across.
creatures.summary: Cult general's steed scorching ash-fields with every charge

creatures.name: Reactor Wyrm
creatures.flavor: Burrows through irradiated bedrock, its hide glowing hot from what it's fed on.
creatures.summary: Bedrock-burrowing wyrm glowing hot from irradiated feeding

creatures.name: Grand Warlord's Champion
creatures.flavor: Fought a hundred duels to earn the right to lead the largest warband in the ash flats.
creatures.summary: Undefeated champion who fought a hundred duels for command

creatures.name: Ash-Frost Colossus
creatures.flavor: A nuclear-winter mutant, matted fur crusted in ash-snow, hungry beyond reason.
creatures.summary: Nuclear-winter mutant with ash-snow-crusted fur and endless hunger

creatures.name: Grid-Fed Iron Sentinel
creatures.flavor: Still wired to a dead power grid, drawing a trickle of current that keeps it standing forever.
creatures.summary: Grid-wired automaton drawing endless trickle current

creatures.name: Vaultbreaker Behemoth
creatures.flavor: A mutated giant that cracks vault doors open bare-handed for the warband behind it.
creatures.summary: Mutant giant that cracks vault doors bare-handed

creatures.name: Deathwatch Cult Oracle
creatures.flavor: Preserved by cult ritual to keep interpreting the countdown only it can still hear.
creatures.summary: Preserved oracle still interpreting a countdown only it hears

creatures.name: Blightborn Roc
creatures.flavor: A carrion bird grown monstrous on radioactive corpses, its shadow alone panics a settlement.
creatures.summary: Radiation-grown carrion bird whose shadow panics settlements

creatures.name: Ash Warlord's Marilith Enforcer
creatures.flavor: A fiend bound into service by an ancient bargain, now runs security for a warlord's court.
creatures.summary: Bound fiend running security for a warlord's court

creatures.name: Devouring Junkyard Kraken
creatures.flavor: Lives beneath a scrapyard's flooded pit, tentacled from decades of chemical mutation.
creatures.summary: Tentacled scrapyard-pit mutant born of decades of chemicals

creatures.name: The Countdown Keeper
creatures.model: net-new: ancient cult figurehead whispering the final number
creatures.flavor: An ancient cult figurehead, preserved by dogma, still whispering the final number.
creatures.summary: Preserved cult figurehead whispering an endless final number

creatures.name: The Warlord Ascendant
creatures.flavor: United every warband in the ash flats under one banner through fear alone.
creatures.summary: Warlord who united every ash-flat gang through pure fear

creatures.name: The Fallout Titan
creatures.flavor: A mutation so vast it's mistaken for a mountain until it stands up.
creatures.summary: Mountain-sized mutant mistaken for terrain until it moves

creatures.name: The Last Detonation
creatures.flavor: A warhead-core walking chassis the Bomb-Cult built to finish what the first bombs started.
creatures.summary: Warhead-core chassis built to finish what first bombs started

creatures.name: The Glass Sea Wyrm
creatures.flavor: Older than the warbands, it swims the vitrified glass flats where the first blast struck.
creatures.summary: Ancient leviathan swimming the vitrified glass flats

creatures.name: Chittergaunt
creatures.flavor: A hairless, twitchy thing that runs on all fours and screeches to call its litter-mates in; harmless alone, a real problem in a pack of six.
creatures.summary: pack-hunting mutant scavenger, calls its litter
creatures.sourceNote: mutant-feral archetype: irradiated pack-scavenger, stock post-apoc creature type (not tied to any franchise)

creatures.name: Rustfang
creatures.flavor: A dog (or what was a dog) with fused metal shrapnel grown into its hide from decades denned in a scrapyard; bites like a bear trap.
creatures.summary: scrap-fused mutant guard-dog
creatures.sourceNote: mutant-feral archetype: junkyard guard-beast gone wrong

creatures.name: Waste Raider
creatures.flavor: Sun-blistered, tattooed with the mile-markers of every settlement they've burned; fights in a screaming knot with two or three others.
creatures.summary: road-gang footsoldier, fights in packs
creatures.sourceNote: raider-gang footsoldier archetype: post-collapse road-warrior stock type

creatures.name: Cult Acolyte, Bomb-Struck
creatures.flavor: Wears a rusted warhead casing like a holy relic and prays to the flash that reshaped the world; will walk into obvious death singing.
creatures.summary: warhead-relic zealot, suicidal devotion
creatures.sourceNote: bomb-cult zealot archetype: doomsday-worship footsoldier, stock post-apoc type

creatures.name: Bleached Ghoul
creatures.flavor: Not undead by ritual but by dose — the radiation cooked the mind out and left hunger behind; skin cracked like dry riverbed, eyes milk-white.
creatures.summary: radiation-sick feral scavenger, not truly undead-lore
creatures.sourceNote: irradiated-ghoul archetype: our own fallout-sickness take, distinct from any undead-ghoul lore or franchise ghoul design

creatures.name: Junk Crawler
creatures.flavor: A drift of rebar and car doors that somehow walks and somehow wants your rifle barrel more than your blood.
creatures.summary: debris-heap creature that devours metal
creatures.sourceNote: scrap-beast archetype: animate debris/rust-monster reskin for a wasteland setting

creatures.name: Warlord's Enforcer
creatures.flavor: Keeps the warlord's convoy in line with a length of chain and a reputation for never asking twice.
creatures.summary: warlord's chain-wielding enforcer
creatures.sourceNote: raider-warlord's lieutenant archetype

creatures.name: Rad-Hulk
creatures.flavor: Grew three sizes past human and forgot most of its words along the way; still remembers the name of the town it used to guard.
creatures.summary: hulking overgrown mutant brute
creatures.sourceNote: mutant-feral archetype: hulking irradiated brute, stock post-apoc mutant type

creatures.name: Scrap Colossus
creatures.flavor: Welded together from three different trucks by hands that clearly loved the work; runs on spite and a leaking fuel drum.
creatures.summary: welded-together walking scrap machine
creatures.sourceNote: scrap-beast archetype: junkyard-built walking machine, stock salvage-golem type

creatures.name: Chem-Baron
creatures.model: net-new: wasteland kingpin in scavenged finery, no bespoke model needed (uses mage stat frame only)
creatures.flavor: Runs three settlements on rationed water and homebrewed stims; smiles like he's already won the argument you haven't started.
creatures.summary: drug-and-fuel kingpin warlord
creatures.sourceNote: raider-warlord archetype: settlement-controlling drug/fuel kingpin

creatures.name: The Sermon-Bearer
creatures.model: net-new: robed zealot with a warhead-fragment icon, no bespoke model needed (uses priest stat frame only)
creatures.flavor: Preaches that the bombs were mercy and the next ones will finish the job kindly; his flock believes him, which is the scary part.
creatures.summary: doomsday high-priest awaiting the next blast
creatures.sourceNote: bomb-cult zealot archetype: doomsday high-priest, our own invented theology (no real-world cult referenced)

creatures.name: Ashfield Titan
creatures.flavor: Built from a downed cargo hauler by a warlord who wanted a throne that could also crush things; mostly it just crushes things.
creatures.summary: hauler-built industrial war-walker
creatures.sourceNote: scrap-beast archetype: settlement-sized industrial walker, stock giant-war-machine type

creatures.name: Glasslands Broodmother
creatures.flavor: Every Chittergaunt and Rustfang for fifty miles traces back to her den under the melted overpass; she remembers being smaller, and human.
creatures.summary: apex matriarch of the mutant bloodline
creatures.sourceNote: mutant-feral archetype: apex irradiated matriarch, seeds a feral bloodline

creatures.name: Deadman's Warlord
creatures.model: net-new: convoy-king in welded plate armor built from truck panels, no bespoke model needed
creatures.flavor: Crowned himself off the corpse of the last warlord and the fuel reserve underneath his throne-truck; his convoy is a moving nation.
creatures.summary: apex convoy-king, rules through fuel scarcity
creatures.sourceNote: raider-warlord archetype: apex convoy-king ruling by fear and fuel scarcity

creatures.name: The Last Sermon
creatures.flavor: Claims the final bomb is still out there, waiting for his word; nobody who's called the bluff has lived to be wrong about it.
creatures.summary: apex doomsday-prophet guarding a live warhead
creatures.sourceNote: bomb-cult zealot archetype: apex doomsday-prophet who holds a live warhead as scripture

creatures.name: Half-Life
creatures.flavor: Been soaking in the hot zone so long the geiger counters just give up near it; what's left of the mind is patient, and furious.
creatures.summary: apex fallout-horror, decades-deep radiation exposure
creatures.sourceNote: irradiated-ghoul archetype: apex fallout-mutated horror, decades of exposure past any human baseline

creatures.name: The Foundry Made Flesh
creatures.model: net-new: factory-fused industrial mass, no bespoke model exists yet (iron-golem stat frame)
creatures.flavor: An entire pre-collapse factory floor — presses, arms, conveyor teeth — fused by decades of slag into a single furious machine that still thinks it's making something.
creatures.summary: factory-fused apex war-machine
creatures.sourceNote: scrap-beast archetype: apex, a factory's automated defense grid fused into one rampaging mass

creatures.name: Cul-de-Sac Wanderer
creatures.flavor: A resident in bathrobe and slippers who never quite reaches the mailbox, looping the same forty feet of driveway forever.
creatures.summary: shambling loop-walker, the block's living dead

creatures.name: Porch-Light Moth-Thing
creatures.flavor: Drawn to bug-zapper blue, it flutters against screen doors at 3am, whispering in a dead child's voice about being let in.
creatures.summary: screen-door lurker begging to be let inside

creatures.name: HOA Enforcer Drone
creatures.flavor: A clipboard on wings that measures lawn height by moonlight and leaves violation notices on houses that don't exist yet.
creatures.summary: flying clipboard drone, petty bureaucratic menace

creatures.name: Sprinkler Ghoul
creatures.flavor: It rises from the irrigation system at exactly 3:00am, joints clicking like a valve timer, watering the grass with something that isn't water.
creatures.summary: irrigation-system ghoul, rises on the same timer nightly

creatures.name: Under-the-Bed Groper
creatures.flavor: Flat black and patient, it presses itself to the box spring all day and only unfolds a reaching limb once the lamp clicks off.
creatures.summary: classic bedroom-dark lurker, waits for lights-out

creatures.name: Overwaving Neighbor
creatures.flavor: He waves before you've even opened your blinds, hand moving a beat too fast, smile a beat too wide, already knowing your name.
creatures.summary: too-friendly neighbor, watching before you're even awake

creatures.name: Curfew Light Wisp
creatures.flavor: Streetlamps that switch on early and herd stragglers indoors by dimming ahead of their steps, punishing anyone caught out past curfew.
creatures.summary: streetlamp wisp that herds you home by dusk

creatures.name: Casserole Cultist
creatures.flavor: Arrives at your door within the hour of any tragedy, dish already baked, eyes already counting who's missing from the block.
creatures.summary: grief-vulture neighbor, dish in hand, headcount ready

creatures.name: Cursed Lawn Sentinel
creatures.flavor: Ceramic and grinning, it rotates a few degrees each night to keep every lawn in its sightline; the grass beneath it never dies right.
creatures.summary: grinning gnome, roots the cursed lawn to its post

creatures.name: Vinyl-Sider
creatures.flavor: A dog-shaped thing that phases through fences, patrolling yard boundaries with a bark that sounds pre-recorded and looped.
creatures.summary: fence-phasing hound, barks on a dead loop

creatures.name: The Family Wearing the Skin
creatures.flavor: Three bodies at the dinner table moving in perfect unison, each one a puppet worn by the same wrongness, still setting a fourth place for someone who used to live there.
creatures.summary: the too-perfect family, all three wearing the same face

creatures.name: Perpetual Yard-Sale Hag
creatures.flavor: Every Saturday her folding tables reappear stocked with items that belonged to people who are no longer around to miss them.
creatures.summary: folding-table hag selling the missing's belongings

creatures.name: Riding-Mower Revenant
creatures.flavor: A husband who died mowing the lawn and never stopped; the mower is rusted through but still runs, dragging him behind it in perfect stripes.
creatures.summary: dead husband still mowing perfect ghost-stripes

creatures.name: The Man Behind the Rubber Mask
creatures.flavor: He never runs and never speaks, just walks the same unhurried pace behind you no matter how fast you go, mask blank and waiting for the moment you stop looking back.
creatures.summary: the masked slasher, unhurried and always closing

creatures.name: Book Club Coven
creatures.flavor: Six women, one wine bottle, and a discussion that always circles back to who in the neighborhood needs to be 'welcomed properly' next.
creatures.summary: wine-and-book coven picking next month's victim

creatures.name: Backyard Above-Ground Deep One
creatures.flavor: Something surfaces in the cheap plastic pool every summer solstice, too large for the water it's found in, patient as chlorine rot.
creatures.summary: bloated pool-thing, too big for the water it's in

creatures.name: Cheerful Renovation Golem
creatures.flavor: Stitched from drywall, spare lumber, and whichever contractor stopped answering his phone, it keeps 'improving' the house whether anyone's living in it or not.
creatures.summary: stitched-contractor golem, endlessly remodeling the house

creatures.name: The PTA President
creatures.flavor: She runs the bake sale, the block committee, and the thing underneath the school gymnasium, and never once raises her voice doing any of it.
creatures.summary: smiling PTA fiend running the block and its secrets

creatures.name: Lawn-Order Enforcer
creatures.flavor: Summoned by an unspoken covenant among homeowners, it trims anything — hedge, weed, or trespasser — that grows past the agreed-upon height.
creatures.summary: covenant-bound guardian, trims anything grown too tall

creatures.name: Master of the Block Party
creatures.flavor: He wears whatever face the street needs to see, grills burgers that taste like every summer you can remember, and only asks for one small thing in return each year.
creatures.summary: shapeshifting host, one small yearly price for paradise

creatures.name: The Substitute Mailman
creatures.flavor: He's delivered mail on this route since before anyone living can remember, always at the exact same minute, and packages addressed to the dead still arrive.
creatures.summary: undead mailman, on-time deliveries for the dead

creatures.name: Development Overseer
creatures.flavor: Built from the bones of the model home nobody bought, it enforces the subdivision's original blueprint, rebuilding whatever the residents dare to change.
creatures.summary: model-home golem enforcing the original blueprint

creatures.name: The Neighborhood Watch Itself
creatures.flavor: Not a person but a consensus — the collective suspicion of every curtain-twitching resident fused into one entity that reads minds through window glass.
creatures.summary: the hive-mind of curtain-twitchers, reading through glass

creatures.name: The First Homeowner
creatures.flavor: Buried under the foundation of the very first house on the street, he built the whole subdivision as his afterlife and considers every current resident a tenant who owes back rent in something other than money.
creatures.summary: the founder's corpse, landlord of the whole afterlife

creatures.name: The Idea of Sunday
creatures.flavor: A god of clipped hedges and identical doors given a single vast eye that never blinks, dreaming the whole suburb into looping perfection, one repeated day at a time — waking it means the wrongness stops keeping regular hours.
creatures.summary: the unblinking eye dreaming the loop into place

creatures.name: Latchkey Shade
creatures.flavor: The lingering print of a kid who let himself in every day after school and never quite left; scuttles across empty kitchen counters after dark.
creatures.summary: Small unseen presence that rattles empty houses at dusk

creatures.name: Storm-Drain Grabber
creatures.flavor: A wet, whispering thing that lives where the curb meets the culvert, luring lost balls and lost kids alike with a friendly voice from the dark.
creatures.summary: Whispers from storm drains, lures children with a friendly voice

creatures.name: Rerun Wraith
creatures.flavor: Bound to a living-room armchair, endlessly rewatching the same three channels; anyone who sits too long starts rewatching with it.
creatures.summary: Armchair-bound ghost that traps watchers in endless reruns

creatures.name: Chain-Link Fence-Walker
creatures.flavor: Something that moves along backyard fence-lines on all fours, always one yard over from wherever you're looking.
creatures.summary: Skulks along fence-lines just out of direct sight

creatures.name: Popped-Collar Poltergeist
creatures.flavor: The restless spirit of the neighborhood's self-appointed cool kid, still slamming screen doors and flipping bike kickstands for an audience that stopped watching decades ago.
creatures.summary: Restless spirit slamming doors, showing off for no one

creatures.name: Newspaper Route Revenant
creatures.flavor: Still pedaling the same route at 5 a.m., flinging rolled papers that thud like fists through screen doors.
creatures.summary: Undead paperboy still riding a route no one ordered

creatures.name: Static-Screen Watcher
creatures.flavor: A face that surfaces in the snow between channels on old console TVs, staring out until someone stares back.
creatures.summary: Face surfaces in TV static, watches whoever watches it

creatures.name: Trash Night Ghoul
creatures.flavor: Drags the cans to the curb every Tuesday out of decades-old habit, and drags anything else it finds in the yard right along with them.
creatures.summary: Compulsive undead trash-day ritual, drags off what it finds

creatures.name: Garage Sale Ghast
creatures.flavor: Haggles over folding tables of dead people's belongings, and won't let a customer leave without buying something of theirs instead.
creatures.summary: Undead haggler who trades your belongings for its junk

creatures.name: Split-Level Skulker
creatures.flavor: A pack-hunter that has learned split-level floor plans intimately, cutting people off between the sunken den and the stairs.
creatures.summary: Pack hunter that ambushes through split-level stairwells

creatures.name: Rec-Room Rug Thing
creatures.flavor: The shag carpet in the finished basement never quite matched the room; it waits for bare feet to wander in during commercials.
creatures.summary: Shag basement carpet that smothers unwary bare feet

creatures.name: Backyard Above-Ground Pool Thing
creatures.flavor: Something moved into the cloudy above-ground pool nobody's cleaned since June; it only surfaces once the pump shuts off for the night.
creatures.summary: Cloudy backyard pool hides something that surfaces at night

creatures.name: Wrong-Number Screamer
creatures.flavor: Calls the house phone at 3 a.m. insisting you have the wrong number, then insists it's already inside.
creatures.summary: Phantom prank caller that claims it's already in the house

creatures.name: Cul-de-Sac Bike Gang Ghost
creatures.flavor: Three or four spectral kids on banana-seat bikes circling a cul-de-sac forever, daring anyone new to join the loop.
creatures.summary: Ghost bike gang circling forever, daring new kids to join

creatures.name: Aluminum Siding Stalker
creatures.flavor: A suit of cheap siding panels clatters upright behind you on the sidewalk, keeping perfect pace whenever you don't look back.
creatures.summary: Siding-panel construct that paces you when you don't look

creatures.name: Van with No Windows
creatures.flavor: It idles at the curb with the engine running and the side door already sliding open, going nowhere until someone gets close enough to look inside.
creatures.summary: Idling windowless van, door sliding open on its own

creatures.name: Ding-Dong-Ditch Devil
creatures.flavor: A small, gleeful horror that rings the bell and vanishes, leaving a scorched handprint on the door and a worse mark on whoever answers too slowly.
creatures.summary: Gleeful imp that rings and runs, leaves a scorched handprint

creatures.name: Toybox Escapee
creatures.flavor: A wind-up toy that wound itself up once too often and never wound back down; it patrols under the bed with clockwork patience.
creatures.summary: Self-winding toy that patrols under the bed relentlessly

creatures.name: Curbside Furniture Fiend
creatures.flavor: That free couch someone left at the curb with a 'FREE' sign taped on has been eating whoever tries to carry it home.
creatures.summary: Free curbside couch that eats whoever tries to take it

creatures.name: Overgrown Hedge Maze Beast
creatures.flavor: The decorative hedge maze behind the model home was never finished being trimmed, and something learned to live in the unfinished parts.
creatures.summary: Untrimmed hedge maze conceals something living in the gaps

creatures.name: Sun-Bleached Lawn Jockey
creatures.flavor: A faded plaster lawn ornament that turns its painted eyes to track anyone who cuts across the grass instead of using the walk.
creatures.summary: Faded lawn statue that turns to track trespassers

creatures.name: Backyard Above-Ground Deep One Spawn
creatures.flavor: A smaller relation of the thing in the pool, gone hunting on land for the first time, still learning to walk on the lawn.
creatures.summary: Young pool-thing spawn awkwardly hunting on dry lawn

creatures.name: Meter Reader Mimic
creatures.flavor: Wears the utility company's polo and clipboard perfectly, and always asks to be let around back where nobody can see from the street.
creatures.summary: Fake utility worker that always asks to go around back

creatures.name: Skateboard Ramp Wight
creatures.flavor: Died trying to land the big trick off the plywood ramp behind the school and still practices, endlessly, on anyone who gets close.
creatures.summary: Undead skater endlessly practicing the trick that killed it

creatures.name: Backyard Bug-Zapper Wisp
creatures.flavor: A crackle of blue light that escaped the porch zapper and now hunts anything warm-blooded that wanders the yard after dark.
creatures.summary: Escaped bug-zapper spark that hunts warm bodies at night

creatures.name: Video Store Return-Slot Horror
creatures.flavor: Something lives in the drop slot of the video rental place, and every tape fed back through comes out changed, and so does the hand that fed it.
creatures.summary: Rental drop-slot horror that changes whatever it swallows

creatures.name: Arcade Cabinet Haunt
creatures.flavor: A high score that was never beaten, and the kid who set it, both still lit up behind the screen glass long after closing.
creatures.summary: Ghost of an unbeaten high-scorer, lit inside the cabinet

creatures.name: Mall Food Court Ooze
creatures.flavor: A slow, syrupy mass that oozes between the food court tables at closing time, absorbing spilled soda, dropped fries, and the occasional straggler.
creatures.summary: Slow food-court ooze that absorbs stragglers after closing

creatures.name: Backyard Trampoline Terror
creatures.flavor: It burrowed up under the trampoline springs and now bounces kids skyward on purpose, waiting to see who doesn't land right.
creatures.summary: Burrowing thing under a trampoline that overbounces kids on purpose

creatures.name: Home Alarm Banshee
creatures.flavor: Trips every motion sensor in the house at once, its wail indistinguishable from — and worse than — the alarm it triggers.
creatures.summary: Alarm-triggering wraith whose wail is worse than the siren

creatures.name: The Family Wearing the Skin (Understudy)
creatures.flavor: A lesser cousin of the perfect-family horror down the street — close enough to pass at a barbecue, not close enough to pass close up.
creatures.summary: Lesser copycat family-thing, close but not quite convincing

creatures.name: Handyman Who Never Leaves
creatures.flavor: Hired for one gutter job three summers ago, his truck's still in the driveway and he's always got one more thing that needs fixing inside.
creatures.summary: Contractor who never finishes the job or leaves the house

creatures.name: The Substitute Teacher
creatures.flavor: Fills in for a week at a time across a dozen schools, and every class she covers loses one kid to absence that never gets explained.
creatures.summary: Roving fiend-teacher whose classes always lose a student

creatures.name: Split-Shift Shapeshifter
creatures.flavor: Works the graveyard shift at the all-night gas station and something else's shift after that; the clerk's smile never quite sits right.
creatures.summary: Gas station night clerk with a shift no human works

creatures.name: Riding-Mower Revenant, Deluxe Model
creatures.flavor: A newer, meaner riding mower haunts the HOA's model-home block, chasing anyone whose lawn falls out of regulation.
creatures.summary: Upgraded haunted mower that enforces HOA lawn regulations

creatures.name: The Man in the Ice Cream Truck
creatures.flavor: His jingle plays even when the truck's parked and empty; kids who chase the sound too far never quite come back the same.
creatures.summary: Ice-cream-truck fiend whose jingle lures kids away

creatures.name: Backyard Bonfire Cultist Circle
creatures.flavor: A ring of neighbors around a burn barrel every full moon, feeding it things that were never supposed to burn that clean.
creatures.summary: Neighbor cult burning offerings in a backyard barrel

creatures.name: The Coach Who Never Ages
creatures.flavor: Has led the same little-league team for twenty-two straight seasons and looks exactly as he did in the first team photo.
creatures.summary: Ageless little-league coach spanning two decades unchanged

creatures.name: Skin-Deep Scoutmaster
creatures.flavor: Leads camping trips into the woods behind the development and always brings back one fewer kid than he took, plus one new smile.
creatures.summary: Doppelganger scoutmaster who returns from trips one kid short

creatures.name: The Perfect Father Next Door
creatures.flavor: Never misses a game, always has the grill going, and keeps a locked shed out back that the whole street has learned not to mention.
creatures.summary: Model neighborhood father with a shed nobody mentions

creatures.name: Static-Cling Poltergeist Swarm
creatures.flavor: A house full of small hauntings — flickering nightlights, cold spots, moved keys — that only reveal themselves as one coordinated thing when cornered.
creatures.summary: House-wide micro-hauntings that unify into one coordinated threat

creatures.name: Cursed Above-Ground Deep One Broodmother
creatures.flavor: The original pool-thing from three doors down, matured and spawning; the whole cul-de-sac's chlorine budget has quietly tripled.
creatures.summary: Matured pool-horror now spawning across the cul-de-sac

creatures.name: Renovation Golem, Load-Bearing Model
creatures.flavor: Built from mismatched drywall, salvaged studs, and whatever the last flip-house crew left behind, animated by a contractor's shortcut curse.
creatures.summary: Drywall-and-lumber golem built from a shortcut renovation curse

creatures.name: The Photo Album Hag
creatures.flavor: Collects family photo albums door to door for 'the historical society' and edits herself into every family that lets her keep one.
creatures.summary: Photo-collecting hag who edits herself into family albums

creatures.name: The Neighborhood Watch Captain
creatures.flavor: Patrols at all hours in a golf cart with a spotlight, and somehow always knows exactly what happened behind every closed door on the block.
creatures.summary: All-seeing patrol captain who knows every closed-door secret

creatures.name: Backyard Above-Ground Pool Shark
creatures.flavor: Something with far too many teeth for a four-foot pool has been circling under the vinyl liner since the last pool party.
creatures.summary: Oversized predator circling under a backyard pool's liner

creatures.name: The Ham Radio Operator
creatures.flavor: Runs a shortwave rig in the attic that picks up something answering back that was never broadcasting from anywhere on Earth's dial.
creatures.summary: Attic ham-radio operator receiving transmissions from nowhere

creatures.name: The PTA Vice President
creatures.flavor: Second-in-command to the block's real horror, buzzing between bake sales gathering names for a list nobody's seen the end of.
creatures.summary: PTA lieutenant gathering names for an unseen master list

creatures.name: Backyard Grill Fire Elemental
creatures.flavor: Someone's charcoal grill fire never went out after the block party; it's been cooking ever since, and it's still hungry.
creatures.summary: Never-extinguished grill fire that's still hungry to cook

creatures.name: The Cul-de-Sac's Second Family
creatures.flavor: A many-limbed thing that arranges itself into a mother, father, and two kids for the length of a driveway conversation, then unfolds once the door shuts.
creatures.summary: Multi-limbed horror that assembles into a fake nuclear family

creatures.name: Lawn-Order Enforcer, Senior Patrol
creatures.flavor: The block's original code-enforcement golem has been promoted; it now issues citations that are also curses.
creatures.summary: Promoted HOA golem whose citations double as curses

creatures.name: The Block Party Ringmaster
creatures.flavor: Organizes the annual street party with unnerving precision, down to exactly who disappears in the bounce-house line each year.
creatures.summary: Block-party organizer who plans a yearly disappearance

creatures.name: Attic Insulation Horror
creatures.flavor: Something moved into the pink fiberglass batting between the joists decades ago and has been slowly widening the crawlspace ever since.
creatures.summary: Attic-dwelling horror slowly widening the crawlspace over decades

creatures.name: Master of the Costume Party
creatures.flavor: Hosts the block's annual costume bash wearing a mask indistinguishable from a face, and everyone who wins 'best costume' stops being seen after.
creatures.summary: Costume-party host whose winners are never seen again

creatures.name: The Substitute Mailman's Supervisor
creatures.flavor: Oversees the whole route from an unmarked postal truck, delivering something to every house that requested nothing.
creatures.summary: Route supervisor delivering unsolicited packages to every house

creatures.name: Development Overseer, Phase Two
creatures.flavor: Built from the foundation slabs of the houses that never got finished, it's been quietly grading a lot that isn't on any map.
creatures.summary: Slab-built golem grading a phantom lot off the map

creatures.name: The First HOA Board
creatures.flavor: Five founding board members, still convening in the clubhouse basement, still voting unanimously on ordinances no living resident agreed to.
creatures.summary: Undead HOA founders still voting on ordinances forever

creatures.name: The Perfect Family, Fully Grown
creatures.flavor: What the skin-wearing family becomes once it stops bothering to look like four separate people at all.
creatures.summary: Skin-family horror that stopped pretending to be separate people

creatures.name: The Neighborhood Watch, Fully Awake
creatures.flavor: Every porch light on the block is one of its eyes now, and it has stopped just watching.
creatures.summary: Block-wide surveillance horror that has begun to act

creatures.name: The Substitute Principal
creatures.flavor: Called in to run the school when the real principal 'took leave,' she rewrites detention slips into something closer to binding contracts.
creatures.summary: Fill-in principal whose detention slips are binding contracts

creatures.name: Superstore Overnight Stock Horror
creatures.flavor: Something restocks the strip-mall superstore's shelves after close, in patterns that spell out things in the aisle layout by morning.
creatures.summary: Overnight stocker that spells warnings in the aisle layout

creatures.name: The Cable Guy Who Was Never Scheduled
creatures.flavor: Shows up during the four-hour window nobody actually booked, and every house he services starts picking up channels that don't exist.
creatures.summary: Uninvited cable installer who tunes homes to impossible channels

creatures.name: The First Family of the Development
creatures.flavor: Buried under the model home's foundation when the development broke ground, and the whole subdivision was built as its reliquary.
creatures.summary: Founder-family entombed beneath the model home's foundation

creatures.name: The Idea of a Perfect Lawn
creatures.flavor: An ideal so total it's grown roots under every yard on the block, pruning any resident who lets their grass get too tall — or too green.
creatures.summary: Root-system ideal that prunes any lawn that stands out

creatures.name: The Last Bell of the School Year
creatures.flavor: A dismissal bell that never actually let the last class out; it's been ringing the same three-o'clock chime under the school for generations.
creatures.summary: Eternal dismissal bell that never released its final class

creatures.name: The Whole Street, Awake
creatures.flavor: Every house on the cul-de-sac turns out to be one organism wearing driveways for a face, and it has just noticed it has neighbors watching back.
creatures.summary: Whole cul-de-sac revealed as one house-wearing organism

creatures.name: The Idea of Back-to-School Night
creatures.flavor: An institutional dread so vast it manifests once a year in the gymnasium, wearing every parent and teacher's worst version of themselves at once.
creatures.summary: Annual gymnasium dread wearing everyone's worst self at once

creatures.name: The Development That Was Never Finished
creatures.flavor: The developer who went bankrupt mid-build bound his own unfinished vision into undeath, and the empty lots are still filling in on their own schedule.
creatures.summary: Bankrupt developer's undying will still building empty lots

creatures.name: Backyard Tetherball Wisp
creatures.flavor: A pale light that spins around the pole where the tetherball snapped off years ago, still keeping score against an opponent who left.
creatures.summary: Ghost light endlessly circling a broken tetherball pole

creatures.name: Split-Level Basement Ooze
creatures.flavor: Seeped up through the unfinished basement's floor drain during the last big storm and never seeped back down.
creatures.summary: Basement floor-drain ooze that never receded after a storm

creatures.name: Trick-or-Treat Bag Snatcher
creatures.flavor: Darts between porch lights on Halloween swapping good candy for something that was never meant to be eaten.
creatures.summary: Halloween sprite that swaps candy for something inedible

creatures.name: The Kid Who Never Came Home
creatures.flavor: Still riding his bike home past curfew, every night, along the exact route where he was last seen thirty years ago.
creatures.summary: Ghost child endlessly biking his last-seen route home

creatures.name: Backyard Above-Ground Pool Leech Swarm
creatures.flavor: Something split off from the main pool-thing into dozens of smaller, blood-hungry pieces after the last shock treatment.
creatures.summary: Splintered pool-horror fragments swarming as biting leeches

creatures.name: Little League Bleacher Ghoul
creatures.flavor: Sits in the same bleacher seat at every game, cheering a team that stopped existing after the field closed, and eyeing the concession stand.
creatures.summary: Undead superfan haunting a closed field's bleachers

creatures.name: Backyard Fireworks Mephit
creatures.flavor: Sparked to unlife from a dud bottle rocket on the Fourth, it's been looking for something bigger to detonate ever since.
creatures.summary: Dud-firework mephit hunting for something bigger to ignite

creatures.name: The Man in the Rubber Mask
creatures.flavor: He doesn't run, doesn't talk, and the mask never quite fits his face right — like it's a size too small for whatever's under it. Cuts power to the block before he starts.
creatures.summary: Silent knife-stalker in a rubber mask, cuts the power first
creatures.sourceNote: stock slasher-archetype (unmasked, unnamed stalker type — no specific franchise silhouette)

creatures.name: The Neighbor Who Isn't
creatures.flavor: Waters the lawn at 2 AM. Smiles too wide at the mailbox. Something wears the neighbor like a coat that's still learning how elbows work.
creatures.summary: A neighbor replaced, wearing the body a little wrong
creatures.sourceNote: body-snatcher/pod-person stock archetype (generic, no specific 50s-film IP)

creatures.name: The Homeowners' Association
creatures.flavor: Matching cardigans, identical lawns, a smile that's a citation waiting to happen. They vote unanimously. They vote for you next.
creatures.summary: Cul-de-sac conformity cult in matching cardigans
creatures.sourceNote: too-perfect-family/HOA conformity archetype, original

creatures.name: The Thing in the Storm Drain
creatures.flavor: It doesn't need a face because the neighborhood kids provide the imagination for it. Rains bring it up from the culvert; the culvert never quite drains right after.
creatures.summary: Shapeless lurker that surfaces through storm drains after rain
creatures.sourceNote: under-the-street / storm-drain lurker stock archetype (deliberately not the well-known clown)

creatures.name: The Thing Under the Bed
creatures.flavor: Only exists between the mattress and the floor, and only when the light's off. Every kid on the block has independently drawn the same picture of it.
creatures.summary: Blind floor-level lurker only real in the dark
creatures.sourceNote: under-the-bed/closet-monster nursery archetype, original design

creatures.name: Static Bride
creatures.flavor: Stitched back together from parts that never asked to be a set. Every TV on the block snows over when she walks past; she's looking for the hands that made her.
creatures.summary: Reanimated stitched-together undead bride, disrupts electronics
creatures.sourceNote: the Bride/animated-corpse motif — Shelley's Frankenstein (1818, PD) & 19th-c. reanimation folklore, NOT any studio's visual design

creatures.name: The Man Who Sold the House
creatures.flavor: Every family on this street signed something they didn't read. He still holds the paper, and the paper is still due.
creatures.summary: Devil-bargain realtor collecting on unread contracts
creatures.sourceNote: deal-with-the-devil / crossroads-bargain motif — universal folklore + Faust legend (pre-1929 tellings, PD)

creatures.name: Medusa of the Mall
creatures.flavor: Works the perfume counter under fluorescent light that never shows her eyes. The food court has forty statues who lingered too long at her register.
creatures.summary: Mythic Gorgon relocated to the dead mall's cosmetics counter
creatures.sourceNote: Medusa — Greek myth (Ovid, Metamorphoses, ancient/PD); OUR setting recontext, not any film design

creatures.name: The Kraken in the Deep End
creatures.flavor: The community pool closed for 'renovations' in 1983 and never reopened. Something ancient and briny decided the deep end was close enough to home.
