creatures.summary: Ancient sea-legend leviathan squatting in a condemned pool
creatures.sourceNote: the Kraken — Norse/Scandinavian sea-legend (pre-modern folklore, PD)

creatures.name: The Toy That Loves You Back
creatures.flavor: Batteries not included, malice included free. It waits on the shelf all day, perfectly still, counting whose room it's going to be in tonight.
creatures.summary: Possessed toy that relocates itself to your room at night
creatures.sourceNote: cursed-toy/possessed-plaything archetype, original design (no specific doll-franchise likeness)

creatures.name: The Refrigerator That Remembers
creatures.flavor: Hums a little too rhythmically. Keeps things fresh that shouldn't still be recognizable. The ice maker only runs when no one's watching.
creatures.summary: Cursed kitchen appliance that preserves things unnaturally
creatures.sourceNote: cursed-appliance archetype, original design

creatures.name: The Arcade Cabinet with One More Life
creatures.flavor: High score never changes because the last kid who beat it never left the arcade. It only takes quarters, and it always has exact change waiting in the slot.
creatures.summary: Haunted arcade cabinet that keeps its high-scorer
creatures.sourceNote: cursed-arcade-machine archetype, original design (generic 'haunted cabinet,' no specific game IP)

creatures.name: The Babysitter's Watcher
creatures.flavor: He's already inside before the phone rings the second time. The kids upstairs are fine. He just wanted her to know he could've stopped that.
creatures.summary: Home-invader who calls from inside the house first
creatures.sourceNote: stalker-on-the-phone-in-the-house urban-legend archetype, original (the call-is-coming-from-inside trope, generic)

creatures.name: The Cul-de-Sac Werething
creatures.flavor: Coaches Little League. Grills every Sunday. On the full moon the whole street knows to keep the dog in and not ask questions in the morning.
creatures.summary: Suburban werewolf-neighbor, folklore lycanthropy in a cul-de-sac
creatures.sourceNote: European werewolf/lycanthropy folk tradition (settled, non-Indigenous, widely public-domain in literary form)

creatures.name: Renfield of Maple Court
creatures.flavor: Eats bugs off the porch and swears the new guy in the house at the end of the block 'just needs some time to settle in.' He's very devoted.
creatures.summary: Thrall-servant mook, devoted to something unseen in the house
creatures.sourceNote: Renfield — Stoker's Dracula (1897, PD), the servant/thrall archetype specifically, not Dracula himself

creatures.name: The Count of the Cul-de-Sac
creatures.flavor: Bought the biggest house on the block in cash, never during daylight hours. Invites you in exactly once. That's all he needs.
creatures.summary: Stoker-lineage vampire lord who bought the biggest house in cash
creatures.sourceNote: Stoker's Dracula (1897, PD) — the literary vampire lord, our own suburban recontext, not any film's visual design

creatures.name: The Skeleton in Every Closet
creatures.flavor: Every house on the street has one, and every family swears it's a coincidence. It rattles the coat hangers when the furnace kicks on.
creatures.summary: Literal skeleton-in-the-closet, one per household
creatures.sourceNote: generic reanimated skeleton — folkloric/literary undead, no owner, ancient stock motif

creatures.name: The Lawn Ornament That Turned
creatures.flavor: Every yard has one — gnome, birdbath cherub, plastic flamingo. They hold still for the mail carrier. They don't hold still for you.
creatures.summary: Animated yard-decor ambush predator, still until you're alone
creatures.sourceNote: animated-yard-decor archetype (garden gnome / gargoyle-adjacent, original), stone-creature motif is ancient/uncopyrightable

creatures.name: The Debt Collector
creatures.flavor: Wears a windbreaker and carries a clipboard. Every house owes him something eventually — a memory, a name, a Sunday afternoon. He always collects on schedule.
creatures.summary: Folkloric collector-of-debts undead, clipboard and windbreaker
creatures.sourceNote: psychopomp / grim-collector folk motif (universal death-messenger tradition, settled and non-Indigenous)

creatures.name: The PTA
creatures.flavor: They vote as one, speak in overlapping half-sentences, and know your kid's grades before you do. Disagreement is not on the agenda.
creatures.summary: Hive-mind swarm of identical, over-informed suburban parents
creatures.sourceNote: hive-mind conformity-swarm archetype, original (mundane-turned-wrong social horror, no IP basis)

creatures.name: Static-Born Whelp
creatures.flavor: A newborn scrap of the drowned language given a body — it chitters half a syllable of an unfinishable name and forgets the rest instantly.
creatures.summary: tiny drowned-language larva, forgets its own half-word

creatures.name: Deep-Kin Netcaster
creatures.flavor: A fish-eyed coastal breed that traded air-breathing kin for something below the tide line generations back; drags nets full of things that aren't fish.
creatures.summary: gilled fish-hybrid raider, classic deep-one coastal breed

creatures.name: Echo-Faced Pilgrim
creatures.flavor: A cultist of the answering wonder, face rearranged toward whatever last spoke to it; still mostly a person, technically.
creatures.summary: robed cultist, face slowly reshaping toward its god

creatures.name: Angle-Wrong Creeper
creatures.flavor: Geometry that argues with itself — from one side a stalactite, from the other a limb; it never resolves, and neither does what it bites.
creatures.summary: non-Euclidean ambush lurker, wrong from every angle

creatures.name: Star-Spat Larva
creatures.flavor: Fell out of the sky still warm from somewhere with no sky of its own; smothers first, digests the question of why later.
creatures.summary: star-spawn hatchling, smothers before it thinks

creatures.name: Choir-Static Wisp
creatures.flavor: A sound with no source, given just enough shape to annoy you; it hums the drowned language slightly off-key, forever.
creatures.summary: formless droning noise-wisp, hums the wrong language

creatures.name: Shoggoth Spawnling
creatures.flavor: A gray, roiling mass no bigger than a barrel, budding eyes and mouths it doesn't keep for long; the full-grown thing it's shed from is somewhere close, and larger.
creatures.summary: eye-budding protoplasmic mass, shoggoth in miniature

creatures.name: Vault-Drift Serf
creatures.flavor: Recruited off some drowned world's docks generations back; still bows at the old angles, still hears the old choir.
creatures.summary: generational cult serf, still bows to the old angles

creatures.name: Gravel-Star Mite
creatures.flavor: A star-spawn splinter no bigger than a dog, all beak and impossible joint-count; petrifies with a look it doesn't understand having.
creatures.summary: small star-spawn splinter, petrifying gaze it can't explain

creatures.name: Wrong-Angle Watcher
creatures.flavor: A patch of geometry that mutters in every direction at once — approach it and the ground itself seems to disagree with your feet.
creatures.summary: babbling mouth-patch, ground disagrees with your feet

creatures.name: Star-Spawn Grazer
creatures.flavor: Blinks half-in, half-out of the visible world, cropping light like grass; it was probably once something's livestock.
creatures.summary: half-phased star-spawn cattle, grazes on visible light

creatures.name: Tentacled Horror of the Drowned Vault
creatures.flavor: A many-limbed thing that hauls itself up from flooded sub-cellars on a forest of feeling tentacles, paralyzing whatever it touches before it decides what to do with it.
creatures.summary: classic many-tentacled cellar-horror, paralyzing touch

creatures.name: Length-Wrong Herald
creatures.flavor: Speaks the opening of its own name every time it attacks; nobody has heard it finish, and the theory is nobody's meant to.
creatures.summary: herald-thing that attacks mid-syllable of its own name

creatures.name: Basalt Geometer
creatures.flavor: Built by something to enforce angles that don't exist here; every room it stands in slowly stops making sense.
creatures.summary: angle-enforcing construct, warps the room it guards

creatures.name: Star-Drunk Colossus-Kin
creatures.flavor: A giant that drank starlight instead of ale one bad night; too big for this sky, and it knows it, and it's furious about it.
creatures.summary: starlight-drunk giant, too big for this sky

creatures.name: Drowned-Tongue Cantor
creatures.flavor: Learned three words of the drowned language and it was two too many; casts by half-singing syllables that hurt to hear correctly.
creatures.summary: cultist-mage, casts by singing a language that hurts

creatures.name: Devouring Mass of the Drift
creatures.flavor: A shoggoth proper, or near enough — a shifting black bulk crawling with makeshift eyes, dissolving whatever it rolls over and remembering the shape for later.
creatures.summary: black shifting shoggoth-mass, dissolves and remembers shapes

creatures.name: Void-Touched Ascetic
creatures.flavor: Trained a martial discipline built entirely around not looking directly at the thing it worships; occasionally fails.
creatures.summary: void-monk cultist, trained never to look at its god

creatures.name: Between-Star Marauder
creatures.flavor: Rides the seams between named stars, raiding worlds that made the mistake of being finishable sentences.
creatures.summary: star-spawn knight-raider, rides the seams between stars

creatures.name: Choir of the Unbuilt Cathedral
creatures.flavor: A congregation compressed into one body, still arguing internally over doctrine; every attack is a different faction's opinion.
creatures.summary: compressed cult-congregation, attacks argue with each other

creatures.name: Cartographer of Wrong Angles
creatures.flavor: Maps places that don't cohere and insists they're accurate; anyone who reads its charts starts seeing the seams in normal rooms too.
creatures.summary: ancient elder-thing cartographer, maps that unravel minds

creatures.name: Star-Spawn Bishop
creatures.flavor: Ordained by something that doesn't have a mouth to ordain with; its sermons rearrange the listener's sense of up.
creatures.summary: brain-warping star-spawn cleric, sermons rearrange your mind

creatures.name: The Waking Eye Beneath
creatures.flavor: A many-eyed orb the size of a wagon, floating up from some flooded temple-shaft, each stalk-eye reading a different page of a book that hasn't been written yet.
creatures.summary: floating many-eyed orb horror, reads unwritten futures

creatures.name: The Sound With No Source
creatures.model: net-new: a vast half-formed silhouette woven from visible, rippling sound-waves
creatures.flavor: It has never had a body; this one is borrowed, argued-over, and already trying to unbecome itself. When it speaks, the drowned language comes out clean, and something answers from very far away.
creatures.summary: bodiless voice-horror, borrowed shape, something answers back

creatures.name: The Wonder That Answers Back
creatures.model: net-new: a star-scaled orb-and-limb mass whose geometry disagrees with itself
creatures.flavor: The realm's sleeping Great Old One — ask it a question and it answers, correctly, in a name too long to finish; the answer costs you something you didn't offer, every single time.
creatures.summary: the realm's Great-Old-One, a correct answer always costs you

creatures.name: Tide-Slick Grub
creatures.flavor: A finger-length droplet of the drift-mass that never quite dries; it mostly just twitches toward warmth.
creatures.summary: tiny drift-ooze droplet, twitches toward body heat

creatures.name: Drowned-Docks Netboy
creatures.flavor: A child-sized deep-kin runt too small to fish alone; it still tries, hauling nets twice its weight up from the black water.
creatures.summary: runt deep-kin fisher, hauls nets too heavy for it

creatures.name: Salt-Choir Initiate
creatures.flavor: Newly sworn to the drowned congregation; still flinches at its own chanting.
creatures.summary: fresh cult recruit, flinches at its own chanting

creatures.name: Half-Seen Crawler
creatures.flavor: Visible only from certain angles, like a smudge on a lens; the rest of the time it's simply already behind you.
creatures.summary: angle-dependent stalker, only visible from some angles

creatures.name: Nursery-Vault Runt
creatures.flavor: Hatched too early from a drowned egg-clutch, it flits weakly through flooded corridors chirping half a word.
creatures.summary: premature hatchling, flits weakly chirping half a word

creatures.name: Deep-Kin Harpooner
creatures.flavor: A veteran of the coastal breed, favoring a barbed line over a net; drags catch back down whether it's still moving or not.
creatures.summary: veteran gilled harpooner, drags catch down regardless

creatures.name: Cyst of Small Eyes
creatures.flavor: A fist-sized knot of shoggoth-stuff that budded off wrong; it's mostly eyes, and none of them blink together.
creatures.summary: palm-sized eye-cluster ooze bud, eyes never blink together

creatures.name: Static-Fed Familiar
creatures.flavor: Kept as a pet by a cantor who feeds it half-heard words; it grows fat on syllables and thin on silence.
creatures.summary: cult-kept static wisp, fattens on half-heard words

creatures.name: Barnacle-Grown Thrall
creatures.flavor: So long submerged in service that crustacean growth has fused to its joints; it still kneels on schedule.
creatures.summary: barnacle-crusted cult thrall, still kneels on schedule

creatures.name: Wharf-Rot Feeler
creatures.flavor: Clings under piers where the water goes the wrong color; drops when something warm walks overhead.
creatures.summary: pier-dwelling smother-thing, drops on warm footsteps

creatures.name: Star-Chipped Hatchling
creatures.flavor: A splinter no bigger than a housecat, all needle-mouth, that fell alongside something much worse and hasn't found it yet.
creatures.summary: tiny star-fallen splinter, still searching for its parent

creatures.name: Wrong-Count Mimicker
creatures.flavor: Copies the shape of ordinary things nearby, but always gets the number of legs, teeth, or windows slightly off.
creatures.summary: shape-mimic with a miscounted number of features

creatures.name: Choking Reef Polyp
creatures.flavor: Grows on drowned altars like coral, lashing anything that lingers too near the offering bowl.
creatures.summary: altar-bound polyp growth, lashes at loitering worshippers

creatures.name: Bell-Tongued Herald-Runt
creatures.flavor: A messenger-thing that rings when it moves, each toll a fragment of a summons nobody asked for.
creatures.summary: bell-ringing messenger aberration, tolls unwanted summons

creatures.name: Kelp-Draped Netcaster
creatures.flavor: Senior among the coastal breed, trailing kelp like a cloak; commands the smaller netcasters without a word.
creatures.summary: senior deep-kin overseer, commands netcasters silently

creatures.name: Choir-Bound Flagellant
creatures.flavor: Whips itself in time with a rhythm only it can hear, certain the pain is a kind of tuning.
creatures.summary: self-flagellating cultist, tunes itself to unheard rhythm

creatures.name: Star-Spat Grazer-Calf
creatures.flavor: A juvenile star-spawn beast, still mostly solid, cropping light-motes out of the air with a beak too wide for its skull.
creatures.summary: juvenile star-spawn beast, crops light-motes from the air

creatures.name: Drift-Snarled Netling
creatures.flavor: Ooze tangled with actual fishing net dragged up from the deep; it hunts by dragging the net behind it like a lure.
creatures.summary: net-tangled ooze, drags its own net as a lure

creatures.name: Fathom-Whisper Cultist
creatures.flavor: Hears the drowned language in running water and repeats fragments of it to anyone standing near a fountain.
creatures.summary: fountain-side cultist, repeats fragments it hears in water

creatures.name: Rib-Cracked Thrall-Sergeant
creatures.flavor: Broken and reset so many times in service that its posture is permanently wrong; it fights like the pain already happened.
creatures.summary: repeatedly-broken cult enforcer, fights past its own pain

creatures.name: Gravel-Star Broodmite Swarm
creatures.flavor: A clutch of star-spawn splinters hatched together, moving as one twitching, beaking mass.
creatures.summary: clutch of tiny star-spawn splinters, moves as one mass

creatures.name: Basalt Chanter-Construct
creatures.flavor: An empty suit of vault-armor that hums the drowned language through its helm slit, walking patrol for masters long dissolved.
creatures.summary: empty armor construct, hums drowned language on patrol

creatures.name: Slack-Jawed Deep-Kin Brute
creatures.flavor: Muscle bred for hauling nets the size of houses; its jaw unhinges when it's excited, which is often.
creatures.summary: heavyset deep-kin muscle, jaw unhinges when excited

creatures.name: Two-Faced Pilgrim
creatures.flavor: A pilgrim whose reshaping went further than most — it now wears two faces at once, arguing about which one is real.
creatures.summary: double-faced cultist, argues with itself about which face is real

creatures.name: Void-Touched Novice
creatures.flavor: Just beginning the discipline of not-looking; its eyes are already starting to film over from the strain.
creatures.summary: beginner void-monk, eyes already filming over

creatures.name: Length-Wrong Runt
creatures.flavor: A smaller cousin of the heralds, its half-syllable attacks are weaker, but it never seems to run out of breath.
creatures.summary: minor herald-cousin, half-syllable attacks and endless breath

creatures.name: Foam-Bled Zealot
creatures.flavor: Foams at the mouth reciting the opening verse of a hymn with no known end; convinced finishing it would be a mercy.
creatures.summary: foaming zealot, recites an unfinishable hymn as devotion

creatures.name: Coil-Fused Netwife
creatures.flavor: A deep-kin matriarch whose lower half has fused into something more eel than leg; she never stops weaving new nets.
creatures.summary: eel-legged deep-kin matriarch, endlessly weaves new nets

creatures.name: Undertow Grapple-Thing
creatures.flavor: Waits in the flooded dark of vault stairwells, a barbed tentacle-mass that hauls the careless down before they can shout.
creatures.summary: stairwell tentacle-ambusher, hauls victims into flooded dark

creatures.name: Reef-Bone Sentinel
creatures.flavor: Drowned centuries ago, its bones now grown through with coral in patterns that spell fragments of the old choir.
creatures.summary: coral-grown drowned skeleton, bones spell hymn fragments

creatures.name: Choir-Static Swarm
creatures.flavor: Dozens of noise-wisps flocking together, their combined drone loud enough to make teeth ache.
creatures.summary: flocking noise-wisp swarm, drone loud enough to hurt teeth

creatures.name: Wrongly-Jointed Fisherman
creatures.flavor: Once a fisherman, its elbows and knees now bend an extra way; it casts a line with unsettling, extra reach.
creatures.summary: extra-jointed ex-fisherman, casts lines with unnatural reach

creatures.name: Depth-Warped Enforcer
creatures.flavor: Cult muscle whose limbs have started growing extra joints from prolonged proximity to the choir; it hits harder than its size suggests it should.
creatures.summary: joint-warped cult enforcer, hits harder than it should

creatures.name: Herald of the First Syllable
creatures.flavor: A floating brain-mass trailing paralytic tendrils, forever mid-utterance of a name it will never complete.
creatures.summary: floating tendriled brain-thing, forever mid-utterance

creatures.name: Vault-Warden Ooze
creatures.flavor: A perfectly geometric mass that patrols flooded vault corridors, absorbing anything that doesn't know the passphrase.
creatures.summary: geometric ooze sentry, absorbs anyone lacking the passphrase

creatures.name: Basalt Geometer-Scout
creatures.flavor: A lighter cousin of the geometer-constructs, sent ahead to survey rooms before the angle-work begins.
creatures.summary: scout construct, surveys rooms ahead of angle-warping work

creatures.name: Deep-Kin War Priest
creatures.flavor: Leads coastal-breed raids with hymnals bound in dried skin no one asks about; blesses spears with water that shouldn't move like that.
creatures.summary: gilled war-priest, blesses spears with wrongly-moving water

creatures.name: Amalgam of Borrowed Limbs
creatures.flavor: Stitched together from whatever the tide brought — none of the limbs match, and it hasn't noticed yet.
creatures.summary: tide-stitched limb-amalgam, mismatched parts unnoticed by it

creatures.name: Star-Spawn Broodcaller
creatures.flavor: Sings a summoning fragment that draws smaller splinters from wherever they've been hiding; never fights alone if it can help it.
creatures.summary: star-spawn summoner, calls splinters to its side

creatures.name: Choir-Grown Ooze Sculptor
creatures.flavor: Reshapes itself into crude mimicries of drowned architecture, humming while it works, dissolving anyone who interrupts.
creatures.summary: self-sculpting ooze mimic, dissolves interrupting witnesses

creatures.name: Vault-Drift Overseer
creatures.flavor: Generations deep in cult service, cracking a whip woven from something that used to be rope and now isn't quite.
creatures.summary: veteran cult overseer, whip woven from something not-quite-rope

creatures.name: Reef-Choked Behemoth-Calf
creatures.flavor: A drowned-world beast bred to guard the choir's flooded vaults, coral growing through its hide like armor.
creatures.summary: coral-armored guard-beast, bred to protect flooded vaults

creatures.name: Nine-Eyed Cyst
creatures.flavor: A budding growth of eyes on a fleshy stalk, each seeing a slightly different version of the same room.
creatures.summary: nine-eyed stalk-growth, each eye sees a different version of the room

creatures.name: Choir-Marked Berserker
creatures.flavor: Fights in an arena the cult built beneath the tide line, scars spelling out fragments of hymn across its back.
creatures.summary: arena fighter, scars spell hymn fragments across its back

creatures.name: Devouring Choir-Cyst
creatures.flavor: Feeds on offerings left at flooded shrines, growing new mouths for every prayer it swallows.
creatures.summary: shrine-fed cyst, grows a new mouth per swallowed prayer

creatures.name: Star-Chewed Roc-Kin
creatures.flavor: A sky-beast whose migratory path drifted through somewhere it shouldn't have; it still flies, but its shadow lags a half-second behind.
creatures.summary: drift-touched sky-beast, shadow lags behind its own flight

creatures.name: Wrong-Season Roper
creatures.flavor: Grows in caverns where the drift touched the stone; its strands taste like the inside of a closed mouth.
creatures.summary: drift-grown ropy ambusher, strands taste of a closed mouth

creatures.name: Reef-Fused War Elemental
creatures.flavor: Water given form by the same wrongness that grows coral over drowned bones; it moves like tide, but with intent.
creatures.summary: drift-touched water elemental, moves with unnerving intent

creatures.name: Coral-Throned Cult Matron
creatures.flavor: Conducts the drowned hymn from a throne grown out of living reef, directing worshippers like an orchestra of dread.
creatures.summary: reef-throned choir conductor, directs worshippers like an orchestra

creatures.name: Star-Warped Chimera-Thing
creatures.flavor: Three creatures fused by the same accident that dropped its kin from the sky, each head disagreeing about what it is.
creatures.summary: triple-fused star-warped beast, heads disagree about its nature

creatures.name: Choir-Bound Invisible Watcher
creatures.flavor: Bound to the choir by a pact it can't remember making, hunting silently for anyone who stops believing on schedule.
creatures.summary: bound invisible hunter, tracks lapsed believers

creatures.name: Bone-Grown Cathedral Skeleton
creatures.flavor: A drowned guardian whose bones have fused with the architecture it once protected; moving it means moving the wall.
creatures.summary: architecture-fused drowned guardian skeleton

creatures.name: Void-Trained Duelist
creatures.flavor: Advanced past the ascetics in the not-looking discipline; it fights with eyes fully closed and somehow never misses.
creatures.summary: advanced void-monk duelist, fights blind and never misses

creatures.name: Warlord of the Sunken Court
creatures.flavor: A giant sworn to the drowned choir generations back, its stonework now grown through with the same wrong coral as the vaults it guards.
creatures.summary: coral-grown giant warlord, sworn to the drowned choir

creatures.name: Cyst-Blossomed Behemoth
creatures.flavor: Each severed head buds a fresh eye before it regrows, until the thing sees in more directions than it can process.
creatures.summary: regenerating many-headed horror, sprouts eyes where heads regrow

creatures.name: Grand Cantor of the Drowned Court
creatures.flavor: Speaks in a chord of three voices at once, each a different generation of the same office; the congregation answers all three.
creatures.summary: tri-voiced high priest, speaks as three generations at once

creatures.name: Fathom-Deep Devourer
creatures.flavor: Older than the vault it lairs in, its gaze doesn't petrify so much as convince the victim that stillness was always the plan.
creatures.summary: ancient depth-lurker, gaze convinces victims stillness was the plan

creatures.name: Star-Warped Amalgam Lord
creatures.flavor: A cult champion so thoroughly reshaped that its original species is a debated footnote among its own worshippers.
creatures.summary: heavily-reshaped cult champion, original species long forgotten

creatures.name: Vault-Keeper of the Drowned Seal
creatures.flavor: Built to guard a door that shouldn't open; every scar in its clay hide is a place someone already tried.
creatures.summary: door-guardian golem, scarred by every prior attempt to pass

creatures.name: Hollow-Throated Herald-Prime
creatures.flavor: An elder herald whose throat has stretched to accommodate names centuries in the reciting; it finishes fragments the young ones can't.
creatures.summary: elder herald-beast, recites fragments younger heralds can't finish

creatures.name: Rakshasa of the Drowned Bargain
creatures.flavor: Made a private deal with the choir long before the cult existed; it wears whatever face gets the terms accepted.
creatures.summary: deal-making fiend, wears any face to get terms accepted

creatures.name: Colossal Sunken Guardian
creatures.flavor: A titan of drowned stone, moss and coral fused so deep into its joints that its footsteps sound like a tide going out.
creatures.summary: titanic coral-fused golem, footsteps sound like a receding tide

creatures.name: Void-Ascendant Grandmaster
creatures.flavor: Perfected the discipline of not-looking so completely it has forgotten what its god even looks like — which may be the point.
creatures.summary: perfected void-monk master, has forgotten its own god's face

creatures.name: Herald-Devourer of the Bishop's Court
creatures.flavor: Advises the bishops on doctrine while quietly consuming the ones whose faith wavers, calling it a mercy.
creatures.summary: doctrine-advisor and quiet devourer of the faithless

creatures.name: Sunk-Court Executioner
creatures.flavor: Handles the choir's internal discipline; those it visits are never spoken of by name again, only by the shape of their absence.
creatures.summary: internal cult enforcer, victims erased even from memory

creatures.name: Amalgam Colossus of the Reef Deep
creatures.flavor: A worm the size of a warship, its segments studded with fused reef, eyes, and the odd intact ship's figurehead.
creatures.summary: warship-sized fused colossus, hull studded with reef and eyes

creatures.name: Herald-Legion, Unified Voice
creatures.flavor: Every herald that ever failed to finish its name, fused into one throat that finally might; the cult prays it never gets the chance.
creatures.summary: fused mass of failed heralds, one throat that might finish

creatures.name: The Unfinished Cathedral-Made-Flesh
creatures.model: net-new: a cathedral's worth of drowned masonry animated into a lurching shape
creatures.flavor: The congregation finally built their temple, and the temple got up. It walks toward the sea on legs made of pews, ringing bells no one installed.
creatures.summary: animated drowned-cathedral golem, walks toward the sea

creatures.name: Star-Spawn Grand Marshal
creatures.flavor: Commands the between-star raiders in the flesh, its armor grown from crystallized starlight that's forgotten how to shine.
creatures.summary: star-spawn war-commander, armor of starlight that's gone dark

creatures.name: The Drift That Remembers Shapes
creatures.flavor: Every shoggoth-mass in the realm is one flake of this; it recalls every shape it's ever dissolved, and occasionally wears one back.
creatures.summary: the source shoggoth-mass, recalls and re-wears dissolved shapes

creatures.name: Last Cantor of the Ending Hymn
creatures.flavor: Traded its death for the chance to sing the drowned language's final verse; it has been rehearsing for four hundred years and is almost, almost ready.
creatures.summary: undying cantor, rehearsing a final verse for four centuries

creatures.name: The Angle That Ate a City
creatures.model: net-new: a fractally-wrong geometric mass the size of a district, still folded
creatures.flavor: It used to be somewhere. Now it's something, crawling slow and patient toward the next somewhere on legs that are technically also rooftops.
creatures.summary: district-sized geometric horror, was once a place, now a mouth

creatures.name: Deep One
creatures.flavor: A shore-town's shame given gills — it wades in half-formed, croaking a hymn it hasn't earned the throat for yet.
creatures.summary: batrachian shore-dweller, croaks a half-formed hymn
creatures.sourceNote: Lovecraft, The Shadow over Innsmouth (1936, PD)

creatures.name: Deep One Whip
creatures.flavor: Older, wetter, meaner — it keeps the school in line with a lashing tail and a stare that promises the tide is coming for you specifically.
creatures.summary: tide-driving enforcer of the Innsmouth shoal
creatures.sourceNote: Lovecraft, The Shadow over Innsmouth (1936, PD)

creatures.name: Deep One Archpriest
creatures.flavor: It leads the chant at the reef-altar and remembers being a person before the change finished; that memory is the only mercy it has left.
creatures.summary: reef-cult elder, half-remembers being human
creatures.sourceNote: Lovecraft, The Shadow over Innsmouth (1936, PD)

creatures.name: Byakhee
creatures.flavor: A crow-shape wrong at every joint, it beats black wings through no air at all and only lands to feed.
creatures.summary: void-crossing carrion flock, wrong at every joint
creatures.sourceNote: shared literary PD mythos convention (Chambers/Lovecraft-circle void-fauna)

creatures.name: Shoggoth
creatures.flavor: A slave that unmade its makers and kept the trick — a boiling black mass that grows whatever eye or mouth the moment calls for.
creatures.summary: protoplasmic slave-thing, grows eyes on demand
creatures.sourceNote: Lovecraft, At the Mountains of Madness (1936, PD)

creatures.name: Elder Thing
creatures.flavor: Barrel-bodied and starfish-headed, it built cities on this world before anything we'd call life existed, and it still keeps better records than we do.
creatures.summary: starfish-headed elder scientist-builder
creatures.sourceNote: Lovecraft, At the Mountains of Madness (1936, PD)

creatures.name: Elder Deep-Thing
creatures.flavor: An elder thing gone ancient and terrible, its city-building patience curdled into something that studies you the way it once studied continents.
creatures.summary: ancient elder thing, patience curdled to menace
creatures.sourceNote: Lovecraft, At the Mountains of Madness (1936, PD)

creatures.name: Dagon
creatures.flavor: The father-shape the Deep Ones sing to, glimpsed once by a starving sailor and never fully described since — because no one who saw it whole stayed sane enough to try.
creatures.summary: the Deep Ones' unspeakable patriarch
creatures.sourceNote: Lovecraft, Dagon (1919, PD)

creatures.name: Nightgaunt
creatures.flavor: Black, rubbery, and faceless, it tickles you into helplessness before it carries you off — the single most polite abduction in any bestiary.
creatures.summary: faceless black tickler that carries victims off
creatures.sourceNote: Lovecraft, The Dream-Quest of Unknown Kadath (1943, PD)

creatures.name: Hound of Tindalos
creatures.flavor: It doesn't come through space, it comes through angles — anywhere a corner exists, it's already halfway in.
creatures.summary: angle-stalking hunter that seeps through corners
creatures.sourceNote: Frank Belknap Long, The Hound of Tindalos (1929, PD)

creatures.name: The Colour
creatures.model: net-new: a shifting stain of unnameable light with no fixed silhouette
creatures.flavor: Not a monster so much as a stain that thinks — a light with no name in any spectrum, patiently turning a farm, then a family, then a county into itself.
creatures.summary: unnameable light that spreads and consumes
creatures.sourceNote: Lovecraft, The Colour Out of Space (1927, PD)

creatures.name: Yog-Sothoth's Herald
creatures.flavor: A half-born twin thing straining against the edges of the world it was dragged into — the Gate and the Key both wearing a body that can barely hold it.
creatures.summary: half-born twin thing straining at the seams of the world
creatures.sourceNote: Lovecraft, The Dunwich Horror (1929, PD)

creatures.name: Nyarlathotep, the Crawling Chaos
creatures.flavor: The only one of Them that bothers to wear a human face and give speeches — which somehow makes it worse, not better.
creatures.summary: the outer gods' smiling ambassador and saboteur
creatures.sourceNote: Lovecraft, Nyarlathotep (1920, PD)

creatures.name: Cthulhu
creatures.flavor: Dead but dreaming under the drowned city that bears his name, he doesn't need to move to end you — the dreams alone have driven men to the asylum and the harbor.
creatures.summary: sunken god-thing, dreaming ruin under the waves
creatures.sourceNote: Lovecraft, The Call of Cthulhu (1928, PD)

creatures.name: The King in Yellow
creatures.flavor: He never has to lift a hand — reading the second act is enough. The tatters of his court simply keep multiplying once you've looked.
creatures.summary: the tattered monarch of a play that unmakes readers
creatures.sourceNote: Robert W. Chambers, The King in Yellow (1895, PD)

creatures.name: Servant of the King in Yellow (Tatterling)
creatures.flavor: Once someone who finished the play. Now a rag-shape in a pale mask, mouthing lines it can no longer stop repeating.
creatures.summary: pale-masked cultist unmade by the forbidden play
creatures.sourceNote: Chambers, The King in Yellow (1895, PD) — the Pallid Mask/court motif

creatures.name: Cassilda's Mourner
creatures.model: net-new: a black-veiled wailing figure trailing tattered star-cloth
creatures.flavor: It weeps in a language that predates grief, wandering the black stars of Carcosa looking for a lake that isn't in this world anymore.
creatures.summary: Carcosan wanderer weeping in a dead tongue
creatures.sourceNote: Chambers, The King in Yellow (1895, PD) — Carcosa/Hyades imagery

creatures.name: Mi-Go
creatures.flavor: Fungoid, winged, and disturbingly businesslike, it doesn't want to kill you so much as file you — in a can, for shipping.
creatures.summary: fungoid trans-void miner, files brains for transport
creatures.sourceNote: Lovecraft, The Whisperer in Darkness (1931, PD)

creatures.name: Brain in a Cylinder
creatures.flavor: A voice from a metal can bolted to a speaker-horn, still insisting it volunteered for this and would love to tell you all about the stars.
creatures.summary: extracted brain, still cheerfully lecturing on the cosmos
creatures.sourceNote: Lovecraft, The Whisperer in Darkness (1931, PD)

creatures.name: Ghast of the Underworld
creatures.flavor: Kangaroo-legged and corpse-pale, it barks like a starved dog in the dark beneath the waking world and hunts in loping, delighted packs.
creatures.summary: kangaroo-legged corpse-thing that barks in the deep dark
creatures.sourceNote: Lovecraft, The Dream-Quest of Unknown Kadath (1943, PD)

creatures.name: Line Infantry Shade
creatures.flavor: A rifleman still dressed by a drill he can't remember learning; he holds a section of trench because holding it is the only order left in him.
creatures.summary: Rank-and-file trench ghost, holds the line by rote

creatures.name: Wire-Cutter Scout
creatures.flavor: Crawls the gaps between lines at night, snipping wire and counting sentries; talks to no one, reports to something.
creatures.summary: Silent night-crawler who counts sentries for something

creatures.name: Whistle-Blown Runner
creatures.flavor: Carries messages between shattered command posts at a dead sprint; the whistle that sends him over is always just about to blow again.
creatures.summary: Message-runner forever mid-sprint toward the whistle

creatures.name: Duckboard Vermin Swarm
creatures.flavor: Fat and fearless on a diet no one wants named, they own the flooded duckboards after dark and don't scatter for the living anymore.
creatures.summary: Fearless rat-swarm that owns the trench floor at night

creatures.name: Mustard Wraith
creatures.flavor: A drifting yellow-green bank that used to be a chemical order given from far behind the lines; it rolls into low ground and doesn't care whose lungs it finds.
creatures.summary: Drifting toxic gas-cloud that hunts low ground blind

creatures.name: Barbed Kill-Zone Tangle
creatures.model: net-new: a thorned mass of coiled wire that snags a boot then pulls
creatures.flavor: Coiled wire gone wrong, grown thorned and hungry between the lines; it snags a boot first and pulls the rest of the man in after.
creatures.summary: Living wire-tangle that snags then reels men in

creatures.name: Musket-Line Regular
creatures.flavor: Loads, presents, fires in volley by rote; the smoke never fully clears from a face that's forgotten peace.
creatures.summary: Volley-fire rifleman lost in permanent powder smoke

creatures.name: Longship Raider
creatures.flavor: Comes off the beach at a dead run, screaming a war-cry with no god's name left in it, only the noise.
creatures.summary: Beach-charging raider screaming a nameless war-cry

creatures.name: Jungle Ambusher
creatures.flavor: Fights from the canopy and the mud both, silent until the moment he isn't; the vines remember where he waited.
creatures.summary: Silent canopy-and-mud ambusher, gone before you see him

creatures.name: Siege-Line Sapper
creatures.flavor: Digs toward the wall under fire, laying the charge that will open it; talks about the tunnel like it's a person he's killing slowly.
creatures.summary: Tunnel-digger laying the charge that breaches the wall

creatures.name: Barbed-Wire Horror
creatures.flavor: A body the wire never let fall, stitched upright by rust and old rage; it still reaches for the men who left it there.
creatures.summary: Wire-impaled corpse that never fell, still reaching

creatures.name: The Unkillable Sergeant
creatures.flavor: Shot, gassed, and buried three times over the objection of his own men, he gets back up cursing and orders the charge again anyway.
creatures.summary: NCO who won't stay dead, keeps ordering the charge

creatures.name: Hedgerow Tank-Killer
creatures.flavor: Waits in the bocage with a tube on his shoulder for a machine bigger than any dragon he's heard of in stories; one shot, one silence.
creatures.summary: Bocage ambusher waiting to drop a war-machine cold

creatures.name: Longship Warlord
creatures.flavor: Twice the size a man should be, armored in captured plates from three different lines; the beach is his only law.
creatures.summary: Giant raider-chief armored in three lines' worth of plate

creatures.name: Trench Ghast
creatures.flavor: Feeds in no-man's-land where nobody goes to collect the dead; it has learned to imitate the whistle to lure the living out.
creatures.summary: No-man's-land feeder that mimics the whistle to lure prey

creatures.name: Jungle Beast-Handler
creatures.flavor: Marches a chained horror ahead of his own line as a breach-weapon; the leash is the only thing keeping the front intact.
creatures.summary: Handler who marches a chained horror as a living breacher

creatures.name: Iron Crawler War-Machine
creatures.flavor: A rivet-scarred hull dragging itself across the wire on tracks it wasn't built to have; the crew inside stopped answering the hatch a long time ago.
creatures.summary: Treaded armored hull grinding across the wire alone

creatures.name: Legion Standard-Breaker
creatures.flavor: Fights for the flag more than the cause, and the flag has no name anyone will say out loud; kills beautifully, believes in nothing.
creatures.summary: Flag-devoted killer who believes in nothing but the fight

creatures.name: Musket-Line Cavalry Officer
creatures.flavor: Charges a line of guns on horseback because the order came down and orders are the only faith he has left.
creatures.summary: Officer charging cannon-fire on horseback for the order alone

creatures.name: The Line That Held
creatures.flavor: A stretch of trench itself, animated by every soldier who swore to hold it and did, until holding was all that was left; it does not attack so much as refuse to move.
creatures.summary: Animate trench-line that simply refuses to yield ground

creatures.name: Longship Draugr-Captain
creatures.flavor: Drowned with his crew and rose commanding them still; the tide brings his ship back to shores that no longer remember his war.
creatures.summary: Drowned captain still commanding his dead crew ashore

creatures.name: Jungle War-Engine
creatures.flavor: A siege-machine gone feral in the canopy, vines grown through its plating, still firing on a target coordinate decades stale.
creatures.summary: Feral jungle war-machine still firing a stale coordinate

creatures.name: Legion Praetor-Revenant
creatures.flavor: Commands a legion of the dead the way he commanded the living, by discipline alone; his oath outlived his empire and his name both.
creatures.summary: Dead commander who still drills a legion by discipline alone

creatures.name: The Whistle
creatures.flavor: Not a person anymore — the sound itself, given a shape of officers' bones and borrowed rank insignia, that sends men over the top forever; every era's war has heard it.
creatures.summary: The sound of the order itself, given bone and rank

creatures.name: No-Man's Bloom
creatures.flavor: Grew from ground so soaked in war it stopped being ground; a forest of barbed thorn and bone-white flowers that remembers every line that ever broke on it, and answers with all of them at once.
creatures.summary: War-soaked ground grown into a thorned, remembering forest

creatures.name: Trench Rat Cloud
creatures.flavor: Bloated on no-man's-land carrion, it swarms boots and packs before anyone can shoot it.
creatures.summary: Carrion rats swarming abandoned trenches and packs

creatures.name: Conscript Straggler
creatures.flavor: Handed a rifle a week ago, he still flinches at his own shots and breaks the instant his squad does.
creatures.summary: Green conscript, flinches and breaks under fire

creatures.name: Wire-Snagged Corpse
creatures.flavor: Caught on the barbed wire mid-charge, it never fell — it just kept twitching forward, one strand at a time.
creatures.summary: Barbed-wire corpse still lurching toward the line

creatures.name: Powder Monkey Cutthroat
creatures.flavor: Small enough to run the guns below deck, mean enough to finish off boarders with a marlinspike.
creatures.summary: Small shipboard runner, finishes off fallen boarders

creatures.name: Musket Skirmisher
creatures.model: net-new: a loose-order rifleman crouched and reloading in drifting smoke
creatures.flavor: Fires from cover in loose order, reloading in the smoke while the line volleys behind him.
creatures.summary: Loose-order skirmisher, fires and vanishes into smoke

creatures.name: Longship Thrall
creatures.model: net-new: a chained oarsman handed an axe at the beachhead
creatures.flavor: Chained to the oar until the ship beaches, then handed an axe and pointed at the shore.
creatures.summary: Chained oarsman turned axe-fighter at the beachhead

creatures.name: Jungle Leech-Thing
creatures.model: net-new: a canopy-dwelling leech creature dropping onto exposed necks
creatures.flavor: Drops from canopy vines onto exposed necks; the bite numbs before it drains.
creatures.summary: Canopy leech-creature that drops and drains blood

creatures.name: Siege Camp Looter
creatures.flavor: Follows the siege lines picking corpses clean before the burial details arrive.
creatures.summary: Corpse-looter trailing behind the siege lines

creatures.name: Shell-Shocked Wanderer
creatures.model: net-new: a hollow-eyed survivor wandering no-man's-land muttering old orders
creatures.flavor: Walks no-man's-land muttering old orders, immune to fear because there's nothing left to lose.
creatures.summary: Shell-shocked survivor wandering, immune to fear

creatures.name: Gas-Mask Sentry
creatures.flavor: Stands post in a rubber mask through every gas alarm, trusting the seal more than his own eyes.
creatures.summary: Masked sentry holding post through gas alarms

creatures.name: Draft-Horse Casualty
creatures.flavor: A supply-train animal that died in harness and kept pulling, wagon and all, long after the wagon rotted away.
creatures.summary: Dead draft horse still hauling its rotted harness

creatures.name: Cavalry Lancer
creatures.flavor: Charges in a wedge before the machine-gun era caught up with the horse.
creatures.summary: Mounted lancer charging ahead of modern fire

creatures.name: Musket-Line Drummer Boy
creatures.model: net-new: a young drummer keeping march step through the volleys
creatures.flavor: Keeps the march step through the volleys; killing him breaks the formation's nerve as much as any officer.
creatures.summary: Drummer keeping march step, breaking his death shatters morale

creatures.name: No-Man's-Land Crawler
creatures.flavor: Feeds on the unburied between the lines, too cowardly to rise until the shelling stops.
creatures.summary: Battlefield ghoul scavenging the unburied at night

creatures.name: Jungle Ambush Sniper
creatures.flavor: Lashed into the high canopy for days at a time, waiting for one clean shot.
creatures.summary: Canopy-lashed sniper waiting days for one shot

creatures.name: Longship Shieldmaiden
creatures.flavor: Holds the shield-wall's flank and screams the ship's name until her voice gives out.
creatures.summary: Flank shield-wall fighter screaming the ship's name

creatures.name: Trench Wire Golem
creatures.flavor: Salvaged plate and barbed coils lashed into a shape that shambles the wire-line on patrol.
creatures.summary: Salvaged-armor construct patrolling the wire on its own

creatures.name: Musket Volley Ghost
creatures.model: net-new: a spectral rank of soldiers standing shoulder to shoulder in smoke
creatures.flavor: A whole rank that died in one volley, still standing shoulder to shoulder in the smoke.
creatures.summary: Volley-killed rank of soldiers standing in smoke

creatures.name: Jungle War-Dog
creatures.model: net-new: a scent-trained war-dog running point ahead of the patrol
creatures.flavor: Trained to track by sweat and fear, it runs the point ahead of the patrol.
creatures.summary: Scent-trained war-dog running point on patrol

creatures.name: Siege Sapper's Mole
creatures.flavor: Bred and directed to chew siege tunnels under walls, indifferent to the men riding its back.
creatures.summary: Tunneling beast bred to dig under siege walls

creatures.name: Mustard Fog Sprite
creatures.model: net-new: a low-rolling pocket of living gas hunting by sound
creatures.flavor: A living pocket of gas that rolls low across the wire, hunting by the sound of coughing.
creatures.summary: Living gas-cloud that hunts by coughing sounds

creatures.name: Longship Berserker
creatures.model: net-new: a wild-eyed berserker chewing ritual root before the beach charge
creatures.flavor: Chews the ritual root before the beach landing and doesn't feel the axe wounds until the tide turns red.
creatures.summary: Beach-landing berserker numb to wounds mid-charge

creatures.name: Colonial Trench Medic
creatures.model: net-new: a medic crawling between craters under fire, satchel in hand
creatures.flavor: Crawls between craters under fire, more dangerous to leave alive than most riflemen.
creatures.summary: Under-fire medic, priority target to break morale

creatures.name: Jungle Pit-Trap Warden
creatures.model: net-new: a guerrilla warden crouched among staked pits and deadfalls
creatures.flavor: Lives among staked pits and deadfalls of his own building, herding patrols into them.
creatures.summary: Guerrilla warden herding patrols into staked pits

creatures.name: Duckboard Trench Fiend
creatures.flavor: Something answered the mud's hunger and started climbing up through the duckboards at night.
creatures.summary: Mud-spawned fiend climbing up through duckboards

creatures.name: Machine-Gun Nest Crew
creatures.flavor: Two men and a tripod that can end a whole charge in the time it takes to reload once.
creatures.summary: Two-man gun crew that ends charges outright

creatures.name: Storm-Trooper Breach Squad
creatures.flavor: Trained to cross the open ground fast and clear a trench section room by room before the rest arrive.
creatures.summary: Fast breach specialists clearing trench sections

creatures.name: Longship Skald-Reaver
creatures.model: net-new: a raider singing the saga while swinging an axe
creatures.flavor: Sings the raid's saga even as he fights, and the crew fights harder for being sung about.
creatures.summary: Singing raider whose saga-verses embolden the crew

creatures.name: Jungle Pit Viper Ambush
creatures.flavor: Strikes from the treeline the moment a patrol bunches up on the trail.
creatures.summary: Treeline ambush snake striking bunched patrols

creatures.name: Cavalry Saber Charge
creatures.flavor: Rides the flank at full gallop, saber down, betting everything on the first pass.
creatures.summary: Full-gallop saber cavalry betting on the first pass

creatures.name: Field Gun Battery
creatures.model: net-new: a cannon crew fighting on grimly at their fallen posts
creatures.flavor: A cannon crew that fights on as one grim machine after the horses bolt and the gunners die at their posts.
creatures.summary: Cannon crew fighting as one machine past death

creatures.name: The Wire-Cutter Colossus
creatures.flavor: Built to walk the wire ahead of the assault, clipping lanes through with rotating shears.
creatures.summary: Wire-clipping walker built to open assault lanes

creatures.name: Longship Hull-Breaker
creatures.flavor: A raiding crew's brute, thrown at ship hulls and gates alike with the same swing.
creatures.summary: Raiding-crew brute thrown at hulls and gates

creatures.name: Jungle Beast-Cage Handler
creatures.model: net-new: a handler flinging open bamboo cages at the ambush horn
creatures.flavor: Releases the war-beasts from bamboo cages the instant the ambush horn sounds.
creatures.summary: Handler releasing caged war-beasts on the ambush horn

creatures.name: Gas Cloud Horror
creatures.model: net-new: a roiling, undissipated gas cloud with a hunting will of its own
creatures.flavor: A whole gas barrage that never dissipated, grown a hunger and a will of its own.
creatures.summary: Sentient, undissipated gas barrage with a will

creatures.name: Trench Raid Bayonet Line
creatures.flavor: Goes over the top in a fixed line, bayonets first, silent until the whistle blows.
creatures.summary: Silent bayonet line going over the top on the whistle

creatures.name: Musket-Line Artillery Sergeant
creatures.flavor: Walks the gun line under fire, correcting aim by voice alone.
creatures.summary: Voice-correcting gun sergeant walking under fire

creatures.name: Siege Tower Crew
creatures.model: net-new: a rolling wooden siege tower crewed by fighters at its top
creatures.flavor: A rolling wooden tower crewed by soldiers who fight from its top even as arrows take the timbers apart.
creatures.summary: Rolling siege tower crewed under falling arrows

creatures.name: Longship War-Wolf Handler
creatures.flavor: Runs with a leashed pack of raiding wolves that hit the shore ahead of the men.
creatures.summary: Raider running a leashed wolf-pack ahead of the men

creatures.name: Jungle War-Elephant Driver
creatures.model: net-new: a barded war-elephant carrying its mahout through the chaos
creatures.flavor: A trained war-beast in barded plate, its mahout riding the howdah through the chaos.
creatures.summary: Barded war-elephant carrying its driver into chaos

creatures.name: Trench Flame-Lance Team
creatures.model: net-new: two soldiers hauling an oil-fire tank with a long lance-nozzle
creatures.flavor: Two men and a tank of oil-fire that clear a bunker in one long, screaming breath.
creatures.summary: Flame-tank team clearing bunkers in one breath

creatures.name: Deserter-Thing
creatures.flavor: Shot for running from the line, it came back wrong and now hunts whoever ordered the execution.
creatures.summary: Executed deserter risen wrong, hunting its executioners

creatures.name: Musket-Line Grenadier
creatures.model: net-new: a tall-hatted grenadier carrying a satchel of black powder
creatures.flavor: Tall-hatted, fearless, and carrying enough black powder to open any door he's pointed at.
creatures.summary: Fearless grenadier carrying door-opening black powder

creatures.name: Longship Ghost Fleet Crewman
creatures.flavor: Rows a ship that beached a hundred years ago and never stopped believing the raid is still on.
creatures.summary: Century-dead rower still believing the raid continues

creatures.name: Siege Ballista Crew
creatures.model: net-new: a gate-punching ballista crewed by soldiers who never rest
creatures.flavor: A war-machine built to punch through castle gates, reloaded by a crew that never sleeps.
creatures.summary: Gate-punching war-machine crewed around the clock

creatures.name: Jungle Tiger-Rider Scout
creatures.model: net-new: a scout riding a trained tiger along canopy trails
creatures.flavor: Rides a trained big cat through the canopy trails faster than any patrol can track.
creatures.summary: Trained big-cat rider scouting the canopy trails

creatures.name: Trench Officer's Ghost-Whistle
creatures.model: net-new: a spectral officer still blowing a whistle for the charge
creatures.flavor: An officer who blew the whistle for the final charge and never stopped hearing it answered.
creatures.summary: Dead officer whose whistle still calls the charge

creatures.name: Musket-Line Field Marshal's Honor Guard
creatures.model: net-new: an honor guard standing fast around a battle standard
creatures.flavor: Sworn to die before the standard falls, and mean about proving it.
creatures.summary: Standard-guard sworn to die before it falls

creatures.name: Cavalry Death-Rider
creatures.model: net-new: a dead cavalry officer and warhorse still mid-charge
creatures.flavor: A cavalry officer and his warhorse, both killed in the same charge, still riding it out.
creatures.summary: Dead cavalry officer and horse still mid-charge

creatures.name: Longship Berserker-King's Champion
creatures.model: net-new: a bare-chested champion fighting at the longship's prow
creatures.flavor: Fights bare-chested at the prow, daring the enemy shore to try and stop the landing.
creatures.summary: Bare-chested prow-fighter daring the shore to resist

creatures.name: Jungle Ambush War-Priest
creatures.model: net-new: a war-priest swinging a ritual club after blessing the ambush
creatures.flavor: Blesses the ambush with old rites before the horn sounds, then wades in swinging a ritual club.
creatures.summary: Ritual-blessing war-priest wading into the ambush

creatures.name: Siege-Line Trebuchet Golem
creatures.model: net-new: a hulking trebuchet that aims and looses itself
creatures.flavor: A siege engine grown a crude will, it aims itself now and doesn't wait for the order to loose.
creatures.summary: Self-aiming trebuchet that no longer waits for orders

creatures.name: Musket-Line Cannon Golem
creatures.model: net-new: a field gun bolted onto a lumbering walking chassis
creatures.flavor: A field gun bolted to a walking chassis, built when someone realized the crew kept dying.
creatures.summary: Walking field-gun chassis built to replace dead crews

creatures.name: Trench Wraith of the Wire
creatures.model: net-new: a fused mass of soldiers hunting by remembered muzzle-flash
creatures.flavor: A whole company lost to one machine gun, fused by grief and mud into something that hunts by muzzle-flash memory.
creatures.summary: Company-wide death-wraith hunting by muzzle-flash memory

creatures.name: Longship Draugr-Fleet Captain
creatures.flavor: Commands a crew of the drowned, and every ship he's ever sunk still answers his horn.
creatures.summary: Drowned fleet-captain whose sunk ships still answer

creatures.name: Jungle Colossus-Beast
creatures.model: net-new: a tamed prehistoric beast used as a living battering ram
creatures.flavor: A prehistoric survivor pressed into service as a living battering ram by whoever tamed it first.
creatures.summary: Tamed prehistoric survivor used as a living ram

creatures.name: Trench Butcher Golem
creatures.model: net-new: a grim close-quarters clearing machine built for the wire
creatures.flavor: Built for the close-quarters clearing work no living soldier could stomach doing twice.
creatures.summary: Close-quarters clearing machine built for the unstomachable work

creatures.name: Musket-Line Ghost Regiment
creatures.model: net-new: a spectral regiment marching in perfect dead formation
creatures.flavor: A whole regiment lost in one disastrous volley-charge, still marching in perfect dead formation.
creatures.summary: Regiment lost in one charge, still marching in formation

creatures.name: Siege Wall-Breaker Titan
creatures.model: net-new: a hulking titan swinging a tree-trunk ram at a gate
creatures.flavor: Swings a ram the size of a tree trunk and doesn't stop until the gate or its arm gives first.
creatures.summary: Ram-wielding siege titan that doesn't stop swinging

creatures.name: Longship Sea-Wyrm Figurehead
creatures.flavor: A carved prow come alive with raider curses, it dives on enemy ships from the fog.
creatures.summary: Cursed living figurehead diving from fog onto ships

creatures.name: Jungle War-Machine of Rusted Vines
creatures.flavor: An engine of war swallowed by the jungle for decades, now grown through with roots and still armed.
creatures.summary: Root-swallowed ancient war-engine, still fully armed

creatures.name: The Field Marshal's Undying Aide
creatures.flavor: Delivers the same order at the same hour every night, a century after the marshal died reading it.
creatures.summary: Undying aide delivering the same dead order nightly

creatures.name: Trench Legion Revenant Colonel
creatures.model: net-new: a revenant colonel rallying every corpse in earshot
creatures.flavor: Refuses to accept the war is over, and rallies every corpse in earshot to prove it.
creatures.summary: War-denying revenant rallying every nearby corpse

creatures.name: Longship Storm-Caller Reaver
creatures.model: net-new: a reaver standing at the helm, storm crackling around him
creatures.flavor: Bargained the sea itself into raiding for him, and the storm still owes him one more shore.
creatures.summary: Storm-bargaining reaver whose weather still owes him

creatures.name: Jungle Chimera-Beast of War
creatures.flavor: Bred by a warlord's beast-tenders to lead a charge no single animal could survive alone.
creatures.summary: Warlord-bred chimera leading otherwise unsurvivable charges

creatures.name: Musket-Line Field Marshal-Revenant
creatures.model: net-new: a spectral marshal frozen mid-order at a headquarters table
creatures.flavor: Died at his own headquarters table mid-order and has been finishing that sentence for a hundred years.
creatures.summary: Century-dead marshal still finishing his last order

creatures.name: Trench Colossus of Bone and Wire
creatures.model: net-new: a titan built from the unburied dead, bone and barbed wire
creatures.flavor: Built itself from the unburied dead of a battle no one survived to name.
creatures.summary: Self-built ossuary titan from an unnamed battle's dead

creatures.name: No-Man's-Land Warlord's Ghost
creatures.flavor: The general who ordered the crater assault still watches it from above, unable to look away from his own order.
creatures.summary: General's ghost eternally watching his own fatal order

creatures.name: The Ironclad Reaver-Queen
creatures.model: net-new: a longship's hull fused with its captain into one war-machine
creatures.flavor: A longship's hull fused with its captain by a dying storm-oath, now a war-machine that never beaches.
creatures.summary: Ship-hull-and-captain war-machine that never comes ashore

creatures.name: Legion Undying Praetorian Host
creatures.flavor: An entire honor-guard that swore to never break formation, and hasn't, in any century since.
creatures.summary: Never-broken honor-guard formation, undying for centuries

creatures.name: The Gas-King of the Salient
creatures.flavor: Every gas attack ever loosed on the salient pooled into one thinking, hating cloud that owns the ground now.
creatures.summary: Sentient gas-cloud amalgam that owns the salient's ground

creatures.name: The Siege That Never Lifted
creatures.flavor: A siege line's worth of engines, crews, and dead fused into one wall-breaking horror that still hasn't taken the city.
creatures.summary: Fused siege-line horror still failing to take the city

creatures.name: The Trench Ghost
creatures.flavor: A soldier who never left the line, rifle still slung, gas-hood rotted to rags; it keeps walking a patrol route that ended lifetimes ago.
creatures.summary: shell-shocked revenant infantryman on eternal patrol
creatures.sourceNote: generic WWI-lensed infantry archetype (no named nation/unit)

creatures.name: The Legion Wall
creatures.flavor: One tile of a wall that used to be a hundred men wide; it still steps in formation even with no one left on either flank.
creatures.summary: lone shield-and-spear legionary, drilled to a fault
creatures.sourceNote: classical-era shield-line legionary archetype

creatures.name: The Musket Line
creatures.flavor: Loads, kneels, fires, reloads — the whole drill even when there's no second rank behind him and no order left to give.
creatures.summary: standing volley-drill musketeer, drilled past reason
creatures.sourceNote: generic 18th/19th-c. volley-fire infantry archetype

creatures.name: The Longship Raider
creatures.flavor: Came ashore for plunder and glory and got neither — just the theater's endless tide instead of home.
creatures.summary: axe-and-round-shield sea raider, stranded in the war
creatures.sourceNote: Norse-lensed raider archetype (not a specific saga figure)

creatures.name: The Jungle Scout
creatures.flavor: Camouflage gone to lichen, machete more rust than edge — still moves like the canopy is watching him back.
creatures.summary: camo-draped recon scout gone half-feral in the green
creatures.sourceNote: generic mid-century jungle-warfare scout archetype (no named conflict)

creatures.name: The Siege Sapper
creatures.flavor: Digs toward the wall by memory, pick over one shoulder, satchel of black powder over the other, humming a tune no living ear would know.
creatures.summary: tunnel-digging siege engineer, still mining toward a wall
creatures.sourceNote: medieval siege-engineer archetype

creatures.name: The Berserker
creatures.flavor: Fights bare-armed and bear-shirted, past fear, past pain, past the point where the theater's rules of engagement still apply to him.
creatures.summary: battle-trance warrior who fights past fear and flesh
creatures.sourceNote: Norse saga/legend berserkr tradition (public domain; no modern media design)

creatures.name: The Draugr Captain
creatures.flavor: Guards a rank that was overrun centuries ago as if the order to hold still stands; corpse-cold hands still know the grip of a sword-hilt.
creatures.summary: mound-risen undead officer still holding a dead line
creatures.sourceNote: Norse folklore draugr — the mound-dwelling undead warrior of the sagas

creatures.name: The Machine-Gun Nest
creatures.flavor: Not one soldier but the whole emplacement fused together — tripod legs, traversing arms, a barrel where a face should be.
creatures.summary: fused gun-and-gunner emplacement, animate and traversing
creatures.sourceNote: generic entrenched-crew-served-weapon archetype

creatures.name: The Storm-Trooper Cadre
creatures.flavor: Moves in twos and threes between the shell-holes, grenade-first, never in the open longer than a breath.
creatures.summary: grenade-and-trench-knife shock infantryman
creatures.sourceNote: generic elite-shock-infantry archetype (WWI stosstruppen-style, no named force)

creatures.name: The Valkyrie
creatures.flavor: Walks the field after the guns fall quiet, marking which of the fallen the theater will keep and which it lets go home.
creatures.summary: battlefield psychopomp choosing which dead the war keeps
creatures.sourceNote: Norse myth — chooser of the slain (public domain figure, our own visual take)

creatures.name: The Iron Cavalry
creatures.flavor: Half horse, half hull-plate — the theater's answer to any age's need for something that doesn't tire and doesn't feel the wire.
creatures.summary: armor-plated war-beast standing in for every era's tank
creatures.sourceNote: generic armored-cavalry/tank archetype, era-blurred

creatures.name: The Siege Tower
creatures.flavor: Rolls forward on its own dead momentum, ladders unfurling like wings, arrow-slits blinking where windows should be.
creatures.summary: animate siege-tower, self-propelled toward the wall
creatures.sourceNote: medieval siege-engine archetype

creatures.name: The Trench Wight
creatures.flavor: Commands a company that's mostly mud and memory now, whistle still around its neck, ready to blow the advance no one will survive.
creatures.summary: revenant trench-officer still blowing the whistle to advance
creatures.sourceNote: WWI-lensed mass-grave revenant archetype (not any single named ghost)

creatures.name: The War Elephant
creatures.flavor: Armored howdah still smoking from the last volley it shrugged off; it doesn't rout, it doesn't stop, it just keeps coming through the line.
creatures.summary: armored siege-beast that shrugs off volleys and keeps coming
creatures.sourceNote: ancient/classical siege-beast archetype

creatures.name: The Gorgon Standard
creatures.flavor: A standard-bearer whose face the theater blurs on purpose — look at her banner too long and you understand exactly why armies used to carry her likeness into battle.
creatures.summary: gorgon-faced standard-bearer, a banner that petrifies stares
creatures.sourceNote: Greek myth — Medusa/Gorgon, invoked here as a war-banner icon rather than the individual myth figure

creatures.name: The Flying Squadron
creatures.flavor: Half war-bird, half war-machine, strafing the line from an altitude the trenches can only pray at.
creatures.summary: aerial strafing beast standing in for the first air war
creatures.sourceNote: generic early-aviation/biplane dogfighter archetype

creatures.name: The Ironclad Leviathan
creatures.flavor: It doesn't fly the theater's skies so much as displace them, guns run out along a hull too vast to have ever been launched from any yard.
creatures.summary: gargantuan warship-beast that dominates the theater's horizon
creatures.sourceNote: generic armored-warship archetype, era-blurred (age-of-sail through dreadnought)

creatures.name: The War-Wyrm
creatures.flavor: Chained to a war chariot bigger than most houses, it's less a monster than a munitions budget with wings and a grudge.
creatures.summary: chained siege-dragon deployed like a living artillery piece
creatures.sourceNote: generic siege-dragon archetype used as the theater's ultimate weapon, not tied to any named dragon myth

creatures.name: The Death Knight of No Nation
creatures.flavor: Every side in every war in this theater has, at one time, sworn he was fighting for them; he has stopped correcting anyone.
creatures.summary: undead commander claimed by every faction, loyal to none
creatures.sourceNote: generic black-armored undead-commander archetype (fantasy stock type, no franchise ties)

creatures.name: The Siege of the World
creatures.flavor: Wears every era's uniform at once and none convincingly; the theater's honest answer to what War would look like if it ever had to show its face.
creatures.summary: war given a body, wearing every era's uniform at once
creatures.sourceNote: original apex — the theater's totalizing embodiment of endless war, an original composite figure, not a myth or franchise reskin

creatures.name: Press-Ganged Deckhand
creatures.flavor: Taken off a dock at knifepoint three ports back; fights because the alternative is the lash, not because he wants your blood.
creatures.summary: Unwilling conscript swinging a cutlass under threat

creatures.name: Bilge Rat Swarm
creatures.flavor: They ate the last cook's boots and are working on his replacement's; every hold has them and every hold pretends not to.
creatures.summary: Chittering vermin tide pouring from the hold

creatures.name: Rope-Scar Cutthroat
creatures.flavor: Owes the crew's articles more than he'll ever earn; boards ships to buy back a little of his own name.
creatures.summary: Cutlass-and-flintlock buccaneer swarming the rail

creatures.name: Chum-Slick Reef Shark
creatures.flavor: Follows any ship that's been bleeding into its wake — a bad sign the crew reads correctly and ignores anyway.
creatures.summary: Blood-trail shark circling a wounded hull

creatures.name: Waterlogged Deckwalker
creatures.flavor: Went over in a storm and came back up the anchor chain; still wears the duty rota pinned to a rotted coat.
creatures.summary: Drowned crewman shambling back up the chain

creatures.name: Rattling Bone-Crew Deckhand
creatures.flavor: Picked clean by fish and time, still hauling the same rigging it died hauling; the rope never lets a bone crew rest.
creatures.summary: Cutlass-armed skeleton still standing its watch

creatures.name: Fin-Toothed Raider
creatures.flavor: Rises over the gunwale in packs when a hull rides low and slow; drags what it takes back down before the alarm bell finishes ringing.
creatures.summary: Fish-fanged sea-devil boarding from below

creatures.name: Kraken-Spawn Squidling
creatures.flavor: A juvenile shed off something vastly larger down in the trench; still small enough to drag a man under one-handed.
creatures.summary: Trench-spawned tentacle-beast dragging sailors under

creatures.name: Gull-Eyed Wreck Harpy
creatures.flavor: Nests in the rigging of ships too slow to outrun it, singing sailors toward the rocks it circles like a gull circles chum.
creatures.summary: Rock-nesting harpy luring ships onto reefs

creatures.name: Debt-Marked Bosun
creatures.flavor: Keeps the ledger of who owes the crew what, in coin or blood, and collects personally when a name comes due.
creatures.summary: Ledger-keeping enforcer collecting the crew's debts

creatures.name: Deep-Fang Sea-Devil Priest
creatures.flavor: Chants the raiding packs into a blood-frenzy from the wave-tops, offering the drowned to something older than the trench.
creatures.summary: Sea-devil war-priest chanting a raiding pack to frenzy

creatures.name: Quartermaster of the Broken Articles
creatures.flavor: Runs discipline on a ship whose captain hasn't been seen topside in weeks; the crew fears him more than any storm.
creatures.summary: Shadow-captain running the ship by fear alone

creatures.name: Chain-Dragging Drowned Sailor
creatures.flavor: Went down chained to the very anchor he was ordered not to release; surfaces to recruit a crew that never mutinies twice.
creatures.summary: Anchor-chained revenant press-ganging the living

creatures.name: Mutinous First Mate
creatures.flavor: Slit the old captain's throat over a fair split and never looked back; the crew that followed him into it now wonders whose throat is next.
creatures.summary: Blade-drawn mate who murdered his way to command

creatures.name: Fogbank Siren
creatures.flavor: Sells safe passage through her fog for a name, a memory, or a firstborn — and always collects in a currency the crew didn't expect.
creatures.summary: Fog-shrouded siren-witch bartering safe passage

creatures.name: Lantern-Eyed Ghost Captain
creatures.flavor: Still walks his own quarterdeck on the night the fog rolls thick, hailing living ships for a berth he'll never fill twice.
creatures.summary: Translucent captain still haunting his own quarterdeck

creatures.name: Riptide Elemental
creatures.flavor: A standing current with a temper, summoned or born where a ship went down wrong; drags cargo and crew alike to the same grave.
creatures.summary: Living riptide dragging a wreck's leftovers under

creatures.name: Deep-Baron of the Drowning Grounds
creatures.flavor: Rules a reef of wrecks and the things that raid from them; ships that fish his water pay a toll in hulls.
creatures.summary: Reef-ruling sea-devil warlord commanding raid packs

creatures.name: Plague-Hulk Zombie Crew
creatures.flavor: A three-decker's worth of drowned dead fused by rot and current into one groaning, many-armed mass still trying to crew the ship.
creatures.summary: Fused mass of drowned dead still crewing the hulk

creatures.name: Storm-Caller of the Drowned Choir
creatures.flavor: Traded her voice to something under the swells for weather on command; the crew loves her and never quite meets her eyes.
creatures.summary: Voice-traded witch who calls storms on command

creatures.name: The Admiral of Nowhere
creatures.flavor: Commands a fleet that was scuttled a hundred years ago and never noticed; still promotes the drowned, still courts-martial the disloyal.
creatures.summary: Undead fleet-admiral commanding a century-scuttled navy

creatures.name: The Keelbreaker
creatures.flavor: Many-headed and older than the shipping lanes; every captain who's fought it and lived describes a different number of heads.
creatures.summary: Many-headed sea-brute older than the shipping lanes

creatures.name: The Ghost Ship Herself
creatures.model: net-new: a sail-shredded derelict with a translucent hull, sailing herself
creatures.flavor: No living hand touches her wheel; she tacks into any wind, runs down any ship that spots her, and every soul she's ever taken still crews her rigging.
creatures.summary: Self-sailing derelict crewed by its own drowned dead

creatures.name: The Fathom-Crowned Leviathan
creatures.flavor: The keel-sunk horror every sailor's oath invokes without meaning it; wakes when a ship's debts to the sea itself finally come due.
creatures.summary: The keel-sunk horror sailors swear by and dread

creatures.name: The Horizon's Own Reckoning
creatures.model: net-new: a burning derelict captain wreathed in storm-fire, chained to a wheel of drowned hands
creatures.flavor: The line where the horizon keeps its own counsel made flesh — a captain who sailed too far past the edge of the charts and came back wrong, wearing a crown of storm-fire and unpaid debts.
creatures.summary: Storm-fire captain who sailed past the edge of the charts

creatures.name: Salt-Cracked Deck Sweeper
creatures.flavor: A ship's boy grown into a shipboard bruiser, all rope-burn hands and no say in where the vessel sails.
creatures.summary: Low-rank deckhand enforcer, no say in the voyage

creatures.name: Powder Monkey Turned Cutthroat
creatures.flavor: Started the crossing hauling shot to the gun deck; ended it with a knife of his own and no patience left.
creatures.summary: Former powder-boy now knife-quick and patience-thin

creatures.name: Barnacle-Crusted Beachcomber
creatures.flavor: Picks a wreck's bones clean before the tide can, and isn't shy about who else gets picked clean too.
creatures.summary: Wreck-looting beachcomber, quick to rob the living

creatures.name: Marooned Castaway
creatures.flavor: Left on a spit of sand to die for a mutiny that wasn't his; came back off the island wrong and hungry.
creatures.summary: Island-marooned mutineer's scapegoat, come back wrong

creatures.name: Gull-Picked Corpse Crab
creatures.flavor: Scuttles the tideline in loose scavenging clusters, drawn to anything that used to breathe.
creatures.summary: Scavenging tideline crab drawn to the recently dead

creatures.name: Chain-Rattling Bilge Zombie
creatures.flavor: Drowned in the hold when the pumps failed and never noticed the ship went down around it.
creatures.summary: Drowned bilge-worker who never noticed the sinking

creatures.name: Wreck-Wood Skeleton
creatures.flavor: Picked clean by fish and reassembled by whatever tide-logic runs the ocean floor's oldest graveyards.
creatures.summary: Reef-floor skeleton reassembled by tide-logic

creatures.name: Grog-Mad Deckhand
creatures.flavor: Three weeks becalmed and a cracked rum cask turned an ordinary sailor into a swinging liability.
creatures.summary: Becalmed sailor gone rum-mad and swinging

creatures.name: Coral-Fanged Moray Swarm
creatures.flavor: A boiling knot of eels nesting in a hull-breach, territorial past all reason.
creatures.summary: Territorial eel-knot nesting inside a breached hull

creatures.name: Flying-Fish Strafer Flock
creatures.flavor: An unnaturally large school that glides clean over the gunwale and shreds an exposed hand or face.
creatures.summary: Oversized gliding fish-flock that shreds exposed skin

creatures.name: Bilge-Bloated Corpse Floater
creatures.flavor: Bobs face-down until something living gets close, then it isn't face-down anymore.
creatures.summary: Bloated floating corpse that only moves when approached

creatures.name: Rope-and-Rum Buccaneer
creatures.flavor: Signed the articles for the split, not the cause, and will renegotiate both mid-boarding.
creatures.summary: Fair-weather buccaneer who renegotiates loyalty mid-fight

creatures.name: Tide-Warped Sahuagin Scout
creatures.flavor: Runs ahead of the raiding pod to test a hull's weak seams before the pack commits.
creatures.summary: Sea-devil scout that tests hulls before the pod attacks

creatures.name: Driftwood Effigy Watcher
creatures.flavor: Lashed together from wreck-spars by superstitious crews to ward the reef; wards it by walking the tideline itself now.
creatures.summary: Wreck-spar effigy that patrols the reef it was built to ward

creatures.name: Reef-Crawling Giant Crab
creatures.flavor: Territorial over a wreck's cargo hold, clamps and doesn't let go until something breaks.
creatures.summary: Wreck-territorial crab that clamps and never releases

creatures.name: Fogbound Lookout Wraith
creatures.flavor: Still stands the watch it died at, calling sightings to a crew that scattered a century ago.
creatures.summary: Dead lookout still calling sightings to a vanished crew

creatures.name: Anchor-Chain Ghoul
creatures.flavor: Went down tangled in the anchor chain and rose still wrapped in it, dragging fathoms of rusted iron.
creatures.summary: Chain-tangled ghoul dragging fathoms of rusted iron

creatures.name: Kraken-Spawn Tentacle Horror
creatures.flavor: A juvenile deep-thing washed inshore, small enough to board but old enough to know exactly where the throat is.
creatures.summary: Small deep-thing juvenile that boards and strikes throats

creatures.name: Sea-Devil Net-Thrower
