creatures.flavor: Drags swimmers under with weighted netting before the rest of the raid ever surfaces.
creatures.summary: Sahuagin netter that drags swimmers under first

creatures.name: Salvage-Diver Ghoul
creatures.flavor: Died prying a strongbox from a sunken hold and still won't surface without it.
creatures.summary: Drowned salvager-ghoul that won't surface without its box

creatures.name: Hardtack Cannibal Crewman
creatures.flavor: What's left of a lifeboat crew that ran out of hardtack long before they ran out of each other.
creatures.summary: Lifeboat survivor turned desperate, quiet cannibal

creatures.name: Shrieking Storm Petrel Swarm
creatures.flavor: Precedes every gale that matters, screaming the ship's name back at the crew before the wind does.
creatures.summary: Storm-heralding bird swarm that screeches the ship's name

creatures.name: Barrel-Bomb Mutineer
creatures.flavor: Carries a lit powder keg into a boarding fight like it's a threat and a bargaining chip both.
creatures.summary: Mutineer wielding a lit powder keg as leverage

creatures.name: Wreck-Grown Rust Louse Swarm
creatures.flavor: Nests in derelict hulls and strips a boarding party's cutlasses to orange flakes before the fight even starts.
creatures.summary: Hull-nesting vermin that rusts weapons to flakes

creatures.name: Doldrums-Drunk Deserter
creatures.flavor: Jumped ship in the doldrums rather than starve slow, and regrets it in a way that makes him dangerous to rescuers.
creatures.summary: Starvation-mad deserter, dangerous to would-be rescuers

creatures.name: Barnacle Golem
creatures.model: net-new: a hull-plate golem crusted floor to helm in barnacles
creatures.flavor: Salvaged armor left lashed to a scuttled hull long enough for the reef to grow through the rivets and wake it up.
creatures.summary: Reef-grown armor golem woken by a scuttled hull

creatures.name: Sea-Devil Priest's Acolyte
creatures.flavor: Chants the drowning-litany half a beat behind the priest, close enough to matter.
creatures.summary: Junior sea-devil chanter half a beat behind the priest

creatures.name: Debt-Marked Purser
creatures.flavor: Keeps the true ledger of who owes the captain what, and the false one for the crew.
creatures.summary: Ship's purser running two ledgers, one true and one lie

creatures.name: Reef-Devil Trapper
creatures.flavor: Lures hulls onto shoal-teeth with false lantern-signals, then finishes what the reef starts.
creatures.summary: Sea-devil that lures hulls onto reefs with false lanterns

creatures.name: Hollow-Eyed Lantern Ghost
creatures.flavor: A drowned signalman's light, still swinging the warning nobody heeded, luring the unwary same as it once tried to save them.
creatures.summary: Drowned signalman's ghost-light, warning and luring both

creatures.name: Rope-Trick Rigging Spider
creatures.flavor: Nests high in a ghost ship's rigging, dropping silk lines to snare anyone who climbs to reef the sails.
creatures.summary: Rigging-nesting spider that snares sail-climbers with silk

creatures.name: Rock-Skulking Bilge Ooze
creatures.flavor: Grew fat in a scuttled hold's standing bilgewater, corroding hull-plate and boot leather with equal patience.
creatures.summary: Bilgewater ooze that corrodes hull-plate and boot leather alike

creatures.name: Quartermaster's Shakedown Man
creatures.flavor: Enforces the Articles to the letter when it profits him and finds loopholes when it doesn't.
creatures.summary: Articles-enforcer who finds loopholes when it profits him

creatures.name: Coral Golem Guardian
creatures.model: net-new: a jagged reef-coral colossus shaped like a boarding pike, alive with darting cleaner-fish
creatures.flavor: Grown by something patient to guard a sunken treasure gallery, indifferent to the centuries it's taken.
creatures.summary: Patient coral colossus guarding a sunken treasure gallery

creatures.name: Storm-Wracked Harpy Matriarch
creatures.flavor: Nests her brood on a wreck-reef and sings ships onto the rocks to feed them.
creatures.summary: Wreck-nesting harpy matriarch that sings ships to their ruin

creatures.name: Bone-Naga of the Drowned Vault
creatures.flavor: Coiled around a sunken hold's strongbox for two hundred years, patient past any living captain's greed.
creatures.summary: Ancient bone-naga coiled around a sunken vault's treasure

creatures.name: Fen-Tide Merrow Raider
creatures.flavor: Overturns skiffs for the sport of it before it ever gets around to the plunder.
creatures.summary: Skiff-overturning merrow raider, plunder is an afterthought

creatures.name: Wreck-Diver Doppelganger
creatures.flavor: Wears the face of whichever sailor it drowned last, and answers to that name at the next port.
creatures.summary: Shape-stealing killer that answers to its last victim's name

creatures.name: Rigging-Runner Assassin
creatures.flavor: Boards from above, garrote-first, dropping from the mainmast onto whoever's steering.
creatures.summary: Above-boarding assassin who drops garrote-first onto helmsmen

creatures.name: Brine-Cursed Werebear Bosun
creatures.model: net-new: a hulking, salt-matted bear-shape bosun's coat still buttoned over the fur
creatures.flavor: Cursed by a witch-doctor for flogging the wrong sailor, and now the whole crew fears the full moon more than the storms.
creatures.summary: Cursed bosun who becomes a bear-thing under full moon

creatures.name: Powder-Keg Berserker Boarder
creatures.flavor: Leads the first wave over the gunwale swinging a boarding axe and screaming the crew's death-oath.
creatures.summary: First-wave boarding-axe berserker screaming a death-oath

creatures.name: Fogbank Siren's Herald
creatures.flavor: Sings the low harmony under the Siren's melody, close enough inshore that the fog never quite lifts.
creatures.summary: Fog-wreathed hag singing harmony to lure ships ashore

creatures.name: Sunken Chapel Revenant
creatures.flavor: A ship's chaplain who kept preaching as the water rose past the pulpit, and hasn't stopped since.
creatures.summary: Drowned chaplain still preaching from a sunken pulpit

creatures.name: Drowned Choir Cantor
creatures.flavor: Leads the storm-hymn from the quarterdeck, calling weather nobody sane would ask for twice.
creatures.summary: Storm-hymn cantor who calls weather nobody sane wants

creatures.name: Iron-Hulled Corsair Captain
creatures.flavor: Runs a fleet of three under false flags, and has personally sunk every navy sent to collect the bounty.
creatures.summary: Three-ship corsair captain, sinker of every bounty-navy sent

creatures.name: Reef Titan Anemone
creatures.flavor: A hull-sized anemone colony that's learned the shape of a drowning man and mimics it to draw rescuers in.
creatures.summary: Anemone colony that mimics drowning victims to lure rescuers

creatures.name: Gale-Bound Air Elemental Squallwright
creatures.flavor: Bound into a captain's storm-bottle generations back, and finally shaken loose in the worst possible weather.
creatures.summary: Bottled storm-elemental shaken loose in the worst weather

creatures.name: Drowned Duelist Wraith
creatures.flavor: Lost the duel over prize-shares and went over the rail still holding his rapier; he's kept the grip.
creatures.summary: Duel-drowned officer's ghost, still gripping his rapier

creatures.name: Sahuagin War-Priestess
creatures.flavor: Calls the tide itself into a raid, timing the assault to a surge no surface captain can predict.
creatures.summary: Tide-timing sea-devil priestess who calls the surge to war

creatures.name: Boarding-Pike Skeleton Crew
creatures.flavor: A drilled, disciplined unit of the drowned that still holds formation better than most living marines.
creatures.summary: Disciplined drowned skeleton unit, still holds formation

creatures.name: Waterlogged Chimeric Hulk-Beast
creatures.flavor: Three drowned crewmen fused by whatever curse sank the ship, now sharing one waterlogged, furious body.
creatures.summary: Three drowned sailors fused into one furious hulk

creatures.name: Deep-Baron's Shark-Bonded Enforcer
creatures.flavor: Rides a bonded reef shark into every raid and has never once had to swim himself.
creatures.summary: Sea-devil baron who rides a bonded shark into every raid

creatures.name: Hurricane-Voiced Storm Herald
creatures.flavor: An unseen wind-thing that rides ahead of a hurricane, testing a ship's rigging for the weak point the storm will use.
creatures.summary: Unseen wind-scout that finds a ship's weakest rigging first

creatures.name: Cursed Doubloon Wight-Captain
creatures.flavor: Cursed by the very gold he stole to guard it forever, raising every sailor who touches a coin as his crew.
creatures.summary: Gold-cursed wight-captain who conscripts anyone who takes a coin

creatures.name: Foundered Frigate's Ghast Bosun
creatures.flavor: Still runs the flogging line on a foundered frigate's ghost-deck, and the punishment never actually ends.
creatures.summary: Foundered frigate's undead disciplinarian, punishment unending

creatures.name: Kraken-Spawn Broodguard
creatures.flavor: Half-grown but already big enough to take a longboat down whole, guarding the nest for whatever birthed it.
creatures.summary: Half-grown deep-thing guarding a brood-nest, already boat-sized

creatures.name: Drowned Fleet Admiral's Ghost
creatures.flavor: Still commands a spectral squadron that only he can see, and still expects every ship on the horizon to salute.
creatures.summary: Ghost admiral commanding an invisible spectral squadron

creatures.name: Reef-Cracker Hydra
creatures.flavor: Denned in a sea-cave that's swallowed three ships trying to chart it, each head a different scar from the attempts.
creatures.summary: Cave-denned hydra scarred by three failed charting attempts

creatures.name: Boarding-Fiend Bone Devil
creatures.flavor: Contracted by a desperate captain for one impossible raid, and never bothered reading the fine print about payment.
creatures.summary: Contracted boarding-fiend, payment terms deliberately vague

creatures.name: Storm-Bound Efreeti Corsair
creatures.model: net-new: a fire-wreathed genie bound into a captain's figurehead, steam hissing where flame meets sea-spray
creatures.flavor: Bound into a corsair ship's figurehead by a desperate deal, and grants the crew impossible speed for an unpaid price.
creatures.summary: Figurehead-bound fire-genie granting speed for an unpaid price

creatures.name: Undertow Terror of the Shoals
creatures.flavor: Burrows through sandbars and shoal-mud the way its cousins burrow through snow, swallowing hulls whole from below.
creatures.summary: Shoal-burrowing terror that swallows hulls whole from beneath

creatures.name: Pale Fathom Wight-Lord
creatures.flavor: Rises from a specific wreck-site once a generation, always dragging the whole doomed crew back up with him.
creatures.summary: Generational wreck-revenant that drags its whole crew back up

creatures.name: Coral Throne Basilisk-Queen
creatures.flavor: Coils a sunken palace's reef-throne, petrifying anything that tries to loot the drowned crown beside her.
creatures.summary: Reef-throne guardian that petrifies looters of a drowned crown

creatures.name: Death-Knight of the Broken Articles
creatures.flavor: Signed the Articles in his own blood and died enforcing every clause; still hunts crews who break the code.
creatures.summary: Blood-oathed undead enforcer of pirate-code violations

creatures.name: Sunken Archmage of the Drowned Spire
creatures.flavor: Went down with his tower-ship still casting, and hasn't noticed two centuries pass underwater.
creatures.summary: Two-centuries-drowned archmage still mid-spell in his tower

creatures.name: Nightbringer of the Drowned Fleet
creatures.flavor: Turned in his own cabin during a becalmed crossing, and has been quietly recruiting the fleet ever since.
creatures.summary: Shipboard vampire quietly turning a becalmed fleet's crew

creatures.name: The Bilge-Born Horror
creatures.flavor: Grew in the dark of a cursed hold on a diet of drowned stowaways, and sees every deck above it through the planks.
creatures.summary: Hold-grown horror that sees through the deck planks above

creatures.name: The Drowned Doge
creatures.model: net-new: a bloated, crown-wearing merchant-lord corpse enthroned on a barnacled chair of fused coin
creatures.flavor: Bankrolled the fleet that sank an entire rival port, and now presides drowned over the wreckage he bought.
creatures.summary: Drowned merchant-lord enthroned over the port he sank

creatures.name: The Ninth Wave Herald
creatures.model: net-new: a churning wall-wave given a face, lightning threading through its curling crest like veins
creatures.flavor: Sailors swear the ninth wave in any storm is always the worst; this is why, and it knows the superstition is true.
creatures.summary: Sentient storm-wave that is the reason the ninth wave is worst

creatures.name: The Deathless Mutiny
creatures.model: net-new: a fused mass of mutineers' corpses forming one many-armed horror
creatures.flavor: Every crew that ever turned on its captain and drowned for it feeds this thing; it wears whichever coat the nearest mutiny needs.
creatures.summary: Fused mass of every drowned mutiny, wearing a stolen captain's coat

creatures.name: The Sunken Cathedral's Choir Eternal
creatures.model: net-new: a coral-crowned lich enthroned in a drowned cathedral nave
creatures.flavor: A ship's chaplain who lichified himself to keep preaching to a congregation that drowned two centuries ago and never left.
creatures.summary: Lich-chaplain still preaching to a two-century-drowned congregation

creatures.name: The Maw That Charts No Course
creatures.flavor: Surfaces on no chart and no schedule, swallowing whole convoys, and every survivor swears a different direction it came from.
creatures.summary: Chartless leviathan that swallows convoys from no fixed direction

creatures.name: the Drowned Captain
creatures.flavor: Lashed to a wheel that rotted out from under him decades ago, he still barks headings to a crew that stopped answering. Cross his wake and he'll press every soul aboard into one more hunt.
creatures.summary: undead ship's-master, obsessed and unable to stop commanding
creatures.sourceNote: generic mad-captain figure in the vein of Melville's Ahab (1851, PD) — our own obsessive, not Ahab himself

creatures.name: Bosun Wormwood
creatures.flavor: Every crew needs someone to swing first and count the take later. He's not smart, he's not brave, but there's always another one behind him.
creatures.summary: rank-and-file cutlass pirate, first over the rail
creatures.sourceNote: stock cutthroat-pirate-mook archetype (uncopyrightable stock type)

creatures.name: the Bone Quartermaster
creatures.flavor: He still keeps the manifest, tallying cargo that turned to silt a hundred years back. Argue with his math and he'll settle it with a cutlass.
creatures.summary: undead crewman, ledger-obsessed and cutlass-armed
creatures.sourceNote: undead-crew archetype built on the ghost-ship stock trope

creatures.name: the Kraken
creatures.flavor: Sailors call it a myth right up until the sea stands up around their ship. It doesn't hunt for food anymore — it hunts because something that old resents being disturbed.
creatures.summary: the mythic apex sea-titan, rarely surfaces, never forgotten
creatures.sourceNote: Norse/Scandinavian sea-monster legend, pre-modern folklore (also the Alfred Tennyson sonnet, 1830, PD)

creatures.name: Moby, the White Whale
creatures.flavor: Pale as bone and scarred by a hundred failed harpoons, it doesn't flee ships — it turns and comes back for them. Some captains hunt it for the bounty. Others hunt it because they can't stop.
creatures.summary: the pale, unkillable whale that turns and fights back
creatures.sourceNote: Melville, Moby-Dick (1851, PD) — the whale itself, not any adaptation's design

creatures.name: a Siren
creatures.flavor: The song doesn't promise treasure or lust — it promises rest, which is worse, because half the crew actually wants that. She only has to be patient; the rocks do the rest.
creatures.summary: reef-perched singer whose song offers exhausted sailors relief
creatures.sourceNote: Greek myth — the Sirens (Homer's Odyssey, ancient/PD)

creatures.name: a Siren-Flock Screecher
creatures.flavor: Not every siren has the voice for the killing song — the young ones just shriek and dive-bomb, hoping to knock a sailor loose from the rigging while their elders finish the job.
creatures.summary: young siren, screeches and dives rather than enchants
creatures.sourceNote: Greek myth — the Sirens, junior/flock member

creatures.name: Scylla
creatures.flavor: She doesn't chase ships — she waits in the same strait she's waited in since before anyone's grandmother, and takes exactly one sailor from every hull that passes too close to her side.
creatures.summary: strait-bound many-headed horror, takes a toll from every passing hull
creatures.sourceNote: Greek myth — Scylla, the six-headed strait-monster (Homer's Odyssey, ancient/PD)

creatures.name: the Charybdis Maw
creatures.flavor: Not a creature so much as an appetite the sea itself grew — three times a day the strait empties into her throat and nothing caught in the pull ever argues its way back out.
creatures.summary: living whirlpool that swallows the strait on a rhythm
creatures.sourceNote: Greek myth — Charybdis, the whirlpool-monster paired with Scylla (Homer's Odyssey, ancient/PD)

creatures.name: the Flying Dutchman's Wheelman
creatures.flavor: Doomed to round the same cape forever, the ship's own helm has become a creature of splintered wood and drowned will — it doesn't want passengers, it wants company in the doom.
creatures.summary: the cursed ghost-ship itself, animate and hunting for crew
creatures.sourceNote: the Flying Dutchman — Cape maritime legend, pre-modern folklore (first written accounts 18th c.)

creatures.name: a Dutchman Deckhand
creatures.flavor: Soaked through and past caring, they still haul the same lines they died hauling. Boarding one ship is the same as boarding the next, to them — the work never ends.
creatures.summary: waterlogged member of the cursed eternal crew
creatures.sourceNote: the Flying Dutchman legend — the doomed crew, pre-modern folklore

creatures.name: Davy Jones's Chain-Ghoul
creatures.flavor: Every drowned sailor goes to the Locker eventually, the old saying goes — and some of them claw back up the anchor chain first, still hungry for one more meal above the waterline.
creatures.summary: drowned-sailor ghoul climbing up from the seabed locker
creatures.sourceNote: Davy Jones's Locker — sailors' folk-idiom for the seabed afterlife, maritime folklore (not a specific character design)

creatures.name: the Locker-Warden
creatures.flavor: Every sailor swears the Locker has a keeper who counts the dead as they settle. Whether that's true or just something sailors tell each other in a storm, something down there is definitely counting.
creatures.summary: the folkloric seabed afterlife given a keeper, vast and patient
creatures.sourceNote: Davy Jones's Locker folk-idiom, personified as its own keeper — our invention on the folklore, not a claimed character

creatures.name: a Sea Hag of the Shoals
creatures.flavor: She trades storms for secrets and secrets for storms, and never tells you which one you actually bought. Sailors leave offerings on the reef so she'll look the other way.
creatures.summary: reef-dwelling hag who barters weather for confessions
creatures.sourceNote: folk sea-hag figure, generic maritime witch-crone (not tied to any single copyrighted work)

creatures.name: a Sahuagin Raider
creatures.flavor: They rise off the reef in packs when a hull rides too low and too slow, stripping a wreck bare before the survivors even reach the boats.
creatures.summary: reef-raiding fish-humanoid, opportunistic wreck-stripper
creatures.sourceNote: generic fish-humanoid raider archetype (own deep-water raider framing, no external IP)

creatures.name: a Sahuagin Depth-Priest
creatures.flavor: He blesses the raids in a tongue that predates any surface language, and the raiders fight harder for it — not out of faith exactly, more like fear of what he'd do if they didn't.
creatures.summary: deep cult priest who blesses reef-raids with dread invocations
creatures.sourceNote: generic fish-humanoid priest archetype, own deep-sea cult framing

creatures.name: a Merrow Wrecker
creatures.flavor: Not clever, just strong and hungry and drawn to the sound of splintering hulls. A merrow doesn't wreck ships for treasure — treasure's just what's left after it eats.
creatures.summary: brutish sea-ogre that swarms wrecks for the meal, not the loot
creatures.sourceNote: generic ogre-of-the-sea archetype (folkloric merrow stock type, no specific IP)

creatures.name: the Bosun's Ghost
creatures.flavor: He still walks his rounds belowdecks, and any living sailor who hears his whistle in the dark knows to brace for something going badly wrong topside within the hour.
creatures.summary: haunting ship's-officer whose whistle warns (or curses) the crew
creatures.sourceNote: generic maritime-haunting archetype — the officer who died on duty and can't leave it

creatures.name: a Corsair Deckhand
creatures.flavor: Fast over the rigging and faster with a knife, these are the ones sent ahead to cut lines and douse lanterns before the boarding party even shows itself.
creatures.summary: nimble boarding-raider, cuts lines before the main assault
creatures.sourceNote: generic historical-corsair mook archetype — long-dead seafaring raider figure, not any named individual

creatures.name: the Storm-Bound Djinn
creatures.flavor: Bound into a waterspout centuries ago by a captain who never wrote down how, it now answers to no one and drags whole ships skyward just to watch them fall.
creatures.summary: elemental genie fused into a waterspout, capricious and huge
creatures.sourceNote: elemental sea-storm archetype drawn from the broad genie/elemental stock type of maritime legend

creatures.name: the Wrecking Reef-Wraith
creatures.flavor: In life it lit false beacon-fires to lure ships onto the rocks for salvage. In death it just lights the fires — there's no cargo left to want, only the habit.
creatures.summary: drowned wrecker's ghost, still luring ships onto the rocks
creatures.sourceNote: generic ghost-of-the-shoals archetype — the drowned wrecker who lured ships onto rocks in life

creatures.name: Sand-Choked Sentry
creatures.flavor: A picked-clean guard still standing post at a gate nobody uses, sand pouring from its ribs.
creatures.summary: classic bone guardian, forever walking its post

creatures.name: Glyph-Warded Scarab Swarm
creatures.flavor: A living seal poured into a doorway generations ago; disturb the lintel and the carpet of beetles rises.
creatures.summary: tomb-curse insect swarm guarding a sealed door

creatures.name: Sun-Fat Ridgeback
creatures.flavor: A sun-fat lizard the size of a hound, sunning on toppled cornices until your shadow crosses it.
creatures.summary: oversized lizard basking among fallen ruins

creatures.name: Linen-Wrapped Shambler
creatures.flavor: A pilgrim mummified mid-step by the dry wind, still shuffling a processional route no one remembers.
creatures.summary: rot-wrapped shambler retracing a dead ritual

creatures.name: Blind Archive-Gnawer
creatures.flavor: Pale, sightless rat-things nesting in the archive halls for a thousand years, chewing scrolls no one will miss.
creatures.summary: blind vermin swarm infesting the buried archive

creatures.name: Cracked Watch-Idol
creatures.flavor: A hollow votive statue jerking through a guard pattern it can no longer complete without falling over.
creatures.summary: animated stone idol stuck on an endless patrol

creatures.name: Vine-Choked Ambusher
creatures.flavor: Something fat and patient in the vines strangling the ornamental garden; it strikes from beneath the flowers.
creatures.summary: venomous ambush-spider lurking in overgrown ruins

creatures.name: Bone-Orchard Jackal
creatures.flavor: Pack scavenger that has learned tomb-robbers mean an easy meal; it circles at the treeline, waiting for the digging to stop.
creatures.summary: scavenger jackal pack circling grave robbers

creatures.name: Curse-Bound Grave Ghoul
creatures.flavor: Someone who broke the same seal you're about to break, and never made it back out.
creatures.summary: paralyzing ghoul, once a fellow tomb-raider

creatures.name: Snake-Cult Zealot
creatures.flavor: A serpent-blooded devotee who kept the old faith alive underground long after the empire fell, fangs bared under a ceremonial mask.
creatures.summary: fanged serpent-cultist guarding forbidden rites

creatures.name: Wall-Set Spear-Guard
creatures.flavor: The last vizier, wound in the same linens as the dead-tongue king it still serves, delivering proclamations to an empty throne room.
creatures.summary: bandaged vizier still guarding an empty throne

creatures.name: Plinth-Fused Sentinel
creatures.flavor: A carved guardian fused to its plinth, sworn to never let the inner sanctum see a second dawn of daylight.
creatures.summary: stone temple guardian bound to bar the sanctum

creatures.name: Riddle-Keeper of the Threshold
creatures.flavor: A stone-eyed watcher at the last unbroken gate, bound to test any who'd pass with a question the builders thought unanswerable.
creatures.summary: riddling sphinx guarding the tomb's final gate

creatures.name: Raptor of the Ruined Plaza
creatures.flavor: A lean pack-hunter that has ruled the crumbled plaza for generations, using fallen colonnades as blinds.
creatures.summary: pack-hunting raptor stalking the ruined plaza

creatures.name: Living Armor-Back
creatures.flavor: A slow tank of a beast that has worn a path through the sacred road for so long its footprints are mistaken for paving.
creatures.summary: club-tailed armored dinosaur, unstoppable and slow

creatures.name: Horned Terror of the Sacred Road
creatures.flavor: A three-horned bull of a beast that charges anything crossing its stretch of the ceremonial highway.
creatures.summary: three-horned dinosaur charging trespassers on sight

creatures.name: The Weeping Cistern
creatures.flavor: Ceremonial water gone wrong across centuries of stagnation and old magic, filling the sunken bath-hall.
creatures.summary: corrosive ooze filling a flooded sacred bath

creatures.name: Marching Colossus of the Processional
creatures.flavor: A processional statue built to march the ceremonial road once a generation; the ceremony stopped, but nobody told the statue.
creatures.summary: towering stone statue still marching a dead parade

creatures.name: Basalt Gaze of the Garden
creatures.flavor: Cursed by the same magic that petrified the garden's statuary, she has become one more monument in a courtyard full of them — until she moves.
creatures.summary: snake-haired guardian posing as garden statuary

creatures.name: Coiled Warden of the Inner Vault
creatures.flavor: A serpentine spirit bound by the builders to guard the innermost vault, ancient and imperturbably patient with intruders.
creatures.summary: giant guardian serpent coiled around the vault door

creatures.name: Throne-Ape of the Fallen Grove
creatures.flavor: A colossal ape the ruin's people once worshipped as a living god; it still holds court over the collapsed temple grove, and it still expects tribute.
creatures.summary: worshipped ape-god ruling the collapsed temple grove

creatures.name: Ever-Marching Automaton King
creatures.flavor: A war-engine built in the last king's image to defend the throne room forever; its coronation speech still loops, garbled, from a mouth that was never meant to speak this long.
creatures.summary: golem king still guarding a throne that's empty

creatures.name: Apex Titan-Lizard
creatures.flavor: The garden's true owner now — a saurian titan that has claimed the collapsed dome as its den, indifferent to the empire whose bones it sleeps on.
creatures.summary: apex tyrant-lizard ruling the collapsed dome

creatures.name: The Unread King
creatures.flavor: The god-king himself, entombed with a dead language carved into his sarcophagus so no living mouth could ever again pronounce his true name — and no living hand could ever again wake him. Someone always finds a way.
creatures.summary: the mummified god-king, cursed and finally waking

creatures.name: The Standing Monument

creatures.summary: gargantuan stone colossus that never stopped watching

creatures.name: Sun-Baked Scrap Raptor

creatures.summary: Small pack raptor darting between ruined stones

creatures.name: Feathered Sickle-Claw

creatures.summary: Feathered raptor slashing with a hooked hind claw

creatures.name: Sickle-Toed Ambush Runner
creatures.model: net-new: a pair of raptors flanking prey between broken columns
creatures.flavor: Coordinated raptors that flank prey between broken columns.
creatures.summary: Coordinated raptor pair flanking around fallen columns

creatures.name: Withered Grave-Servant
creatures.flavor: A tomb-slave animated by lingering funerary rites, shuffling in endless circuits.
creatures.summary: Shuffling tomb-slave still walking its funeral circuit

creatures.name: Salt-Cured Husk
creatures.flavor: Preserved by desert salts rather than proper rites, brittle but relentless.
creatures.summary: Salt-cured husk shambling with brittle relentlessness

creatures.name: Rattling Ossuary Ward

creatures.summary: Wire-bound bones standing eternal watch over bones

creatures.name: Loose-Jointed Tomb Archer
creatures.model: net-new: a rattling bone-guard still loosing arrows down a processional hall
creatures.flavor: Old bone-guards still loosing arrows down processional halls.
creatures.summary: Bone-guard still loosing arrows down the hall

creatures.name: Dune-Coiled Fang Serpent
creatures.model: net-new: a coiled venomous serpent nesting in a cracked idol plinth

creatures.summary: Venomous serpent nesting in a cracked plinth

creatures.name: Constrictor of the Choked Aqueduct
creatures.model: net-new: a heavy-bodied serpent coiled against wet aqueduct stone
creatures.flavor: A heavy-bodied snake that squeezes prey against aqueduct stone.
creatures.summary: Heavy serpent squeezing prey against wet stone

creatures.name: Sun-Cult Acolyte
creatures.flavor: A robed devotee chanting to gods the ruins no longer answer.
creatures.summary: Robed acolyte chanting to unanswering old gods

creatures.name: Dead-Tongue Initiate
creatures.model: net-new: a gaunt initiate muttering an extinct liturgical language
creatures.flavor: Trains in the extinct liturgical language, half-mad from isolation.
creatures.summary: Initiate half-mad from an extinct liturgical tongue

creatures.name: Scaled Temple-Guard
creatures.flavor: A hardened spear-bearer sworn to a dynasty centuries gone.
creatures.summary: Hardened spear-guard sworn to a dead dynasty

creatures.name: Feather-Cloaked Sentinel
creatures.flavor: Marches the outer wall in molting ceremonial plumage.
creatures.summary: Plumed sentinel marching the crumbling outer wall

creatures.name: Idol-Cracked Jackal
creatures.model: net-new: a scavenger jackal denning beneath a toppled idol
creatures.flavor: A scavenger pack that dens beneath toppled idols.
creatures.summary: Scavenger jackal denning beneath a toppled idol

creatures.name: Grave-Wasp Nest Cluster
creatures.model: net-new: a wasp nest cluster swarming out of a hollow sarcophagus
creatures.flavor: Nests inside hollow sarcophagi, swarming any disturbance.
creatures.summary: Wasp nest swarming from a hollow sarcophagus

creatures.name: Chittering Reliquary Swarm
creatures.model: net-new: a scarab swarm boiling out of a cracked reliquary
creatures.flavor: Scarabs boiling out of a cracked reliquary at the first footstep.
creatures.summary: Scarab swarm boiling from a cracked reliquary

creatures.name: Rope-Fanged Pit Viper
creatures.model: net-new: a coiled viper hidden in a false-bottomed coffin
creatures.flavor: Coils in false-bottomed sarcophagi as a trap-maker's last defense.
creatures.summary: Coiled viper hidden in a false-bottomed coffin

creatures.name: Choke-Vine Ambusher
creatures.model: net-new: a creeping vine blight rooted in cracked temple flagstone
creatures.flavor: A creeping blight rooted in cracked temple flagstone.
creatures.summary: Creeping vine blight rooted in cracked flagstone

creatures.name: Spore-Choked Idol Fungus
creatures.model: net-new: a fungal growth on an idol that shrieks when disturbed
creatures.flavor: Shrieks a warning when disturbed, drawing every guardian in earshot.
creatures.summary: Idol fungus shrieking to summon every guardian

creatures.name: Loincloth Grave-Robber
creatures.flavor: A local desperate enough to loot the same tombs the party is exploring.
creatures.summary: Desperate local looting the same cursed tombs

creatures.name: Whisper-Idol Cultist Fanatic
creatures.flavor: Speaks in the dead tongue and believes the idols still listen.
creatures.summary: Fanatic convinced the silent idols still listen

creatures.name: Broken-Fang Wererat Tomb-Rat
creatures.model: net-new: a cursed grave-looter scurrying tomb tunnels as vermin
creatures.flavor: A cursed grave-looter who now scurries the tunnels as vermin by night.
creatures.summary: Cursed looter scurrying tunnels as vermin

creatures.name: Stalking Sand-Ambusher
creatures.model: net-new: a spider-shape slipping through desert heat-mirage to ambush
creatures.flavor: Slips between the desert's heat-mirage and the material world to strike.
creatures.summary: Ambusher slipping through heat-mirage to strike

creatures.name: Petrifying Serpent-Crowned Guardian
creatures.model: net-new: a stone-eyed guardian statue that petrifies with a glance
creatures.flavor: A carved-looking beast said to have once been a living guard, now stone-eyed.
creatures.summary: Stone-eyed guardian that petrifies with a glance

creatures.name: Vulture-Headed Carrion Priest
creatures.model: net-new: a vulture-masked priest presiding over open-air excarnation rites
creatures.flavor: Wears a vulture skull mask and presides over open-air excarnation rites.
creatures.summary: Vulture-masked priest presiding over excarnation rites

creatures.name: Sarcophagus-Bound Wight Steward
creatures.flavor: Once the mummy-king's chief steward, still enforcing an outdated household order.
creatures.summary: Undead steward still enforcing dead household order

creatures.name: Blazing Ember-Skull Oracle
creatures.model: net-new: a burning severed skull muttering fire-lit prophecy
creatures.flavor: The severed head of a court astrologer, still muttering prophecy in fire.
creatures.summary: Astrologer's burning skull still muttering prophecy

creatures.name: Broken Wing Terror-Bird
creatures.flavor: A flightless apex predator that once ruled the temple's terraced gardens.
creatures.summary: Flightless apex hunter ruling terraced garden ruins

creatures.name: Vault-Sworn Ettin Doorkeeper
creatures.model: net-new: a two-headed brute chained to guard a single vault door
creatures.flavor: Two-headed brute chained by old oath to guard a single vault door.
creatures.summary: Two-headed brute oath-bound to guard one door

creatures.name: Weretiger Jungle-Stalker
creatures.model: net-new: a cursed hunter prowling the jungle canopy above the ruin
creatures.flavor: A cursed hunter who prowls the jungle canopy above the ruin.
creatures.summary: Cursed hunter prowling the ruin's jungle canopy

creatures.name: Cracked-Idol Gargoyle Watcher
creatures.flavor: A stone temple guardian animated by residual sun-god magic.
creatures.summary: Stone guardian animated by residual sun-magic

creatures.name: Ash-Grey Ochre Seep
creatures.model: net-new: a corrosive ooze seeping through burial-chamber floor cracks
creatures.flavor: Seeps through cracks in the burial chamber floor, dissolving the careless.
creatures.summary: Corrosive ooze seeping through burial-chamber cracks

creatures.name: Hollow-Coffer Gelatinous Vault
creatures.model: net-new: a cube-shaped ooze absorbing a tomb corridor's grave goods
creatures.flavor: Fills an entire tomb corridor, absorbing centuries of grave goods.
creatures.summary: Cube-shaped ooze absorbing centuries of grave goods

creatures.name: Chain-Bound Barrow Ghast
creatures.model: net-new: a ravenous ghast in rotted chains once served the king's table
creatures.flavor: A ravenous grave-thing that once served the mummy-king's table.
creatures.summary: Ravenous ghast once serving the king's table

creatures.name: Bandaged Falconry Ghast
creatures.model: net-new: a bandaged ghast tending the tomb's mummified hunting birds
creatures.flavor: Handles the tomb's mummified hunting birds with rotted, careful hands.
creatures.summary: Ghast tending the tomb's mummified hunting birds

creatures.name: Toppled Minotaur Skeleton Guard
creatures.model: net-new: a skeletal minotaur guard still pacing its ruined maze
creatures.flavor: The bones of a labyrinth-guardian, still pacing its maze in death.
creatures.summary: Skeletal labyrinth-guardian still pacing its maze

creatures.name: Grave-Silk Poltergeist
creatures.model: net-new: a shrouded poltergeist hurling funerary urns at intruders
creatures.flavor: Hurls funerary urns and shrouds at anyone who breaks tomb silence.
creatures.summary: Poltergeist hurling urns at silence-breakers

creatures.name: Zombie-Herd Elephant Carrier
creatures.model: net-new: a shambling zombie elephant still hauling grave-cart chains
creatures.flavor: A shambling beast of burden still hauling grave-cart chains.
creatures.summary: Shambling zombie beast still hauling grave-cart chains

creatures.name: Snake-Cult Priest of the Hollow Coil
creatures.model: net-new: a chanting priest summoning serpents up from the foundations
creatures.flavor: Leads chants that draw serpents up from the temple's foundations.
creatures.summary: Priest whose chants summon serpents from below

creatures.name: Sacrificial Blind Prophet
creatures.model: net-new: a blind prophet claiming to speak for a buried god
creatures.flavor: Claims to speak for a god buried under the plaza; sometimes right.
creatures.summary: Blind prophet claiming to speak for a buried god

creatures.name: Wrapped Gladiator of the Sun Pit
creatures.model: net-new: a bandage-wrapped undying gladiator dueling an empty arena
creatures.flavor: An undying champion still fighting exhibition duels for a vanished crowd.
creatures.summary: Undying champion still dueling a vanished crowd

creatures.name: Bog-Sunk Umber Digger
creatures.flavor: Tunnels beneath the temple, its gaze cracking minds through cracked floors.
creatures.summary: Tunneling digger whose gaze cracks minds below

creatures.name: Rot-Feathered Bulette Ambusher
creatures.flavor: Erupts from beneath temple courtyards, scattering worshippers and looters alike.
creatures.summary: Burrowing ambusher erupting under temple courtyards

creatures.name: Sun-Forged Earth Colossus Fragment
creatures.flavor: A shard of an ancient wall given animus by buried sun-forges.
creatures.summary: Animate wall-shard powered by buried sun-forges

creatures.name: Cinder-Font Fire Warden
creatures.flavor: Guards the eternal brazier said to keep the mummy-king's tomb warm.
creatures.summary: Warden guarding the mummy-king's eternal brazier

creatures.name: Rope-Trap Roper of the Deep Shaft
creatures.flavor: Mimics a stalactite in the temple's deepest excavation shaft.
creatures.summary: Stalactite-mimic lurking a deep excavation shaft

creatures.name: Bloated Refuse-Idol Otyugh
creatures.flavor: Feeds on centuries of temple refuse dumped down a forgotten well.
creatures.summary: Refuse-fed horror lurking a forgotten temple well

creatures.name: Shambling Garden Overgrowth
creatures.model: net-new: a sentient tangle of vines reclaiming a hanging garden
creatures.flavor: A reclaimed hanging garden, fully sentient and territorial now.
creatures.summary: Sentient overgrowth reclaiming a hanging garden

creatures.name: Ashen Vampire-Spawn Handmaiden
creatures.model: net-new: a pale undead handmaiden tending a long-empty throne
creatures.flavor: A royal handmaiden turned undead, still tending an empty throne.
creatures.summary: Undead handmaiden still tending an empty throne

creatures.name: Wight-Lord of the Processional Guard
creatures.model: net-new: an armored wight-lord commanding the marching dead guard
creatures.flavor: Commands the lesser dead who still march the ceremonial road.
creatures.summary: Undead lord commanding the marching dead guard

creatures.name: Sky-Talon Wyvern of the Ziggurat
creatures.flavor: Roosts atop the tallest step-pyramid, territorial over the whole valley.
creatures.summary: Wyvern roosting atop the tallest step-pyramid

creatures.name: Idol-Warped Chimera of Three Gods
creatures.flavor: A grafted horror built from the temple's three patron-beast idols.
creatures.summary: Grafted horror built from three patron-beast idols

creatures.name: Eight-Legged Web-Warden of the Vault
creatures.flavor: Half-cursed guardian left to web shut the innermost treasure vault.
creatures.summary: Half-cursed drider webbing shut the treasure vault

creatures.name: Storm-Song Satyr Revelmaster of Ruins
creatures.model: net-new: a fey satyr holding a feral revel among fallen columns
creatures.flavor: Holds feral revels among the fallen columns, luring the reckless in.
creatures.summary: Fey revelmaster luring travelers to ruin-feasts

creatures.name: Hollow-Throated Vrock Carrion-Caller
creatures.model: net-new: a vulture-headed demon bound to guard forbidden grave-magic
creatures.flavor: A summoned scavenger-demon bound to guard forbidden grave-magic.
creatures.summary: Summoned scavenger-demon guarding forbidden grave-magic

creatures.name: Serpent-Sworn Lamia of the Oasis Court
creatures.model: net-new: a serpent-bodied lamia charming travelers at a hidden oasis
creatures.flavor: Charms travelers at a hidden oasis before feeding on their years.
creatures.summary: Charming oasis fiend feeding on stolen years

creatures.name: Basalt-Skinned Gorgon of the Sun Gate
creatures.model: net-new: a bull-shaped stone construct breathing petrifying dust at a gate
creatures.flavor: A bull-shaped construct whose breath turns intruders to stone at the gate.
creatures.summary: Bull construct petrifying intruders at the sun gate

creatures.name: Nine-Serpent Basalt Hydra Spawn
creatures.flavor: Guards the temple's central cistern, heads regrowing with each severed strike.
creatures.summary: Cistern hydra whose heads regrow when severed

creatures.name: Petrified Roc of the High Terraces
creatures.model: net-new: a colossal roc nesting atop a crumbling stone terrace
creatures.flavor: A colossal bird that nests atop the crumbling highest terrace tier.
creatures.summary: Colossal roc nesting on the crumbling terrace

creatures.name: Fossil-Chained Behir of the Under-Passage
creatures.flavor: A lightning-scaled serpent-beast that patrols the flooded under-passages.
creatures.summary: Lightning serpent-beast patrolling flooded passages

creatures.name: Dune-Sunk Purple Devourer
creatures.flavor: Tunnels beneath the whole valley, swallowing pilgrims and pillars alike.
creatures.summary: Colossal worm tunneling beneath the whole valley

creatures.name: Efreeti Bound to the Eternal Forge-Idol
creatures.model: net-new: a flame-wreathed efreeti chained to stoke an idol-forge
creatures.flavor: Bound by old contract to stoke the forge that casts the temple's idols.
creatures.summary: Bound efreeti stoking the temple's idol forge

creatures.name: Cyclops Oracle of the Buried Eye
creatures.model: net-new: a blinded one-eyed giant reading omens in collapsing stone
creatures.flavor: A blinded seer-giant who reads omens in the ruins' collapsing stone.
creatures.summary: Blinded giant seer reading omens in ruined stone

creatures.name: Marble-Veined Storm Giant Excavator
creatures.model: net-new: a marble-veined giant standing guard over a quarry pit
creatures.flavor: Once quarried the temple's founding stones; still guards the quarry pit.
creatures.summary: Giant quarry-guard who once cut the temple's stones

creatures.name: Death-Cultist Herald of the Buried Sun
creatures.model: net-new: a robed cultist preaching that the sun itself lies entombed
creatures.flavor: Preaches that the sun itself is entombed and can be freed by blood rite.
creatures.summary: Cultist preaching the sun is entombed, awaiting blood rite

creatures.name: Archpriest of the Dead Liturgy
creatures.model: net-new: an aged archpriest, last living speaker of a dead tongue
creatures.flavor: The last living speaker of the temple's true dead language, and its final judge.
creatures.summary: Last living speaker of the temple's dead liturgy

creatures.name: Bone-Crowned Death Knight of the Ziggurat
creatures.model: net-new: a bone-crowned death knight commanding a legion long gone
creatures.flavor: An entombed general still commanding a legion that no longer exists.
creatures.summary: Entombed general commanding a legion long gone

creatures.name: Vault-Sealed Naga of the Bone Archive
creatures.model: net-new: a serpent-sage naga coiled guarding an archive of the dead
creatures.flavor: A serpent-sage bound to guard the archive of dead names.
creatures.summary: Serpent-sage guarding the archive of the dead's names

creatures.name: Frost-Cracked Abominable Cave-Beast
creatures.flavor: An anomalous cold-thing that dens in the temple's deepest, frost-slick cave.
creatures.summary: Anomalous cold-beast denning in a frost-slick cave

creatures.name: Rakshasa Vizier of the Broken Court
creatures.flavor: The mummy-king's old advisor, still whispering counsel from the shadows of the throne.
creatures.summary: Fiendish vizier still whispering from the throne's shadow

creatures.name: The Undying Ape-Colossus of the Sacred Grove
creatures.model: net-new: a titanic stone ape-idol animated to punish desecrators
creatures.flavor: A titanic idol carved in the shape of the ape-god, animated to punish the grove's desecrators.
creatures.summary: Titanic ape-idol punishing desecrators of the grove

creatures.name: Dragon-Turtle of the Drowned Necropolis
creatures.model: net-new: a shelled leviathan wearing a swallowed necropolis like armor
creatures.flavor: A shelled leviathan that swallowed a lesser necropolis whole and now wears it like armor.
creatures.summary: Shelled leviathan wearing a swallowed necropolis

creatures.name: The First Priest-King, Undying
creatures.model: net-new: a jeweled, dreaming skull, all that remains of a founder-king
creatures.flavor: All that remains of the dynasty's founder, a jeweled skull that still dreams of empire.
creatures.summary: Founder-king's jeweled skull still dreaming empire

creatures.name: Emperor Wyrm of the Sunken Ziggurat
creatures.model: net-new: a great serpent-dragon corpse bound to its own ziggurat
creatures.flavor: A great serpent-dragon bound in death to the ziggurat it once terrorized alive.
creatures.summary: Serpent-dragon bound in death to its own ziggurat

creatures.name: The Ever-Watching Sphinx of Final Judgment
creatures.flavor: Judges every soul that crosses the temple threshold, riddle or blade in equal measure.
creatures.summary: Threshold sphinx judging souls by riddle or blade

creatures.name: Medusa
creatures.flavor: A cursed priestess left to guard a ruin no one else will enter; she doesn't hunt, she waits for you to look.
creatures.summary: snake-haired gaze-petrify guardian of a forbidden shrine
creatures.sourceNote: Greek myth (Perseus cycle)

creatures.name: the Minotaur
creatures.flavor: Bred as a punishment and grown into a king of his own maze — the walls moved to keep him, so now he moves them to keep you.
creatures.summary: bull-headed labyrinth-warden, gores anything that gets turned around
creatures.sourceNote: Greek myth (Theseus / Cretan labyrinth)

creatures.name: the Hydra
creatures.flavor: Every wound you land is a negotiation it wins later — cut deep enough, fast enough, or it simply outlasts you with one more mouth.
creatures.summary: regenerating many-headed swamp apex predator
creatures.sourceNote: Greek myth (Labors of Herakles)

creatures.name: the Cyclops
creatures.flavor: He counts his flock by touch, one eye or none, and either way he's never once lost track of an intruder.
creatures.summary: one-eyed shepherd-giant sentry, brutal in close quarters
creatures.sourceNote: Greek myth (Homer's Odyssey, Polyphemus)

creatures.name: the Oracle Cyclops
creatures.flavor: Blinded on purpose, so the story goes, in trade for seeing further — he'll tell you your death before he deals it.
creatures.summary: blind seer-giant, prophetic elite variant of the sentry
creatures.sourceNote: Greek myth — Cyclopes as forge-kin of Hephaestus / seer tradition

creatures.name: the Chimera
creatures.flavor: Three heads, three different opinions about how you should die — the goat screams first so the lion and the dragon don't have to.
creatures.summary: lion/goat/serpent composite, breathes fire mid-roar
creatures.sourceNote: Greek myth (Iliad; Bellerophon cycle)

creatures.name: the Harpy
creatures.flavor: They don't so much attack as infest — a shrieking cloud that strips a camp of food and morale in the same pass.
creatures.summary: filth-winged bird-woman raider, hunts in screaming flocks
creatures.sourceNote: Greek myth (Argonautica; Aeneid)

creatures.name: the Harpy Matriarch
creatures.flavor: Older, meaner, and smart enough to use her flock as bait — she circles while they soften you up.
creatures.summary: harpy brood-leader, coordinates the swarm's dive attacks
creatures.sourceNote: Greek myth — harpy tradition, elevated to a brood-leader

creatures.name: the Sphinx-Warden
creatures.model: net-new: lion-bodied, human-faced, feathered-winged riddler perched on a ruined threshold
creatures.flavor: She'll let you pass if you answer well — and she is in absolutely no hurry, because she has outlived every wrong answer she's ever heard.
creatures.summary: riddling lion-bodied guardian barring a sealed passage
creatures.sourceNote: Greek/Egyptian myth (riddle-guardian tradition, Oedipus cycle)

creatures.name: Anubis's Jackal-Priest
creatures.model: net-new: jackal-masked embalmer-priest in funerary wrappings, ceremonial flail
creatures.flavor: He was a man once, before the mask stopped coming off — now he weighs every heart that walks into his tomb, including his own.
creatures.summary: jackal-masked tomb-priest, judges intruders before it fights them
creatures.sourceNote: Egyptian myth/religion (Anubis, funerary tradition) — treated as a masked mortal priesthood, not the god

creatures.name: the Mummy
creatures.flavor: Wrapped, sealed, and cursed on purpose — it was meant to stay down here forever, and it resents every second you've made that not true.
creatures.summary: bandage-wrapped rot-cursed guardian of a sealed tomb
creatures.sourceNote: Egyptian funerary myth/folklore (pre-1929 literary tradition, e.g. Stoker's Jewel of Seven Stars)

creatures.name: Gilgamesh's Shade
creatures.model: net-new: a once-great king's armored shade, bull-horned crown, still swinging for immortality
creatures.flavor: He tore down Humbaba, refused his own death twice, and still lost the one fight that mattered — now he re-fights every stranger like they might be that fight.
creatures.summary: legendary king's undying shade, apex melee boss
creatures.sourceNote: Epic of Gilgamesh (Mesopotamian, ancient/public domain)

creatures.name: Humbaba
creatures.model: net-new: bark-skinned forest titan, roaring face of coiled intestine-like features per the epic's description
creatures.flavor: He was posted here to keep the cedar forest safe from people exactly like you, and he has never once been relieved of that duty.
creatures.summary: monstrous forest-guardian giant, terrifying roar attack
creatures.sourceNote: Epic of Gilgamesh — forest guardian set by the gods

creatures.name: Grendel
creatures.model: net-new: hulking marsh-born raider, iron-resistant hide, drags prey back to the fen
creatures.flavor: He doesn't want your gold and doesn't want your land — he wants the noise you make to stop, permanently.
creatures.summary: iron-immune marsh-raider, hunts camps at night
creatures.sourceNote: Beowulf (Old English epic, public domain)

creatures.name: Grendel's Mother
creatures.model: net-new: a mere-dwelling avenger, drags the fight underwater to fight on her terms
creatures.flavor: She only comes up out of the mere when someone's killed one of hers — and by then the math has already stopped being in your favor.
creatures.summary: underwater ambush-avenger, drags foes into her mere
creatures.sourceNote: Beowulf — the mere-wife, avenging kin

creatures.name: Raptor Pack-Hunter
creatures.model: net-new: feathered pack-hunting dromaeosaur, quick and coordinated
creatures.flavor: One alone is a nuisance; hearing three more calling back from the treeline is the actual threat.
creatures.summary: quick feathered pack-hunter, always comes in threes
creatures.sourceNote: paleontological fact (dromaeosaurid dinosaur), no IP owner

creatures.name: Pteranodon Screecher
creatures.flavor: It doesn't want a fight, it wants your lunch — but it'll take a finger to get it.
creatures.summary: cliff-nesting flying scavenger, snatches and flees
creatures.sourceNote: paleontological fact (pterosaur), no IP owner

creatures.name: Allosaurus
creatures.flavor: Not the biggest thing in the valley, just the fastest thing willing to test that against you.
creatures.summary: mid-sized ambush predator, fast and relentless
creatures.sourceNote: paleontological fact, no IP owner

creatures.name: Triceratops
creatures.flavor: It would honestly rather be left alone grazing the fern-flats — it just won't be told to move twice.
creatures.summary: armored horned grazer, devastating charge when cornered
creatures.sourceNote: paleontological fact, no IP owner

creatures.name: Tyrannosaurus Rex
creatures.flavor: The valley has a food chain and one name at the top of it — everything else here is just working out how to be somewhere else when it walks by.
creatures.summary: the valley's apex predator, ends most fights in one bite
creatures.sourceNote: paleontological fact, no IP owner

creatures.name: Threshold Rat
creatures.flavor: Ordinary vermin that nest only in houses where something else already lives; they scatter from the cellar door the instant it's ajar, and never go back in.
creatures.summary: Vermin omen fleeing whatever else lives here

creatures.name: Guttered Wick
creatures.flavor: A candle-flame that should have died in the draft an hour ago; it drifts room to room looking for the wick it lost. Touch its light and your own shadow forgets to follow you for a minute.
creatures.summary: Drifting corpse-light that steals your shadow

creatures.name: Grinning Poppet
creatures.model: animated-flying-sword: a small porcelain doll skittering upright on cracked joints
creatures.flavor: Left on the nursery shelf for three generations, it only moves when no one is looking directly at it, and it is always exactly one shelf closer than it was.
creatures.summary: The haunted doll that creeps when unwatched

creatures.name: Pallid Newcomer
creatures.flavor: Someone who died recently enough that the neighbors still wave. It walks the same route to the same house every night and knocks exactly three times.
creatures.summary: Fresh-buried neighbor still walking its route

creatures.name: Bone-Rattle Skeleton
creatures.flavor: Grave-robbed bones reassembled by something patient; it clicks when it walks, a metronome counting down to whatever the cult needs it for.
creatures.summary: Reassembled grave-bones, a cult's patient tool

creatures.name: Zealous Initiate
creatures.flavor: A true believer in plain robes, still capable of guilt, still capable of running the ritual anyway. Answers to the coven without question.
creatures.summary: Robed true-believer running the ritual anyway

creatures.name: Static Reflection
creatures.flavor: A mirror-image one full second behind, that finally catches up and steps out of the glass. It drains you the way a slow leak drains a tire — you don't notice until you're on the ground.
creatures.summary: Mirror-double, one second behind, draining you

creatures.name: Rot-Handed Ghoul
creatures.flavor: Once a mourner who ate what it was supposed to bury; its paralytic bite is the reason funerals in the gloom are held at noon, never dusk.
creatures.summary: Grave-eater whose bite paralyzes the mourner

creatures.name: Moonshackled Cur
creatures.flavor: Runs in the pack that follows the werewolf's howl, half-turned and losing more of itself with every full moon it survives.
creatures.summary: Half-turned wolf-thing running with the pack

creatures.name: Household Poltergeist
creatures.flavor: Not a haunting — a tantrum, ongoing, decades long. It throws whatever's closest and has strong opinions about who's allowed in its kitchen.
creatures.summary: Decades-long tantrum that throws the furniture

creatures.name: Cellar Warden
creatures.flavor: The cult leaves it down in the dark to keep the door shut from the inside — except lately it's been the one opening it.
creatures.summary: The cult's own guard now opening the door

creatures.name: Full-Moon Shepherd
creatures.flavor: Wears its human face at the market and its true face at midnight, and swears every time it will be the last. It never is.
creatures.summary: The neighbor who wears a wolf's face at midnight

creatures.name: Hollow-Robed Zealot
creatures.flavor: A cult elder who finished the rite on himself; wrapped in the vestments he died in, still leading services nobody living attends.
creatures.summary: Self-mummified elder still preaching to no one

creatures.name: Possessed Vessel
creatures.flavor: Wears a person like a coat, imperfectly — the voice is right but the blinking is wrong. Whatever's inside it wants the body back once its work is finished.
creatures.summary: A person worn like a coat, blinking wrong

creatures.name: The Slow Reflection
creatures.flavor: Lives one mirror-second out of sync with the world; it has had a full lifetime alone in that lag to plan what it'll do the moment it catches up.
creatures.summary: Ghost one second behind, plotting to catch up

creatures.name: Grief-Fed Banshee
creatures.flavor: Mourns in a key that shatters glass and eardrums both; she was promised a wake that never happened, and she's still owed it.
creatures.summary: Wailing widow owed a wake that never came

creatures.name: Coven Matriarch
creatures.flavor: The eldest of a coven of three, who trades in stolen sleep and worse; her sisters answer to her the way a storm answers to the moon.
creatures.summary: Coven matriarch trading in stolen sleep and souls

creatures.name: Marrow Revenant
creatures.flavor: Came back wrong and remembers exactly who wronged it. Walks in a straight line toward its killer through locked doors, walls, anything.
creatures.summary: Undead thing that only wants its killer, unerringly

creatures.name: Candlewax Doppelganger
creatures.flavor: A face that melts and re-sets itself into whoever last looked at it too long; meeting its eyes is how it decides which of you to become next.
creatures.summary: Melting face that copies whoever stares longest

creatures.name: Congregation Made Flesh
creatures.flavor: What happens when a coven's devotion finally has somewhere to go — a dozen willing bodies fused at the altar into one thing that still, somehow, prays.
creatures.summary: A coven's dozen bodies fused into one prayer

creatures.name: Warden of the Cellar Door
creatures.flavor: Bound to the one door in the house that's never fully closed; it has watched every family that ever lived there and outlasted all of them.
creatures.summary: Vampire bound to the door that's never shut

creatures.name: Bell-Tolling Revenant
creatures.flavor: A funeral bell's worth of grief given shape and a bell-tower's worth of reach; it tolls once for every soul it's owed, and it keeps very careful count.
creatures.summary: Bell-tower revenant tolling once per debt owed

creatures.name: The Second Face in the Glass
creatures.flavor: An elder vampire kingpin who lives entirely inside reflective surfaces, one beat behind its prey, until the night it decides to be early instead.
creatures.summary: Elder vampire kingpin living inside the mirrors

creatures.name: The Uninvited
creatures.flavor: It always knocks first. Every house it has ever entered, it was let in — a guest, a mourner, a face someone half-remembered — and it has never once needed to knock twice.
creatures.summary: Ancient thing that only ever needs one knock

creatures.name: The Possession at the Root
creatures.flavor: Not a demon wearing a body — a congregation's worth of willing vessels burned down to one true and monstrous shape, still calling itself by the coven's oldest, most patient name.
creatures.summary: A congregation's willing vessels burned to one shape

creatures.name: Crawlspace Widow
creatures.flavor: A bloated house-spider the size of a cat that drops from attic rafters onto sleeping throats.
creatures.summary: Attic spider that drops on sleepers

creatures.name: Threadbare Scarecrow
creatures.flavor: A field-post effigy stuffed with grave-dirt straw that unpins itself at moonrise.
creatures.summary: Straw effigy that walks after moonrise

creatures.name: Ashen Widow's Cat
creatures.flavor: A funeral-black cat that never blinks and always knows which door hides the coffin.
creatures.summary: Unblinking cat that tracks the dead

creatures.name: Gutter Wraith
creatures.flavor: A drowned drunk's grudge, sluicing through storm drains looking for the one who left him there.
creatures.summary: Drowned grudge haunting the storm drains

creatures.name: Wick-Eyed Changeling Child
creatures.flavor: A too-quiet foundling left in a cradle, its smile widening only when no one is looking.
creatures.summary: Cradle-swapped child with a widening smile

creatures.name: Tallow Ghoul
creatures.flavor: A ghoul that drips rendered fat from a crypt-candle vigil that never ended.
creatures.summary: Candle-vigil ghoul dripping rendered fat

creatures.name: Splintered Marionette
creatures.model: net-new: a puppet with its own cut strings, still bowing
creatures.flavor: A puppet-theater star whose strings were cut by its own hand, still bowing to an empty house.
creatures.summary: Self-cut puppet bowing to an empty house

creatures.name: Bog-Sunk Revenant
creatures.flavor: A peat-preserved corpse hauled from the marsh, its noose still knotted at the throat.
creatures.summary: Peat-bog hanged man risen with the noose

creatures.name: Pox-Marked Thrall
creatures.flavor: A plague-branded villager who traded a fever for a whisper that never stops.
creatures.summary: Plague villager thralled to a whisper

creatures.name: Feral Barn Bat-Swarm
creatures.flavor: A rafters-thick cloud of bats that only stirs when the church bell cracks midnight.
creatures.summary: Bell-triggered swarm pouring from the rafters

creatures.name: Rope-Burned Suicide
creatures.flavor: A hanging-tree haunt that re-lives its last minute on anyone who lingers beneath the branch.
creatures.summary: Hanging-tree haunt re-living its last minute

creatures.name: Hollow Nursemaid
creatures.flavor: A governess-shaped absence that hums lullabies through the nursery wall long after the family fled.
creatures.summary: Lullaby-humming absence in the nursery wall

creatures.name: Cur of the Black Barn
creatures.flavor: A farm dog that starved loyal beside its master's grave and rose wrong.
creatures.summary: Loyal farm dog that starved and rose wrong

creatures.name: Rat-King Knot
creatures.flavor: Dozens of sewer rats fused tail-to-tail into one furious, many-headed knot.
creatures.summary: Tail-fused rats forming one furious knot

creatures.name: Choir-Loft Poltergeist
creatures.flavor: An organist's fury, still slamming hymnal pages and yanking bellropes no hand can hold.
creatures.summary: Organist's fury slamming hymnals and bellropes

creatures.name: Gravecloth Zombie
creatures.flavor: A shroud-wrapped exhumee, still stitched into its burial linens, lurching by grave-light.
creatures.summary: Shroud-stitched exhumee lurching by grave-light

creatures.name: Fen Ghoul
creatures.flavor: A ghoul that nests in flooded family crypts, its claws slick with graveyard silt.
creatures.summary: Crypt-nesting ghoul with silt-slick claws

creatures.name: Beast of the Full Moon Runt
creatures.flavor: A fresh-bitten victim mid-transformation, more terrified of itself than of you.
creatures.summary: Freshly bitten victim terrified of itself

creatures.name: Wax-Sealed Familiar
creatures.flavor: A coven's carrier-crow, its beak sewn shut around a secret it will die before dropping.
creatures.summary: Coven crow with a beak sewn shut

creatures.name: Sackcloth Effigy
creatures.flavor: A burnt-corn poppet stitched with a stranger's hair, animated by whoever's name is pinned to its chest.
creatures.summary: Hair-stitched poppet animated by a pinned name

creatures.name: Ossuary Skitterling
creatures.flavor: A single severed hand from the charnel wall, still scrabbling toward its own coffin.
creatures.summary: Severed charnel-wall hand scrabbling homeward

creatures.name: Lantern-Jawed Corpse Candle
creatures.flavor: A death-light that hovers over fresh graves, feeding on the grief of mourners who follow it.
creatures.summary: Grave-light that feeds on following mourners

creatures.name: Widow's Veil Shade
creatures.flavor: A mourning-dress silhouette that peels off mirrors during funerals to grieve alongside the living.
creatures.summary: Mirror-shed silhouette that grieves at funerals

creatures.name: Feasting Cellar Grub
creatures.flavor: A pale root-cellar centipede fattened on offerings left for something worse living deeper down.
creatures.summary: Pale centipede fattened on deeper offerings

creatures.name: Rusalka's Drowned Bride
creatures.flavor: A jilted bride who walked into the millpond in her gown and now walks out of it, dripping.
creatures.summary: Jilted drowned bride walking out dripping

creatures.name: Fanged Chorister
creatures.flavor: A choir-loft ghoul whose hymn-perfect voice lures the faithful within reach of its talons.
creatures.summary: Hymn-voiced ghoul luring the faithful closer

creatures.name: Marrow Beetle Swarm
creatures.flavor: A carpet of grave-beetles that strips a corpse to clean bone in a single feeding.
creatures.summary: Grave-beetle carpet that strips corpses clean

creatures.name: Bell-Jar Wraith
creatures.flavor: A physician's failed experiment, trapped between a bell jar and the grave, still reaching for its notes.
creatures.summary: Failed experiment reaching for its notes

creatures.name: Attic-Bound Revenant
creatures.flavor: A locked-away relative the family pretended never existed, still pacing the same six feet.
creatures.summary: Locked-away relative still pacing six feet

creatures.name: Coven Apprentice
creatures.flavor: A hedge-witch initiate memorizing the coven's book by candle-stub, half in love with the dark it teaches.
creatures.summary: Hedge-witch initiate half in love with the dark

creatures.name: Reliquary Ghast
creatures.flavor: A saint's stolen corpse gone hungry, still wearing the vestments it was buried in.
creatures.summary: Stolen saint's corpse gone hungry in vestments

creatures.name: Ossified Bell-Ringer
creatures.flavor: A campanile skeleton that still climbs the tower stair each dusk, ringing a bell no one else hears.
creatures.summary: Skeleton still ringing an unheard dusk bell

creatures.name: Charnel-Yard Skeleton Archer
creatures.flavor: A crossbow-armed grave-guard skeleton that still holds its post along the cemetery wall.
creatures.summary: Crossbow skeleton still holding its cemetery post

creatures.name: Full-Moon Enforcer
creatures.flavor: A pack lieutenant who hunts in human guise all week and only shows its claws at the coven's convenience.
creatures.summary: Pack lieutenant hiding claws until convenient

creatures.name: Steeple Bloodkin
creatures.flavor: A choirmaster turned bloodsucker who still leads the hymn each Sunday, mouth stitched into a smile.
creatures.summary: Choirmaster vampire leading hymns with stitched smile

creatures.name: The Weeping Bride
creatures.flavor: A ghost bride whose scream shatters glass at the mention of the groom who left her at the altar.
creatures.summary: Jilted ghost bride whose scream shatters glass

creatures.name: Warden of the Drowning Pool
creatures.flavor: A witch-trial executioner cursed to guard the millpond where he condemned the innocent.
creatures.summary: Cursed executioner guarding the drowning pool

creatures.name: Hollow-Throated Ghast Priest
creatures.flavor: A defrocked cleric who fed his own flock to something in the crypt and joined the feast.
creatures.summary: Defrocked cleric who joined his flock's feast

creatures.name: Coven Hexweaver
creatures.flavor: A three-sister coven's youngest voice, still human enough to bargain, cruel enough to relish it.
creatures.summary: Coven's youngest sister, bargains cruelly

creatures.name: The Mirror-Bound Twin
creatures.flavor: A reflection that stole its owner's face centuries ago and now waits in every polished surface.
creatures.summary: Face-stealing reflection waiting in every mirror

creatures.name: Rite-Scarred Zealot Captain
creatures.flavor: A ritual leader whose scars spell the summoning name in a language the tongue was never meant for.
creatures.summary: Ritual leader scarred with a forbidden name

creatures.name: Charnel-House Ogre Zombie
creatures.flavor: A gravedigger's own hulking corpse, reanimated by the very rite he used to raise others.
creatures.summary: Gravedigger's corpse raised by his own rite

creatures.name: The Second Groom
creatures.flavor: A jilted suitor who murdered the wedding party and now presides over an eternal, empty reception.
creatures.summary: Jilted suitor presiding over an eternal reception

creatures.name: Loomstitch Doppelganger
creatures.flavor: A face-thief who replaced a beloved village elder months ago, and no one has noticed the seams yet.
creatures.summary: Face-thief impersonating the beloved village elder

creatures.name: Gallows Wraith Captain
creatures.flavor: An executed highwayman who commands lesser hanged-spirits from the crossroads gibbet.
creatures.summary: Hanged highwayman commanding lesser gibbet-spirits

creatures.name: Vestry Revenant
creatures.flavor: A murdered sexton, swollen with grave-rot fury, who will not stop digging until his killer is found.
creatures.summary: Swollen sexton digging until his killer's found

creatures.name: Cellar-Bound Bulette Grub
creatures.flavor: A burrowing horror that tunneled up under a village graveyard and now surfaces through open plots.
creatures.summary: Burrowing horror surfacing through open graves

creatures.name: Coven Matron's Cauldron-Kin
creatures.flavor: A second matriarch of the same coven, who trades in nightmares rather than curses.
creatures.summary: Second matriarch trading in nightmares, not curses

creatures.name: Blood-Thrall Chevalier
creatures.flavor: A knight sworn to a vampire's service centuries past, still armored, still loyal, still starving.
creatures.summary: Centuries-loyal knight thrall, still starving

creatures.name: Ashfall Mummy Curate
creatures.flavor: A sect elder mummified alive as punishment, now shepherding the congregation from inside its wrappings.
creatures.summary: Punished elder mummified alive, still shepherding

creatures.name: Marrow-Bound Wererat Broker
creatures.flavor: A black-market fixer who trades cursed relics from the sewers, and bites those who don't pay.
creatures.summary: Sewer relic-fixer who bites debtors

creatures.name: Widow-Maker Banshee Elder
creatures.flavor: A generations-old keening spirit whose wail has claimed every man who married into her bloodline.
creatures.summary: Generations-old wail that claims every husband

creatures.name: Coffin-Nail Wight Sergeant
creatures.flavor: A militia captain buried with his men, now drilling their reanimated ranks in the churchyard at night.
creatures.summary: Buried captain drilling reanimated ranks by night

creatures.name: Blood-Drunk Vampire Familiar Knight
creatures.flavor: A turned squire who serves his master's coffin by day and hunts travelers by dusk.
creatures.summary: Turned squire guarding the coffin, hunting by dusk

creatures.name: Seance Circle Medium
creatures.flavor: A parlor spiritualist who really did open a door, and now can't close it, or doesn't want to.
creatures.summary: Parlor medium who opened a door she can't close

creatures.name: Effigy-Bound Flesh Golem
creatures.flavor: A resurrectionist's stitched patchwork, sewn from a village's worth of the recently deceased.
creatures.summary: Resurrectionist's patchwork sewn from village corpses

creatures.name: The Uninherited Heir
creatures.flavor: A disinherited son who haunts the family estate, rewriting the will in blood on the study wall each night.
creatures.summary: Disinherited ghost rewriting the will in blood

creatures.name: Coven Familiar Alpha
creatures.flavor: A frost-pale wolf bound to the coven's oldest hex, its howl carrying a curse instead of a warning.
creatures.summary: Coven-bound wolf whose howl carries a curse

creatures.name: Rot-Crowned Spirit Naga
creatures.flavor: A grave-cult idol given serpentine unlife, worshipped by the possessed congregation as a saint.
creatures.summary: Serpentine grave-idol worshipped as a saint

creatures.name: The Chained Confessor
creatures.flavor: An inquisitor's own victims fused into one shackled horror, forced to confess sins that were never theirs.
creatures.summary: Fused inquisition victims forced to confess

creatures.name: Blood-Countess's First Spawn
creatures.flavor: The vampire matriarch's oldest childe, groomed for centuries to eventually replace her.
creatures.summary: Ancient childe groomed to replace the matriarch

creatures.name: Church-Broken Death Knight
creatures.flavor: A crusader who slaughtered his own congregation at the coven's whisper, and now guards their unmarked grave.
creatures.summary: Crusader who slaughtered his flock, guards its grave

creatures.name: The Cellar Door's Real Keeper
creatures.flavor: A tunneling horror the covens have fed for generations, mistaken by the village for a mere legend.
creatures.summary: Generation-fed tunneling horror mistaken for legend

creatures.name: Matriarch of the Full Moon Pack
creatures.flavor: A were-beast alpha whose bite carries a curse potent enough to found an entire bloodline in one night.
creatures.summary: Alpha whose bite founds a whole bloodline

creatures.name: The Archivist of Screams
creatures.flavor: A librarian who catalogued every scream in the manor's history and became the sum of them.
creatures.summary: Librarian who became the sum of every scream

creatures.name: Blightmother's Chosen Vessel
creatures.flavor: A cult's living conduit to something old and hungry beneath the church foundation.
creatures.summary: Cult conduit to something old beneath the church

creatures.name: The Reflection That Escaped
creatures.flavor: A vampire that shattered its own mirror-prison and now hunts the family it once served for a hundred years.
creatures.summary: Mirror-escaped vampire hunting its former family

creatures.name: Wax Cathedral Sentinel
creatures.flavor: A candle-wax colossus grown from a century of dripped vigil-tapers, animated by grief alone.
creatures.summary: Vigil-wax colossus animated by a century of grief

creatures.name: The Possessed Cardinal
creatures.flavor: A high church official whose sermons now come from something else entirely, congregation unaware.
creatures.summary: Church official possessed, sermons not his own

creatures.name: Gravebound Necrohulk
creatures.flavor: A mass grave that sprouted fungal flesh over centuries, wearing every buried skeleton at once.
creatures.summary: Mass grave grown into a fungal flesh horror

creatures.name: The Hollow Cardinal Enthroned
creatures.flavor: A saint-king mummified on his own cathedral throne, still ruling a congregation of the dead.
creatures.summary: Mummified saint-king ruling a dead congregation

creatures.name: The Bloodline's First Sin
creatures.flavor: The founding ancestor of a cursed noble house, still enforcing the pact that damned every heir since.
creatures.summary: Founding ancestor enforcing the house's damning pact

creatures.name: The Rite Given Flesh
creatures.flavor: A century-long summoning ritual finally completed, wearing the coven's collective sacrifice as a body.
creatures.summary: Century-long ritual completed as living flesh

creatures.name: Grand Matriarch of the Blood Court
creatures.flavor: A vampire queen who transcended even undeath through a lichdom pact, ruling both realms of the dead.
creatures.summary: Vampire queen who transcended into lichdom

creatures.name: The Everlasting Congregation
creatures.flavor: An entire drowned parish fused by a cataclysmic ritual into one endless, singing, grasping mass.
creatures.summary: Entire drowned parish fused into one singing mass

creatures.name: the Bloodless Bride
creatures.flavor: A shambling grave-bride still in her rotted wedding linens, drawn to warmth and grief in equal measure; she doesn't hunt so much as attend, over and over, a wedding that ended badly.
creatures.summary: shuffling grave-bride, drawn to warmth and mourning
creatures.sourceNote: European folk-revenant/vampire folklore (pre-literary, no single owner)

creatures.name: Renfield's Kin
creatures.flavor: An asylum-thin thrall who traded sanity for a taste of borrowed immortality; catches flies, counts them, offers the count up like a prayer.
creatures.summary: insect-eating thrall serving something undead
creatures.sourceNote: Stoker, Dracula (1897, PD) — the Renfield archetype, generalized (not the named character)

creatures.name: the Carrion Wolf
creatures.flavor: Not yet a full were-thing — just a wolf that has fed on the wrong grave and picked up a taste, and a little too much cunning, for it.
creatures.summary: grave-fed wolf edging toward the curse
creatures.sourceNote: generic European werewolf folklore (pre-literary tradition, not any specific IP)

creatures.name: Fog-Walker
creatures.flavor: A pale hound-shape that only holds together inside fog; step into clear air and it's a stray dog again, confused and harmless.
creatures.summary: fog-bound phantom hound, harmless in clear air
creatures.sourceNote: generic Gothic-horror mist/fog-hound stock creature

creatures.name: the Somnambulist
creatures.flavor: A respectable townsperson by day; by dusk something narrower and meaner wears their face out into the streets. They remember none of it — the gloom remembers all of it.
creatures.summary: a townsperson's cruel second self, out after dark
creatures.sourceNote: Stevenson, Strange Case of Dr Jekyll and Mr Hyde (1886, PD) — the split-self archetype, generalized

creatures.name: Ashen Handmaiden
creatures.flavor: Still dusting a house that burned down a century ago; she'll answer the door for guests who knocked before her own death, and mistake the party for them.
creatures.summary: loyal ghost-servant, stuck in a burned house's routine
creatures.sourceNote: generic Gothic-manor servant-ghost stock type

creatures.name: Innsmouth Hollow-Kin
creatures.flavor: A villager whose family married the tide-line one generation too many; gill-slits under a high collar, and a hunger for the shallows nobody in town will name out loud.
creatures.summary: gill-marked villager with an unspoken tide-hunger
creatures.sourceNote: generic isolated-fishing-village/hybrid-folk stock type (not any specific IP's mythos)

creatures.name: the Wolf-Cursed
